AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless workflow with Step Functions publishing custom events to a custom EventBridge bus, with a rule forwarding all events to CloudWatch Logs.

Resources:
  CustomEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-custom-bus'

  EventArchiveLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-forwarded-events'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  LogsResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-eventbridge-logs-policy'
      PolicyDocument: !Sub |
        {
          "Version": "2012-10-17",
          "Statement": [
            {
              "Effect": "Allow",
              "Principal": {
                "Service": "events.amazonaws.com"
              },
              "Action": [
                "logs:PutLogEvents",
                "logs:DescribeLogStreams",
                "logs:CreateLogStream"
              ],
              "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/events/${AWS::StackName}-forwarded-events:*"
            }
          ]
        }

  ForwardAllEventsRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-forward-all'
      EventBusName: !Ref CustomEventBus
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - prefix: ''
      Targets:
        - Id: ForwardToCloudWatchLogs
          Arn: !GetAtt EventArchiveLogGroup.Arn

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PutEventsToCustomBus
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-event-publisher'
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: Publishes a custom event to the custom EventBridge bus
        StartAt: PutCustomEvent
        States:
          PutCustomEvent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: arn:aws:states:::aws-sdk:eventbridge:putEvents
            Parameters:
              Entries:
                - Detail: >-
                    {"message": "Hello from Step Functions", "source": "stepfunctions-demo"}
                  DetailType: CustomEvent
                  EventBusName: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
                  Source: com.example.custom
            End: true

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref StateMachine
  EventBusName:
    Description: Name of the custom EventBridge event bus
    Value: !Ref CustomEventBus
  EventBusArn:
    Description: ARN of the custom EventBridge event bus
    Value: !GetAtt CustomEventBus.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group
    Value: !Ref EventArchiveLogGroup
  LogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Logs log group
    Value: !GetAtt EventArchiveLogGroup.Arn

Description: CodePipeline custom action type for OpsWorks deployments backed by a Lambda function.

Resources:
  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/opsworks-deploy-custom-action
      RetentionInDays: 30

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: OpsWorksDeployPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - opsworks:UpdateApp
                  - opsworks:CreateDeployment
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:GetObjectVersion
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'

  OpsWorksDeployFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import time
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  job_id = event['jobId']
                  user_params = event.get('userParameters', {})
                  config = event.get('configuration', {})
                  deploy_bucket = config.get('Deploy-Bucket')
                  opsworks_stack_id = config.get('OpsWorks-Stack-ID')
                  opsworks_app_id = config.get('OpsWorks-App-ID')

                  def put_job_success(message):
                      print(message)
                      codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
                      codepipeline.put_job_success_result(jobId=job_id)

                  def put_job_failure(message):
                      print(message)
                      codepipeline = boto3.client('codepipeline')
                      codepipeline.put_job_failure_result(
                          jobId=job_id,
                          failureDetails={'type': 'JobFailed', 'message': message}
                      )

                  try:
                      opsworks = boto3.client('opsworks')
                      opsworks.create_deployment(
                          StackId=opsworks_stack_id,
                          AppId=opsworks_app_id,
                          Command={'Name': 'deploy'},
                          Comment='Deployment triggered by CodePipeline custom action'
                      )
                      put_job_success('OpsWorks deployment created successfully.')

                      put_job_failure(f'Deployment failed: {str(e)}')

    Properties:
      Category: Deploy

      Settings:

        - Name: OpsWorks-Stack-ID

        - Name: OpsWorks-App-ID

          Required: true
          Key: true

        MinimumCount: 1

Description: >
  Creates an IAM role for the DLM service and a lifecycle policy that takes
  daily snapshots (every 24 hours at 1:00 UTC) of EBS volumes tagged
  TeemDLM=daily, retaining the last 7 snapshots and copying all volume
  tags to the snapshots.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment name applied as a tag to all resources.
    Default: production

Resources:
  DLMLifecycleRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dlm-lifecycle-role
      Description: IAM role assumed by the DLM service to manage EBS snapshots.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dlm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dlm-snapshot-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateSnapshotsOnTaggedVolumes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*:*:volume/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/TeemDLM: daily
              - Sid: ManageSnapshots
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                Resource: arn:aws:ec2:*:*:snapshot/*
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    aws:ResourceTag/TeemDLM: daily
              - Sid: DescribeVolumes
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVolumes
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Name

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates an SSM String parameter (dbUsername, default value "alice"), a
  least-privilege IAM execution role, and a Lambda function that reads the
  parameter at runtime via boto3. Runtime note: python3.8 is deprecated and
  blocked by AWS Lambda, so python3.12 is used instead.

Parameters:
  DBUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: alice
    Description: Database username value stored in the dbUsername SSM parameter.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{1,64}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Username must be 1-64 characters (letters, digits, underscore, dot, hyphen).

Resources:
  DbUsernameParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: dbUsername
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref DBUsername
      Description: Database username for Lambda runtime testing.

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DbUsernameLeastPrivilege
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AllowGetDbUsernameParameter
                Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${DbUsernameParameter}'
              - Sid: AllowLambdaLogging
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  # Function name is fixed, so the log group ARN path is a static
                  # literal — avoids a role-to-function reference cycle.
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/db-username-test-function:*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/db-username-test-function:log-stream:*'

  DbUsernameLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/db-username-test-function
      RetentionInDays: 14

  DbTestFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DbUsernameLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: db-username-test-function
      Description: Test function that reads the dbUsername SSM parameter via boto3.
      # python3.8 is deprecated and blocked by AWS Lambda; python3.12 is used instead.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          PARAMETER_NAME: !Ref DbUsernameParameter
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os

          import boto3


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              parameter_name = os.environ["PARAMETER_NAME"]
              ssm_client = boto3.client("ssm")
              response = ssm_client.get_parameter(
                  Name=parameter_name, WithDecryption=False
              )
              db_username = response["Parameter"]["Value"]
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"dbUsername": db_username}),
              }

Outputs:
  DbUsernameParameterArn:
    Description: ARN of the dbUsername SSM parameter.
    Value: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${DbUsernameParameter}'
  DbUsernameParameterName:
    Description: Name of the dbUsername SSM parameter.
    Value: !Ref DbUsernameParameter
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the test Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt DbTestFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: Creates an IAM Access Analyzer named "MyAccountAnalyzer" with a Kind=Dev tag and archive rules for a trusted principal and trusted S3 buckets, using an idempotent get-or-create custom resource.

Resources:
  AnalyzerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AccessAnalyzerCustomResourcePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - access-analyzer:ListAnalyzers
                  - access-analyzer:GetAnalyzer
                  - access-analyzer:CreateAnalyzer
                  - access-analyzer:PutArchiveRule
                  - access-analyzer:TagResource
                  - access-analyzer:UntagResource
                  - access-analyzer:ListTagsForResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/access-analyzer.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAccessAnalyzer'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  AnalyzerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${AnalyzerLambdaFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  AnalyzerLambdaFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt AnalyzerLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import urllib.request
          import boto3

          ANALYZER_NAME = "MyAccountAnalyzer"
          ARCHIVE_RULES = [
              ("ArchiveTrustedPrincipal", "principal", "123456789012"),
              ("ArchiveDocsBucket", "resource", "docs-bucket"),
              ("ArchiveClientsBucket", "resource", "clients-bucket"),
          ]

          def send(event, context, status, data=None, reason=None):
              body = {
                  "Status": status,
                  "Reason": reason or ("See CloudWatch logs: " + context.log_stream_name),
                  "PhysicalResourceId": context.log_stream_name,
                  "StackId": event["StackId"],
                  "RequestId": event["RequestId"],
                  "LogicalResourceId": event["LogicalResourceId"],
                  "Data": data or {},
              }
              req = urllib.request.Request(
                  event["ResponseURL"],
                  data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
                  headers={"Content-Type": ""},
                  method="PUT",
              )
              urllib.request.urlopen(req)

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  client = boto3.client("accessanalyzer")
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      send(event, context, "SUCCESS")
                      return

                  arn = None
                  try:
                      arn = client.get_analyzer(analyzerName=ANALYZER_NAME)["analyzer"]["arn"]
                  except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                      pass

                  if arn is None:
                      resp = client.create_analyzer(
                          analyzerName=ANALYZER_NAME,
                          type="ACCOUNT",
                          tags={"Kind": "Dev"},
                      )
                      arn = resp["arn"]

                  for rule_name, prop, value in ARCHIVE_RULES:
                      client.put_archive_rule(
                          analyzerName=ANALYZER_NAME,
                          ruleName=rule_name,
                          filter={prop: {"eq": [value]}},
                      )

                  send(event, context, "SUCCESS", {"Arn": arn})
              except Exception as e:
                  send(event, context, "FAILED", reason=str(e))

  MyAccountAnalyzer:
    Type: Custom::Analyzer
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt AnalyzerLambdaFunction.Arn

    Value: !GetAtt MyAccountAnalyzer.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Creates an HTTP (Private DNS) namespace for service discovery named after
  the stack name, tagged with a "tutorial" key, and a "web" service within
  that namespace for testing purposes.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: tutorial
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  HttpNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'
      Vpc: !Ref Vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: tutorial
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::StackName'

  WebService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    Properties:
      Name: web
      NamespaceId: !Ref HttpNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        NamespaceId: !Ref HttpNamespace
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: A
            TTL: 300

Outputs:
  NamespaceId:
    Description: ID of the service discovery namespace
    Value: !Ref HttpNamespace

  ServiceId:
    Description: ID of the web service
    Value: !Ref WebService

  ServiceArn:
    Description: ARN of the web service
    Value: !GetAtt WebService.Arn

Description: >
  Encrypted EFS file system (general purpose) with automated backups disabled,
  mount targets in a dedicated VPC across two AZs.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - test
      - dev
      - staging
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging and naming.
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.

Resources:
  Vpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-subnet-a'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  SubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-subnet-b'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EfsSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow NFS (TCP 2049) only from within the VPC
      VpcId: !Ref Vpc
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 2049
          ToPort: 2049
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  EfsFileSystem:
    Type: AWS::EFS::FileSystem
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Encrypted: true
      PerformanceMode: generalPurpose
      ThroughputMode: elastic
      LifecyclePolicies:
        - TransitionToIA: AFTER_30_DAYS
        - TransitionToPrimaryStorageClass: AFTER_1_ACCESS
      BackupPolicy:
        Status: DISABLED
      FileSystemTags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-efs'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EfsFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetA
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EfsSecurityGroup

  MountTargetB:
    Type: AWS::EFS::MountTarget
    Properties:
      FileSystemId: !Ref EfsFileSystem
      SubnetId: !Ref SubnetB
      SecurityGroups:
        - !Ref EfsSecurityGroup

Outputs:
  FileSystemId:
    Description: ID of the EFS file system
    Value: !Ref EfsFileSystem
  FileSystemDnsName:
    Description: DNS name of the EFS file system

  MountTargetAId:
    Description: ID of the mount target in AZ A

    Description: IP address of the mount target in AZ A
    Value: !GetAtt MountTargetA.IpAddress
  MountTargetBIpAddress:
    Description: IP address of the mount target in AZ B
    Value: !GetAtt MountTargetB.IpAddress

    Properties:
      RoleName: SuperCoolAPI-AppSync-Logging-Role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams

    Properties:
      Name: SuperCoolAPI
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      LogConfig:
        CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncLoggingRole.Arn
        FieldLogLevel: ALL

      ResolverCountLimit: 100

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Serverless workflow: EventBridge rule on the default event bus detects EC2
  instance state changes (running, stopped, terminated) and starts a Step
  Functions state machine with placeholder business logic branches and
  CloudWatch Logs execution logging.

Resources:

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vendedlogs/states/${AWS::StackName}-ec2-state-sm'
      RetentionInDays: 30

  StateMachineLogResourcePolicy:
    Type: AWS::Logs::ResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'sfn-log-delivery-${AWS::StackName}'
      PolicyDocument: !Join
        - ''
        - - '{'
          - '"Version": "2012-10-17",'
          - '"Statement": [{'
          - '"Sid": "AllowStepFunctionsLogDestination",'
          - '"Effect": "Allow",'
          - '"Principal": {"Service": "states.amazonaws.com"},'
          - '"Action": ["logs:CreateLogStream", "logs:DescribeLogStreams", "logs:PutLogEvents",'
          - '"logs:CreateLogDelivery", "logs:GetLogDelivery", "logs:UpdateLogDelivery",'
          - '"logs:DeleteLogDelivery", "logs:ListLogDeliveries"],'
          - '"Resource": ["'
          - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
          - '", "'
          - !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'
          - '", "'
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/vendedlogs/states/*:*'
          - '"]}]'
          - '}'

  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ec2-state-sm-execution-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  StateMachineLoggingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Grants the Step Functions state machine role access to its CloudWatch Logs destination
      Roles:
        - !Ref StateMachineExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogDelivery
              - logs:GetLogDelivery
              - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
              - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
              - logs:ListLogDeliveries
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
              - logs:PutLogEvents
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
              - !Sub '${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  Ec2StateStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn:
      - StateMachineLoggingPolicy
      - StateMachineLogResourcePolicy
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub 'ec2-instance-state-workflow-${AWS::StackName}'
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      LoggingConfiguration:
        Destinations:
          - CloudWatchLogsLogGroup:
              LogGroupArn: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
        IncludeExecutionData: true
        Level: ALL
      Definition:
        Comment: Routes EC2 instance state-change events to placeholder business logic
        StartAt: DispatchInstanceState
        States:
          DispatchInstanceState:
            Type: Choice
            Choices:
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: running
                Next: RunningBranch
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: stopped
                Next: StoppedBranch
              - Variable: '$.detail.state'
                StringEquals: terminated
                Next: TerminatedBranch
            Default: UnsupportedState
          RunningBranch:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: business logic for instance running state'
            Parameters:
              instanceId.$: '$.detail.instance-id'
              state.$: '$.detail.state'
              region.$: '$.region'
              account.$: '$.account'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: RunningLogic
          RunningLogic:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: replace with real running-state tasks'
          StoppedBranch:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: business logic for instance stopped state'
            Parameters:
              instanceId.$: '$.detail.instance-id'
              state.$: '$.detail.state'
              region.$: '$.region'
              account.$: '$.account'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: StoppedLogic
          StoppedLogic:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: replace with real stopped-state tasks'
          TerminatedBranch:
            Type: Pass
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: business logic for instance terminated state'
            Parameters:
              instanceId.$: '$.detail.instance-id'
              state.$: '$.detail.state'
              region.$: '$.region'
              account.$: '$.account'
            ResultPath: '$.businessLogic'
            Next: TerminatedLogic
          TerminatedLogic:
            Type: Succeed
            Comment: 'PLACEHOLDER: replace with real terminated-state tasks'
          UnsupportedState:
            Type: Fail
            Comment: 'Unexpected EC2 instance state received'
            Error: 'UnsupportedInstanceState'
            Cause: 'The EC2 instance state did not match running, stopped, or terminated.'

  EventBridgeTriggerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'ec2-state-eventbridge-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartStateMachineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt Ec2StateStateMachine.Arn

  Ec2InstanceStateChangeRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'ec2-instance-state-change-${AWS::StackName}'
      Description: Matches EC2 instance state changes to running, stopped, or terminated
      State: ENABLED
      EventBusName: default
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - 'EC2 Instance State-change Notification'
        detail:
          state:
            - running
            - stopped
            - terminated
      Targets:
        - Id: Ec2StateStepFunctionsTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt Ec2StateStateMachine.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeTriggerRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: '$.detail.instance-id'
              state: '$.detail.state'
              region: '$.region'
              account: '$.account'
            InputTemplate: >-
              {
                "detail": {
                  "instance-id": <instanceId>,
                  "state": <state>
                },
                "region": <region>,
                "account": <account>
              }

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the EC2 instance state Step Functions state machine
    Value: !GetAtt Ec2StateStateMachine.Arn
  StateMachineName:
    Description: Name of the Step Functions state machine
    Value: !Ref Ec2StateStateMachine
  EventBridgeRuleName:
    Description: Name of the EventBridge rule on the default event bus
    Value: !Ref Ec2InstanceStateChangeRule
  StateMachineLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for state machine execution logs
    Value: !Ref StateMachineLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Creates a customer managed KMS key (with alias), an S3 bucket to receive
  CloudTrail log deliveries, a Glue database, and a Glue crawler to catalog
  the logs for Athena queries. Trail delivery is configured out-of-band
  (e.g. org-level or console trail) targeting this bucket.

Parameters:
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: cloudtrail-kk-admin-db
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-z0-9_-]+-kk-admin-db$
    Description: Name of the Glue database (must end with -kk-admin-db).

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for CloudTrail log bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudTrailEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudtrail:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:trail/*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/cloudtrail-logs-kk
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  CloudTrailLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CloudTrailLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CloudTrailLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudTrailAclCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn
          - Sid: CloudTrailWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  GlueDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref GlueDatabaseName

  GlueCrawlerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GlueCrawlerS3Access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub '${CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  CloudTrailCrawler:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Crawler
    Properties:
      Name: cloudtrail-logs-crawler
      Role: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn
      DatabaseName: !Ref GlueDatabase
      Targets:
        S3Targets:
          - Path: !Sub 's3://${CloudTrailLogBucket}/cloud-trail/AWSLogs/'
      TablePrefix: cloudtrail_

Outputs:
  BucketName:
    Description: Name of the CloudTrail log bucket.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailLogBucket
  BucketArn:
    Description: ARN of the CloudTrail log bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogBucket.Arn
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer managed KMS key.

    Description: Alias of the customer managed KMS key (use for external trail configuration).
    Value: !Ref KmsKeyAlias
  GlueDatabaseName:
    Description: Glue database name for Athena queries.
    Value: !Ref GlueDatabaseName

    Description: Name of the Glue crawler.
    Value: !Ref CloudTrailCrawler
  CrawlerRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Glue crawler IAM role.
    Value: !GetAtt GlueCrawlerRole.Arn

Description: >-
  Hybrid-mode deduplication idempotency store (DynamoDB) for scenarios where
  both polling and event-driven workflows may trigger duplicate executions on
  the same file. Provides a composite-key table with TTL and Point-in-Time
  Recovery, plus a managed IAM policy granting Lambda and Step Functions
  read/write access to the table.

Parameters:
  ProjectPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: fsxn-s3ap
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,40}$'
    Description: Prefix used to name the idempotency table and managed policy.
  TtlRetentionSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 604800
    MinValue: 3600
    MaxValue: 31536000
    Description: >-
      Default TTL retention period in seconds (default 7 days = 604800).
      Callers must write the ttl attribute as epoch seconds; expiry aligns
      with this configurable default.

Resources:
  IdempotencyTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-store'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: ttl
        Enabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  IdempotencyAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectPrefix}-idempotency-rw'
      Description: >-
        Read/write access to the idempotency DynamoDB table for Lambda
        execution roles and Step Functions state machine roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: IdempotencyTableReadWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:UpdateItem
              - dynamodb:DeleteItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:BatchGetItem
              - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
              - dynamodb:DescribeTable
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
              - !Sub '${IdempotencyTable.Arn}/index/*'

Outputs:
  IdempotencyTableName:
    Description: Name of the idempotency/deduplication DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyTable
  IdempotencyTableArn:
    Description: ARN of the idempotency/deduplication DynamoDB table.
    Value: !GetAtt IdempotencyTable.Arn
  TtlRetentionSeconds:
    Description: >-
      Configured TTL retention period in seconds; callers should write the
      ttl attribute as (current epoch seconds + this value).
    Value: !Ref TtlRetentionSeconds
  IdempotencyAccessPolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the managed policy to attach to Lambda and Step Functions roles.
    Value: !Ref IdempotencyAccessPolicy

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Chaos engineering workflow with Step Functions terminating an EC2 instance and validating ECS service health.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chaos-lab
    Description: Environment name used for resource naming.
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: Latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI resolved from public SSM parameter.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-a'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.16.0/20
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-b'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  ContainerSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for ECS tasks (default allow-all egress applies)
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - !Ref PublicSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - !Ref PublicSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId

  LogsEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.logs'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - !Ref PublicSubnetB
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId

  AlertKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for resilience alert SNS topic encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ec2-role'

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  ChaosInstance:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: t3.micro
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      IamInstanceProfile: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 1
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeType: gp3
            VolumeSize: 8
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-chaos-target'

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster'

  ECSTaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-task'
      Cpu: '256'
      Memory: '512'
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ECSTaskExecutionRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: app
          Image: public.ecr.aws/docker/library/nginx:latest
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: 80
              Protocol: tcp

  ECSTaskExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy

  ECSService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-service'
      Cluster: !Ref ECSCluster
      TaskDefinition: !Ref ECSTaskDefinition
      DesiredCount: 1
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: ENABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !GetAtt ContainerSecurityGroup.GroupId
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PublicSubnetA
            - !Ref PublicSubnetB

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-resilience-alerts'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlertKmsKey

  AlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic

  TerminateLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${EnvironmentName}-terminate-instance'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  HealthCheckLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${EnvironmentName}-check-ecs-health'
      RetentionInDays: 7

  LambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LambdaChaosPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateLogGroup.Arn
                  - !GetAtt HealthCheckLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ec2:TerminateInstances
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/${ChaosInstance}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ecs:DescribeServices
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ecs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:service/${ECSCluster}/${EnvironmentName}-service'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt AlertKmsKey.Arn

  TerminateInstanceFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-terminate-instance'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instance_id = event['instanceId']
              ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
              ec2.terminate_instances(InstanceIds=[instance_id])
              return {'terminated': instance_id}

  CheckHealthFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-check-ecs-health'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          CLUSTER_NAME: !Ref ECSCluster
          SERVICE_NAME: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-service'
          TOPIC_ARN: !Ref AlertTopic
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import os

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              ecs = boto3.client('ecs')
              cluster = os.environ['CLUSTER_NAME']
              service = os.environ['SERVICE_NAME']
              resp = ecs.describe_services(cluster=cluster, services=[service])
              svc = resp['services'][0]
              desired = svc['desiredCount']
              running = svc['runningCount']
              healthy = running >= desired and desired > 0
              if not healthy:
                  sns = boto3.client('sns')
                  sns.publish(
                      TopicArn=os.environ['TOPIC_ARN'],
                      Subject='ECS Service Unhealthy',
                      Message=f'Service {service} in cluster {cluster} is unhealthy: running={running}, desired={desired}'
                  )
              return {'healthy': healthy, 'running': running, 'desired': desired}

  StepFunctionsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StepFunctionsInvokePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt CheckHealthFunction.Arn

  ChaosStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    DependsOn:
      - StepFunctionsRole
      - TerminateInstanceFunction
      - CheckHealthFunction
    Properties:
      StateMachineType: EXPRESS
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StepFunctionsRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Chaos engineering workflow - terminate instance, wait, check ECS health",
            "StartAt": "TerminateInstance",
            "States": {
              "TerminateInstance": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${TerminateArn}",
                "Parameters": {
                  "instanceId.$": "$.instanceId"
                },
                "ResultPath": "$.terminateResult",
                "Next": "Wait300Seconds"
              },
              "Wait300Seconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 300,
                "Next": "CheckHealth"
              },
              "CheckHealth": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "${HealthArn}",
                "ResultPath": "$.healthResult",
                "Next": "IsHealthy"
              },
              "IsHealthy": {
                "Type": "Choice",
                "Choices": [
                  {
                    "Variable": "$.healthResult.healthy",
                    "BooleanEquals": true,
                    "Next": "ServiceHealthy"
                  }
                ],
                "Default": "ServiceUnhealthy"
              },
              "ServiceHealthy": {
                "Type": "Succeed"
              },
              "ServiceUnhealthy": {
                "Type": "Fail",
                "Error": "EcsServiceUnhealthy",
                "Cause": "ECS service running count below desired count after chaos test; SNS alert published by health check Lambda."
              }
            }
          }
        - TerminateArn: !GetAtt TerminateInstanceFunction.Arn
          HealthArn: !GetAtt CheckHealthFunction.Arn

Outputs:
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the chaos engineering state machine
    Value: !Ref ChaosStateMachine
  AlertTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the resilience alert SNS topic
    Value: !Ref AlertTopic
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: Name of the ECS cluster
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  ChaosInstanceId:
    Description: ID of the chaos target EC2 instance
    Value: !Ref ChaosInstance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Creates SSM parameters and a Secrets Manager secret under a stack-name-based
  path, plus a Lambda function (ParameterStoreDemo) that demonstrates retrieving
  parameters by path and secrets by name prefix.

Resources:
  DemoParameterConfig:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/config/example'
      Type: String
      Value: 'demo-config-value'
      Description: Demo non-sensitive configuration parameter

  DemoParameterFeature:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${AWS::StackName}/config/features'
      Type: StringList
      Value: 'featureA,featureB,featureC'
      Description: Demo StringList parameter for path-based retrieval

  DemoSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-demo-secret'
      Description: Demo secret with dynamically generated password
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"username": "demo-user"}'
        GenerateStringKey: 'password'
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludeCharacters: '"@/\'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ParameterStoreDemo-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmSecretsAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ssm:GetParameter'
                  - 'ssm:GetParameters'
                  - 'ssm:GetParametersByPath'
                  - 'ssm:DescribeParameters'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AWS::StackName}*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'secretsmanager:GetSecretValue'
                  - 'secretsmanager:ListSecrets'
                  - 'secretsmanager:DescribeSecret'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${AWS::StackName}*'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'

  ParameterStoreDemoFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: ParameterStoreDemo
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STACK_NAME: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
          SECRET_PREFIX: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          ssm = boto3.client("ssm")
          secrets = boto3.client("secretsmanager")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              stack_name = os.environ["STACK_NAME"]
              param_path = f"/{stack_name}"

              print(f"Retrieving SSM parameters under path: {param_path}")
              paginator = ssm.get_paginator("get_parameters_by_path")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Path=param_path, Recursive=True):
                  for param in page["Parameters"]:
                      print(f"SSM Parameter: {param['Name']} = {param['Value']}")

              print(f"Listing secrets with prefix: {stack_name}")
              secret_paginator = secrets.get_paginator("list_secrets")
              for page in secret_paginator.paginate():
                  for secret in page["SecretList"]:
                      name = secret["Name"]
                      if not name.startswith(stack_name):
                          continue
                      print(f"Found secret: {name}")
                      value = secrets.get_secret_value(SecretId=name)
                      secret_string = value.get("SecretString")
                      if secret_string:
                          parsed = json.loads(secret_string)
                          masked = {
                              k: ("****" if k.lower() == "password" else v)
                              for k, v in parsed.items()
                          }
                          print(f"Secret {name} values (password masked): {json.dumps(masked)}")

              return {"status": "complete"}

  DemoSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the demo secret
    Value: !Ref DemoSecret
  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the ParameterStoreDemo Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt ParameterStoreDemoFunction.Arn

  end-user IAM group with Service Catalog end-user permissions and four

        - PolicyName: servicecatalog-end-user-access

            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:

                  - servicecatalog:ProvisionProduct

                  - servicecatalog:SearchProvisionedProducts
                  - servicecatalog:DescribeProvisionedProduct
                  - servicecatalog:TerminateProvisionedProduct

        Version: '2012-10-17'

Description: >
  Basic Step Functions state machine (STANDARD) with a two-step Pass state
  workflow ("Hello" then "World") for testing Amazon States Language.

Resources:
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: MyBasicStateMachine
      StateMachineType: STANDARD
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Two-step Pass state workflow: Hello then World",
          "StartAt": "HelloState",
          "States": {
            "HelloState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "Hello",
              "ResultPath": "$.message",
              "Next": "WorldState"
            },
            "WorldState": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": "World",
              "ResultPath": "$.next",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }
      Tags:
        - Key: stateMachine:createdBy
          Value: SAM

Description: Lambda function logging current UTC time every 5 minutes via CloudWatch Events rate schedule.

Resources:

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'time-logger-lambda-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TimeLoggerLambdaLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  TimeLoggerLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/${TimeLoggerFunction}'
      RetentionInDays: 30
    DeletionPolicy: Delete

  TimeLoggerFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'time-logger-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      MemorySize: 128
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import logging
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(logging.INFO)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              current_time = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
              logger.info("Current UTC time: %s", current_time)
              return {
                  "statusCode": 200,
                  "body": json.dumps({"utc_time": current_time})
              }

    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'time-logger-schedule-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: 'Triggers the time logger Lambda function every 5 minutes.'
      ScheduleExpression: 'rate(5 minutes)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: TimeLoggerFunctionTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn

  LambdaInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref TimeLoggerFunction
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt TimeLoggerScheduleRule.Arn

    Description: ARN of the time logger Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt TimeLoggerFunction.Arn

    Description: ARN of the CloudWatch Events schedule rule.
    Value: !GetAtt TimeLoggerScheduleRule.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Creates a custom SSM Command document and association to collect inventory
  of database and caching processes on Linux and Windows EC2 instances.

Parameters:
  LinuxProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "CassandraDaemon,dse cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: Comma-separated list of Linux process names to inventory.
  WindowsProcessKeywords:
    Type: String
    Default: "sqlservr,cassandra,mysql,postgres,redis-server,redis-sentinel,memcached"
    Description: Comma-separated list of Windows process names to inventory.
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: "rate(30 days)"
    Description: Schedule expression for the SSM association.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "Production"
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: "CustomInventory"
    Description: Application tag value.

Resources:
  CustomInventoryDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: Custom-Inventory-Processes-Document
      DocumentType: Command
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
      Content:
        schemaVersion: "2.2"
        description: Custom inventory collection of database and caching processes.
        parameters:
          LinuxKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated Linux process keywords.
            default: ""
          WindowsKeywords:
            type: String
            description: Comma-separated Windows process keywords.
            default: ""
        mainSteps:
          - action: aws:runShellScript
            name: CollectLinuxProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Linux
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  #!/bin/bash
                  set -u
                  KEYWORDS="{{ LinuxKeywords }}"
                  TOKEN=$(curl -s -X PUT "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds: 21600")
                  INSTANCE_ID=$(curl -s -H "X-aws-ec2-metadata-token: $TOKEN" http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id)
                  INVENTORY_DIR="/etc/Amazon/CloudWatch"
                  INVENTORY_FILE="${INVENTORY_DIR}/CustomInventoryProcesses.json"
                  mkdir -p "${INVENTORY_DIR}"
                  TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
                  RESULTS=""
                  IFS=',' read -ra KW_ARRAY <<< "$KEYWORDS"
                  for KW in "${KW_ARRAY[@]}"; do
                    KW_TRIMMED=$(echo "$KW" | xargs)
                    if [ -n "$KW_TRIMMED" ]; then
                      PIDS=$(pgrep -f "$KW_TRIMMED" 2>/dev/null || true)
                      for PID in $PIDS; do
                        PROC_NAME=$(ps -p "$PID" -o comm= 2>/dev/null || true)
                        if [ -n "$PROC_NAME" ]; then
                          if [ -n "$RESULTS" ]; then
                            RESULTS="${RESULTS},"
                          fi
                          RESULTS="${RESULTS}{\"processName\":\"${PROC_NAME}\",\"pid\":\"${PID}\",\"keyword\":\"${KW_TRIMMED}\"}"
                        fi
                      done
                    fi
                  done
                  cat > "${INVENTORY_FILE}" <<EOF
                  {
                    "schemaVersion": "1.0",
                    "instanceId": "${INSTANCE_ID}",
                    "captureTime": "${TIMESTAMP}",
                    "inventoryType": "Custom:DatabaseCachingProcesses",
                    "items": [${RESULTS}]
                  }
                  EOF
                  exit 0
          - action: aws:runPowerShellScript
            name: CollectWindowsProcesses
            precondition:
              StringEquals:
                - platformType
                - Windows
            inputs:
              runCommand:
                - |
                  $ErrorActionPreference = "SilentlyContinue"
                  $Keywords = "{{ WindowsKeywords }}"
                  $Token = (Invoke-RestMethod -Method PUT -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/api/token" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token-ttl-seconds"="21600"})
                  $InstanceId = (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/instance-id" -Headers @{"X-aws-ec2-metadata-token"=$Token})
                  $InventoryDir = "C:\ProgramData\Amazon\SSM"
                  $InventoryFile = Join-Path $InventoryDir "CustomInventoryProcesses.json"
                  if (-not (Test-Path $InventoryDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $InventoryDir -Force | Out-Null }
                  $Timestamp = (Get-Date).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ")
                  $Results = @()
                  $Keywords.Split(",") | ForEach-Object {
                    $Keyword = $_.Trim()
                    if ($Keyword -ne "") {
                      Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -like "*$Keyword*" } | ForEach-Object {
                        $Results += @{
                          processName = $_.ProcessName
                          pid         = $_.Id
                          keyword     = $Keyword
                        }
                      }
                    }
                  }
                  $Inventory = [ordered]@{
                    schemaVersion  = "1.0"
                    instanceId     = $InstanceId
                    captureTime    = $Timestamp
                    inventoryType  = "Custom:DatabaseCachingProcesses"
                    items          = $Results
                  }
                  $Inventory | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content -Path $InventoryFile -Force
                  exit 0

  CustomInventoryAssociation:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Association
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
      AssociationName: Custom-Inventory-Processes
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      Targets:
        - Key: InstanceIds
          Values:
            - "*"
      Parameters:
        LinuxKeywords:
          - !Ref LinuxProcessKeywords
        WindowsKeywords:
          - !Ref WindowsProcessKeywords

Outputs:
  DocumentName:
    Description: Name of the custom SSM inventory document.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryDocument
  AssociationId:
    Description: ID of the SSM association.
    Value: !Ref CustomInventoryAssociation

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'AppMesh colorteller demo. Note: AWS App Mesh is scheduled for shutdown on 2026-09-30.'
Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  AttachGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: AttachGateway
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  Subnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  SubnetRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref Subnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  CloudMapNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC

  Mesh:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Mesh
    Properties:
      MeshName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mesh'

  ColorGateway:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualGateway
    Properties:
      VirtualGatewayName: colorgateway
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorgateway

  ColorGatewayNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn: CloudMapNamespace
    Properties:
      VirtualNodeName: colorgateway-node
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorgateway
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorgateway-node

  ColorTellerVirtualRouter:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualRouter
    Properties:
      VirtualRouterName: colorteller-router
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorteller-router

  ColorTellerVirtualService:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualService
    Properties:
      VirtualServiceName: colorteller
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Provider:
          VirtualRouter:
            VirtualRouterName: !GetAtt ColorTellerVirtualRouter.VirtualRouterName
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorteller

  ColorTellerBlueNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn: CloudMapNamespace
    Properties:
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-blue-node
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorteller-blue-node

  ColorTellerGreenNode:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::VirtualNode
    DependsOn: CloudMapNamespace
    Properties:
      VirtualNodeName: colorteller-green-node
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      Spec:
        Listeners:
          - PortMapping:
              Port: 9080
              Protocol: http
            HealthCheck:
              Protocol: http
              Path: /ping
              HealthyThreshold: 2
              UnhealthyThreshold: 2
              TimeoutMillis: 2000
              IntervalMillis: 5000
        ServiceDiscovery:
          AWSCloudMap:
            NamespaceName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}.local'
            ServiceName: colorteller
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: colorteller-green-node

  ColorTellerRoute:
    Type: AWS::AppMesh::Route
    Properties:
      RouteName: colorteller-route
      MeshName: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
      MeshOwner: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshOwner
      VirtualRouterName: !GetAtt ColorTellerVirtualRouter.VirtualRouterName
      Spec:
        HttpRoute:
          Action:
            WeightedTargets:
              - VirtualNode: !GetAtt ColorTellerBlueNode.VirtualNodeName
                Weight: 50
              - VirtualNode: !GetAtt ColorTellerGreenNode.VirtualNodeName
                Weight: 50
          Match:
            Prefix: /

Outputs:
  MeshName:
    Value: !GetAtt Mesh.MeshName
  MeshArn:
    Value: !GetAtt Mesh.Arn
  ColorGatewayArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ColorGateway.Arn
  VirtualRouterArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ColorTellerVirtualRouter.Arn
  NamespaceId:
    Value: !Ref CloudMapNamespace
  VpcId:
    Value: !Ref VPC
  SubnetId:
    Value: !Ref Subnet
