Description: >
  Private S3 buckets for a data processing pipeline: source, target, and an
  optional EMR log bucket with lifecycle rules, TLS-only bucket policies,
  versioning, and SSE-KMS encryption using a customer managed key.

Parameters:
  CreateEmrLogBucket:
    Type: String
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"
    Description: Whether to create the optional EMR log bucket.

Conditions:
  ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket: !Equals [!Ref CreateEmrLogBucket, "true"]

Resources:
  PipelineKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for pipeline S3 bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3UseViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"

  PipelineKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/pipeline-${AWS::StackName}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref PipelineKmsKey

  SourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "pipeline-source-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: PipelineLifecycle
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
              - TransitionInDays: 180
                StorageClass: GLACIER
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  TargetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "pipeline-target-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: PipelineLifecycle
            Status: Disabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
              - TransitionInDays: 180
                StorageClass: GLACIER
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  EmrLogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "pipeline-emr-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: PipelineLifecycle
            Status: Enabled
            Transitions:
              - TransitionInDays: 90
                StorageClass: STANDARD_IA
              - TransitionInDays: 180
                StorageClass: GLACIER
            ExpirationInDays: 2555

  SourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref SourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSAndOwnerAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt SourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${SourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  TargetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TargetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSAndOwnerAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt TargetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${TargetBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  EmrLogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref EmrLogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSAndOwnerAccess
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${EmrLogBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

Outputs:
  SourceBucketName:
    Description: Name of the source bucket.
    Value: !Ref SourceBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SourceBucketName"

  TargetBucketName:
    Description: Name of the target bucket.
    Value: !Ref TargetBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-TargetBucketName"

  EmrLogBucketName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Description: Name of the EMR log bucket.
    Value: !Ref EmrLogBucket
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketName"

  EmrLogBucketDnsName:
    Condition: ShouldCreateEmrLogBucket
    Description: DNS name of the EMR log bucket.
    Value: !GetAtt EmrLogBucket.DomainName
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-EmrLogBucketDnsName"

Description: >
  Automatically disables IMDSv1 on EC2 instances when they enter the running state
  by invoking the AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata SSM automation document via EventBridge.

Parameters:
  HttpPutResponseHopLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 64
    Description: HTTP PUT response hop limit to enforce on EC2 instance metadata options.

Resources:
  EventBridgeStartAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "eventbridge-start-ssm-automation-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartSSMAutomationExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$LATEST"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DisableIMDSv1

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "ssm-automation-configure-metadata-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConfigureEC2Metadata
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Deny
                Action: ec2:ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*"
                Condition:
                  StringNotEquals:
                    aws:RequestedRegion: !Ref AWS::Region
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DisableIMDSv1

  EC2RunningStateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "ec2-running-disable-imdsv1-${AWS::Region}"
      Description: Trigger AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata automation when an EC2 instance enters the running state.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.ec2
        detail-type:
          - EC2 Instance State-change Notification
        detail:
          state:
            - running
      Targets:
        - Id: ConfigureEC2MetadataTarget
          Arn: !Sub "arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}::automation-definition/AWSSupport-ConfigureEC2Metadata:$LATEST"
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeStartAutomationRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              instanceId: "$.detail.instance-id"
            InputTemplate: !Sub >-
              {
                "InstanceId": [<instanceId>],
                "AutomationAssumeRole": ["${AutomationExecutionRole.Arn}"],
                "HttpPutResponseHopLimit": [${HttpPutResponseHopLimit}]
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: DisableIMDSv1

Outputs:
  EventBridgeRuleArn:
    Description: ARN of the EventBridge rule that triggers on EC2 running state.
    Value: !GetAtt EC2RunningStateRule.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role used by the SSM automation execution.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  AppSync GraphQL API (AWS_IAM auth) with an EventBridge data source that puts
  events onto a custom event bus. Fully self-contained; no external resources.

Resources:
  NoteEventBus:
    Type: AWS::Events::EventBus
    Properties:
      Name: AppSyncNoteBus

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AppSyncPutEventsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: events:PutEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt NoteEventBus.Arn

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: NoteApi
      AuthenticationType: AWS_IAM
      XrayEnabled: false

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Note {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
        }

        input NoteInput {
          NoteId: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
        }

        type Query {
          getNote(NoteId: ID!): Note
        }

        type Mutation {
          saveNote(note: NoteInput!): Note
        }

        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
        }

  EventBridgeDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: NoteEventBridgeDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_EVENTBRIDGE
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      EventBridgeConfig:
        EventBusArn: !GetAtt NoteEventBus.Arn

  SaveNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Mutation
      FieldName: saveNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: !Sub |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "source": "com.example.notes",
              "detailType": "NoteSaved",
              "detail": $util.toJson($ctx.args.note),
              "resources": ["arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/AppSyncNoteBus"]
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #else
          $util.toJson($ctx.args.note)
        #end

  # NOTE: There is no backing data store (e.g. DynamoDB) defined in this
  # template, so getNote cannot retrieve persisted notes. This resolver uses
  # the EventBridge data source to emit a NoteRetrieved event and returns a
  # static placeholder response. Replace with a real data source if
  # persistence is required.
  GetNoteResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: getNote
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt EventBridgeDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: !Sub |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutEvents",
          "events": [
            {
              "source": "com.example.notes",
              "detailType": "NoteRetrieved",
              "detail": $util.toJson({"NoteId": $ctx.args.NoteId}),
              "resources": ["arn:aws:events:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/AppSyncNoteBus"]
            }
          ]
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #else
          $util.toJson({
            "NoteId": $ctx.args.NoteId,
            "title": "Placeholder title",
            "content": "Placeholder content - no backing store configured"
          })
        #end

Outputs:
  GraphQLApiId:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL API ID
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
  GraphQLEndpoint:
    Description: AppSync GraphQL endpoint URL
    Value: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.GraphQLUrl
  EventBusArn:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Parameters:
  ScheduleExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: rate(1 hour)
    Description: Schedule expression for the cleanup rule. Pass an empty string to disable scheduling.

Conditions:
  HasSchedule: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ScheduleExpression, '']]

Resources:
  ThrottleTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: throttle
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: pk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: pk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCleanupPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:BatchWriteItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ThrottleTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn

  LambdaLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      RetentionInDays: 30

  DynamoDBCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3
          from decimal import Decimal

          TABLE_NAME = os.environ['TABLE_NAME']
          dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
          table = dynamodb.Table(TABLE_NAME)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              now = int(time.time())
              deleted_total = 0
              last_evaluated_key = None

              while True:
                  scan_kwargs = {
                      'FilterExpression': '#sk < :now',
                      'ExpressionAttributeNames': {'#sk': 'sk'},
                      'ExpressionAttributeValues': {':now': Decimal(now)},
                      'ProjectionExpression': 'pk, sk'
                  }
                  if last_evaluated_key:
                      scan_kwargs['ExclusiveStartKey'] = last_evaluated_key

                  response = table.scan(**scan_kwargs)
                  items = response.get('Items', [])

                  for i in range(0, len(items), 25):
                      batch = items[i:i + 25]
                      request_items = {
                          TABLE_NAME: [
                              {'DeleteRequest': {'Key': {'pk': item['pk'], 'sk': item['sk']}}}
                              for item in batch
                          ]
                      }
                      unprocessed = request_items
                      while unprocessed:
                          resp = dynamodb.batch_write_item(RequestItems=unprocessed)
                          unprocessed = resp.get('UnprocessedItems', {})
                          if unprocessed:
                              time.sleep(0.5)
                      deleted_total += len(batch)

                  last_evaluated_key = response.get('LastEvaluatedKey')
                  if not last_evaluated_key:
                      break

              print(f'Deleted {deleted_total} expired items from {TABLE_NAME}')
              return {'deleted': deleted_total}
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref ThrottleTable

  CleanupScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      Name: DynamoDBCleanupSchedule
      ScheduleExpression: !Ref ScheduleExpression
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: DynamoDBCleanupTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn
          RetryPolicy:
            MaximumRetryAttempts: 2
            MaximumEventAgeInSeconds: 3600

    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Condition: HasSchedule
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DynamoDBCleanupFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: events.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt CleanupScheduleRule.Arn

    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBCleanupFunction.Arn

Description: >

  One pool backs a Lambda-oriented unauthenticated role (also usable as a Lambda

        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CognitoUnauthenticatedFederation
            Effect: Allow

            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  PCI compliance remediation prerequisites: an IAM role (pciautomationassumerole-<region>)
  trusted by SSM, EC2, and Events, plus four SSM Automation documents for Config
  remediation: restrict default SG traffic, delete unused SGs, release unassociated
  EIPs, set ASG health check to ELB/300s. NOTE: Document 4 execution requires
  autoscaling:UpdateAutoScalingGroup, intentionally not in the EC2-only role policy;
  extend the policy before running it. The invoking principal (e.g., Config remediation
  caller) must hold iam:PassRole on the PCI role because documents use document-level
  assumeRole.

Resources:
  PciAutomationAssumeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pciautomationassumerole-${AWS::Region}'
      Description: >
        Assumed by SSM Automation, EC2, and Events to perform PCI compliance
        remediation actions (security group cleanup and Elastic IP release).
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowSsmEc2AndEventsToAssume
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ssm.amazonaws.com
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub 'pciautomation-ec2-remediation-${AWS::Region}'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: MinimumEc2RemediationActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:ReleaseAddress
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DeleteSecurityGroup
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
                  - ec2:RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
                Resource: '*'

  PciRestrictDefaultSecurityGroupDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-restrict-default-security-group-traffic
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Revokes all ingress and egress rules on the VPC default security group(s).
          If SecurityGroupId is not provided, all security groups named "default"
          (optionally filtered by VpcId) are enumerated and fully restricted.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: Optional specific default security group ID to restrict. If empty, all default security groups are restricted.
            default: ''
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: Optional VPC ID used to scope the default security group lookup when SecurityGroupId is empty.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
                VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def _revoke(ec2, group_id, permissions, egress):
                    if not permissions:
                        return
                    if egress:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_egress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=permissions)
                    else:
                        ec2.revoke_security_group_ingress(
                            GroupId=group_id, IpPermissions=permissions)


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    group_id = events.get('SecurityGroupId') or ''
                    vpc_id = events.get('VpcId') or ''

                    if group_id:
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            GroupIds=[group_id])['SecurityGroups']
                    else:
                        filters = [{'Name': 'group-name', 'Values': ['default']}]
                        if vpc_id:
                            filters.append({'Name': 'vpc-id', 'Values': [vpc_id]})
                        groups = ec2.describe_security_groups(
                            Filters=filters)['SecurityGroups']

                    restricted = []
                    for group in groups:
                        gid = group['GroupId']
                        _revoke(ec2, gid, group.get('IpPermissions', []), False)
                        _revoke(ec2, gid, group.get('IpPermissionsEgress', []), True)
                        restricted.append(gid)

                    return {'RestrictedSecurityGroups': restricted}

  PciDeleteUnusedSecurityGroupsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-delete-unused-security-groups
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Deletes security groups that are not attached to any network interface
          (ENI) and are not referenced by any other security group's rules.
          Default security groups are always skipped.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteUnusedSecurityGroups
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload: {}
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    security_groups = ec2.describe_security_groups()['SecurityGroups']

                    attached_group_ids = set()
                    paginator = ec2.get_paginator('describe_network_interfaces')
                    for page in paginator.paginate():
                        for eni in page.get('NetworkInterfaces', []):
                            for group in eni.get('Groups', []):
                                attached_group_ids.add(group['GroupId'])

                    referenced_group_ids = set()
                    for sg in security_groups:
                        permissions = (
                            sg.get('IpPermissions', [])
                            + sg.get('IpPermissionsEgress', [])
                        )
                        for permission in permissions:
                            for ref in permission.get('UserIdGroupPairs', []):
                                referenced_group_ids.add(ref['GroupId'])

                    deleted = []
                    skipped = []
                    for sg in security_groups:
                        gid = sg['GroupId']
                        name = sg['GroupName']
                        if name == 'default':
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid, 'Reason': 'default security group'})
                            continue
                        if gid in attached_group_ids:
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid, 'Reason': 'attached to an ENI'})
                            continue
                        if gid in referenced_group_ids:
                            skipped.append(
                                {'GroupId': gid,
                                 'Reason': 'referenced by another security group'})
                            continue
                        ec2.delete_security_group(GroupId=gid)
                        deleted.append(gid)

                    return {'DeletedSecurityGroups': deleted, 'Skipped': skipped}

    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      Name: pci-release-unassociated-elastic-ips
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: >-
          Releases unassociated Elastic IP addresses using their AllocationId.
          Addresses with an AssociationId or InstanceId are never released.
          If AllocationId is provided, only that address is evaluated.
        assumeRole: '{{ AssumeRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          AssumeRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the PCI automation role assumed by SSM Automation for the remediation.
            default: 'arn:aws:iam::{{global:ACCOUNT_ID}}:role/pciautomationassumerole-{{global:REGION}}'
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Optional specific EIP AllocationId (eipalloc-*) to evaluate and release if unassociated. If empty, all unassociated EIPs are released.
            default: ''
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseUnassociatedElasticIps
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3


                def script_handler(events, context):
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')

                    target_allocation_id = events.get('AllocationId') or ''
                    addresses = ec2.describe_addresses().get('Addresses', [])

                    released = []
                    skipped = []
                    for address in addresses:
                        allocation_id = address.get('AllocationId')
                        if target_allocation_id and allocation_id != target_allocation_id:
                            continue
                        if address.get('AssociationId') or address.get('InstanceId'):
                            skipped.append({
                                'AllocationId': allocation_id,
                                'Reason': 'associated with an instance or ENI'})
                            continue
                        if allocation_id:
                            ec2.release_address(AllocationId=allocation_id)
                            released.append(allocation_id)
                        elif address.get('PublicIp'):
                            ec2.release_address(PublicIp=address['PublicIp'])
                            released.append(address['PublicIp'])

          HealthCheckGracePeriod of 300 seconds.

                    autoscaling.update_auto_scaling_group(
                        AutoScalingGroupName=asg_name,
                        HealthCheckType='ELB',
                        HealthCheckGracePeriod=300)

                    return {

                        'HealthCheckType': 'ELB',
                        'HealthCheckGracePeriod': 300
                    }

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Mirrors three existing CodeCommit repositories (card-service, rule-service,
  ecs-pipeline) from the current region to a target replica region using a
  CodeBuild project triggered by EventBridge rules on pushes to the 'mainline' branch.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    Description: Target region to which the source repositories will be mirrored.

Resources:
  CodeBuildMirrorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: codebuild.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-build-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CodeBuildLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/codebuild/*'
              - Sid: CodeCommitSourceAndReplicaAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - codecommit:GitPull
                  - codecommit:GitPush
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${TargetRegion}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'

  EventBridgeInvokeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-events-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-events-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: StartMirrorBuild
                Effect: Allow
                Action: codebuild:StartBuild
                Resource: !GetAtt MirrorProject.Arn

  MirrorProject:
    Type: AWS::CodeBuild::Project
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mirror-project'
      Description: Mirrors card-service, rule-service, and ecs-pipeline to the target replica region.
      ServiceRole: !GetAtt CodeBuildMirrorRole.Arn
      EncryptionKey: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:kms:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alias/aws/s3'
      Source:
        Type: NO_SOURCE
        BuildSpec: |
          version: 0.2
          phases:
            install:
              commands:
                - pip install git-remote-codecommit
            build:
              commands:
                - |
                  for REPO in card-service rule-service ecs-pipeline; do
                    echo "Mirroring ${REPO} from ${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION} to ${TARGET_REGION}"
                    git clone --mirror "codecommit::${AWS_DEFAULT_REGION}://${REPO}" "${REPO}.git"
                    cd "${REPO}.git"
                    git remote add replica "codecommit::${TARGET_REGION}://${REPO}"
                    git push replica --all
                    git push replica --tags
                    cd ..
                  done
      Environment:
        Type: LINUX_CONTAINER
        Image: aws/codebuild/standard:7.0
        ComputeType: BUILD_GENERAL1_SMALL
        ImagePullCredentialsType: CODEBUILD
        EnvironmentVariables:
          - Name: TARGET_REGION
            Type: PLAINTEXT
            Value: !Ref TargetRegion
      Artifacts:
        Type: NO_ARTIFACTS

  CardServiceMainlineRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mainline-card-service-rule'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:card-service'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-card-service-mirror-target'
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

  RuleServiceMainlineRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mainline-rule-service-rule'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.codecommit
        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:rule-service'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rule-service-mirror-target'
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

  EcsPipelineMainlineRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-mainline-ecs-pipeline-rule'
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:

        detail-type:
          - CodeCommit Repository State Change
        resources:
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:codecommit:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:ecs-pipeline'
        detail:
          event:
            - referenceCreated
            - referenceUpdated
          referenceType:
            - branch
          referenceName:
            - mainline
      Targets:
        - Id: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ecs-pipeline-mirror-target'
          Arn: !GetAtt MirrorProject.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeInvokeRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Secure S3 infrastructure with replication and access logging

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: testanu
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$"
    Description: Application name used for bucket and resource naming

Resources:
  S3KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for ${ApplicationName} S3 buckets"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowS3ServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub "s3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  PrimaryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref LogBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub "${ApplicationName}/primary-access-logs/"
      ReplicationConfiguration:
        Role: !GetAtt ReplicationRole.Arn
        Rules:
          - Id: ReplicateAll
            Status: Enabled
            Destination:
              Bucket: !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn

  LogBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-logs-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: AES256
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  ReplicaBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt S3KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  PrimaryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PrimaryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${PrimaryBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  LogBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref LogBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingDelivery

    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy

      Bucket: !Ref ReplicaBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowS3LoggingDelivery
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ReplicaBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ReplicaBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !GetAtt PrimaryBucket.Arn

  ReplicationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-s3-replication-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

                Action:
                  - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionForReplication
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionAcl
                  - s3:GetObjectVersionTagging
                  - s3:ObjectOwnerOverrideToBucketOwner
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ApplicationName}-primary-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"

                  - s3:ReplicateDelete
                  - s3:ReplicateTags
                  - s3:ObjectOwnerOverrideToBucketOwner
                Resource:
                  - !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::${ApplicationName}-replica-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*"
              - Sid: KmsPermissions

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Route53 hosted zone and DNS records for the Ear Hustle production
  environment (Squarespace, G Suite email, ZenDesk, Campaign Monitor,
  Supercast). DNS-only: the ACM certificate for the feeds subdomain is
  intentionally deferred to a follow-up stack after NS delegation.

Parameters:
  DomainName:
    Type: String
    Default: earhustlesq.com
    Description: Root domain for the hosted zone (dot-less; the template appends the trailing dot).
  OldSubdomain:
    Type: String
    Default: mail.earhustlesq.com.
    Description: >
      Legacy subdomain that also receives G Suite MX records. Must be a
      fully-qualified domain name ending with a trailing dot (Route53
      rejects malformed names, e.g. a double dot).
  SquarespaceIP1:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.144
  SquarespaceIP2:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.185.159.145
  SquarespaceIP3:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.49.23.144
  SquarespaceIP4:
    Type: String
    Default: 198.49.23.145
  SquarespaceVerifyTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Squarespace domain verification code published as a TXT record at the
      apex (CNAME is not permitted at the apex in Route53). PLACEHOLDER
      default — replace with the code Squarespace issues, and confirm the
      record type/name matches what Squarespace actually provides.
  GoogleSiteVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google site verification token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real token obtained from Google Search Console / Google Workspace
      before production use.
  ZoomVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Zoom domain verification token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real token obtained from Zoom before production use.
  ATProtoVerification:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      ATProto (Bluesky) domain verification token. PLACEHOLDER default —
      replace with the real token obtained from Bluesky before production use.
  SPFRecord:
    Type: String
    Default: v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com include:mail.zendesk.com include:cmail1.com ~all
  DMARCValue:
    Type: String
    Default: v=DMARC1; p=quarantine; rua=mailto:dmarc@earhustlesq.com; pct=100
  ZendeskVerificationTXT:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      ZenDesk account verification TXT token. PLACEHOLDER default — replace
      with the real token obtained from ZenDesk before production use.
  ZendeskValidationCNAME:
    Type: String
    Default: support.zendesk.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk domain validation target hostname (fully-qualified, trailing
      dot required by Route53). Must be an external ZenDesk hostname, never
      the record name itself (a self-referential target creates a CNAME loop
      that Route53 rejects).
  CampaignMonitorSPFValue:
    Type: String
    Default: v=spf2.0/pra include:cmail1.com ~all
  GoogleDKIMPart1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google Workspace DKIM public key, first quoted fragment (must be <=255
      characters). PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the first fragment of
      the key generated in the Google Workspace admin console.
  GoogleDKIMPart2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-TXT-TOKEN
    Description: >
      Google Workspace DKIM public key, second quoted fragment (must be
      <=255 characters). PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the second
      fragment of the real key; if the key fits in a single fragment, the
      first fragment must be re-split so that both fragments are non-empty
      (Route53 does not accept empty TXT character-strings).
  SupercastDKIMTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Supercast DKIM target hostname. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target provided by Supercast before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  SupercastReturnPathTarget:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Supercast return-path CNAME target. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with
      the real target provided by Supercast before production use. Real
      values must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  ZenDeskDKIMTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target 1. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target obtained from ZenDesk before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  ZenDeskDKIMTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      ZenDesk DKIM CNAME target 2. PLACEHOLDER default — replace with the
      real target obtained from ZenDesk before production use. Real values
      must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget1:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Campaign Monitor DKIM CNAME target 1. PLACEHOLDER default — replace
      with the real target obtained from Campaign Monitor before production
      use. Real values must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget2:
    Type: String
    Default: PLACEHOLDER-CNAME-TARGET.example.com.
    Description: >
      Campaign Monitor DKIM CNAME target 2. PLACEHOLDER default — replace
      with the real target obtained from Campaign Monitor before production
      use. Real values must be fully-qualified hostnames ending with a dot.
  CampaignMonitorMXHost:
    Type: String
    Default: mail.cmail1.com.

Resources:
  HostedZone:
    Type: AWS::Route53::HostedZone
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      HostedZoneConfig:
        Comment: Ear Hustle production DNS zone
      HostedZoneTags:
        - Key: prx:ops:environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: prx:dev:application
          Value: Ear Hustle

  ApexTXTRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${SPFRecord}"'
        - !Sub '"${GoogleSiteVerification}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZoomVerification}"'
        - !Sub '"${ZendeskVerificationTXT}"'
        - !Sub '"${SquarespaceVerifyTXT}"'

  ATProtoVerificationRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_atproto.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${ATProtoVerification}"'

  DMARCTextRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '_dmarc.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${DMARCValue}"'

  GSuiteMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  LegacyMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Ref OldSubdomain
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - '1 aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt1.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '5 alt2.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt3.aspmx.l.google.com.'
        - '10 alt4.aspmx.l.google.com.'

  ApexARecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub '${DomainName}.'
      Type: A
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP1
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP2
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP3
        - !Ref SquarespaceIP4

  WWWCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'www.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-sq.squarespace.com.

  FeedsCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'feeds.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - ext-sq.squarespace.com.

  ZenDeskValidationCNAME:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'support.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZendeskValidationCNAME

  ZenDeskDKIMRecord1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskDKIMTarget1

  ZenDeskDKIMRecord2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'zendesk2._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref ZenDeskDKIMTarget2

  CampaignMonitorDKIMRecord1:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm1._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget1

  CampaignMonitorDKIMRecord2:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cm2._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref CampaignMonitorDKIMTarget2

  CampaignMonitorSPFRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'cmail.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${CampaignMonitorSPFValue}"'

  CampaignMonitorMXRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'reply.${DomainName}.'
      Type: MX
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '10 ${CampaignMonitorMXHost}'

  GoogleWorkspaceDKIM:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'google._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: TXT
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Sub '"${GoogleDKIMPart1}" "${GoogleDKIMPart2}"'

  SupercastDKIMRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'supercast._domainkey.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastDKIMTarget

  SupercastReturnPathRecord:
    Type: AWS::Route53::RecordSet
    Properties:
      HostedZoneId: !Ref HostedZone
      Name: !Sub 'supercast.${DomainName}.'
      Type: CNAME
      TTL: '3600'
      ResourceRecords:
        - !Ref SupercastReturnPathTarget

Outputs:
  HostedZoneId:
    Description: Route53 hosted zone ID (use in follow-up ACM certificate stack)
    Value: !Ref HostedZone
  HostedZoneNameServers:
    Description: >
      Route53 name servers for the hosted zone. Point the domain's registrar
      at these before requesting the ACM certificate in a follow-up stack.
    Value: !Join
      - ','
      - !GetAtt HostedZone.NameServers

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Aurora Global Database failover automation - SSM role, Lambda role, SSM Automation document, and TriggerFailover Lambda.

Resources:

  SsmAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraGlobalDbFailoverSsmRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AuroraFailoverSsmPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: RdsGlobalCluster
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rds:DescribeGlobalClusters
                  - rds:FailoverGlobalCluster
                  - rds:ModifyGlobalCluster
                  - rds:DescribeDBClusters
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ArcRoutingControl
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:GetRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlState
                  - route53-recovery-cluster:UpdateRoutingControlStates
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:DescribeCluster
                  - route53-recovery-control-config:ListRoutingControls
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: SecretsManager
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:PutSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                  - secretsmanager:UpdateSecret
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aurora-global-failover-*'
              - Sid: SsmAutomation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: AuroraGlobalDbFailoverLambdaRole
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: TriggerFailoverSsmPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SsmStartAndMonitor
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:DescribeAutomationExecutions
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: PassSsmAutomationRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SsmAutomationRole.Arn

  FailoverSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: aurora-global-failover-writer-endpoint
      Description: Updated at runtime by the Aurora Global Database failover SSM automation with the new writer endpoint.
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{"writerEndpoint": "not-set"}'
        GenerateStringKey: nonce
        PasswordLength: 16

  AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      Name: AuroraGlobalDatabaseFailoverSSMDocument
      DocumentType: Automation
      UpdateMethod: NewVersion
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Determines the active region via ARC routing controls, performs Aurora Global Database failover, then flips ARC routing control states and updates the writer endpoint secret.
        assumeRole: '{{ SsmAutomationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          PrimaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-east-1
            description: Primary region of the Aurora global database.
          SecondaryRegion:
            type: String
            default: us-west-2
            description: Secondary region of the Aurora global database.
          RoutingControlArnPrimary:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the ARC routing control representing the primary region.
          RoutingControlArnSecondary:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the ARC routing control representing the secondary region.
          GlobalClusterIdentifier:
            type: String
            description: Identifier of the Aurora global database cluster.
          SecretArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the Secrets Manager secret to update with the new writer endpoint.
          SsmAutomationRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: ARN of the IAM role assumed by this automation.
        mainSteps:
          - name: DetermineActiveRegion
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 300
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                RoutingControlArnPrimary: '{{ RoutingControlArnPrimary }}'
                RoutingControlArnSecondary: '{{ RoutingControlArnSecondary }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    primary = event['PrimaryRegion']
                    secondary = event['SecondaryRegion']
                    routing_controls = {
                        primary: event['RoutingControlArnPrimary'],
                        secondary: event['RoutingControlArnSecondary'],
                    }

                    active_region = None
                    for region, rc_arn in routing_controls.items():
                        if not rc_arn:
                            continue
                        client = boto3.client('route53-recovery-cluster', region_name=region)
                        state = client.get_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=rc_arn
                        )['RoutingControlState']
                        if state == 'On':
                            active_region = region
                            break

                    if active_region is None:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            'No routing control found in On state; cannot determine active region.'
                        )

                    failover_region = secondary if active_region == primary else primary
                    return {
                        'ActiveRegion': active_region,
                        'FailoverRegion': failover_region,
                        'ActiveRoutingControlArn': routing_controls[active_region],
                        'FailoverRoutingControlArn': routing_controls[failover_region],
                    }

              - Name: ActiveRegion
                Selector: $.ActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: FailoverRegion
                Selector: $.FailoverRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.ActiveRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
              - Name: FailoverRoutingControlArn
                Selector: $.FailoverRoutingControlArn
                Type: String
            nextStep: PerformGlobalFailover

          - name: PerformGlobalFailover
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                FailoverRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRegion }}'
                GlobalClusterIdentifier: '{{ GlobalClusterIdentifier }}'
              Script: |-
                import time
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    failover_region = event['FailoverRegion']
                    client = boto3.client('rds', region_name=failover_region)

                    clusters = client.describe_global_clusters(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                    )['GlobalClusters']

                    target_cluster_id = None
                    for gc in clusters:
                        for member in gc.get('GlobalClusterMembers', []):
                            if failover_region in member.get('DBClusterArn', ''):
                                target_cluster_id = member['DBClusterArn'].split(':')[-1]
                                break
                        if target_cluster_id:
                            break

                    if not target_cluster_id:
                        raise RuntimeError(
                            f'No regional cluster for {failover_region} found in global cluster '
                            f'{event["GlobalClusterIdentifier"]}.'
                        )

                    response = client.failover_global_cluster(
                        GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier'],
                        TargetDbClusterIdentifier=target_cluster_id,
                        AllowDataLoss=False
                    )

                    waiter_state = 'pending'
                    deadline = time.time() + 1800
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        gcs = client.describe_global_clusters(
                            GlobalClusterIdentifier=event['GlobalClusterIdentifier']
                        )['GlobalClusters']
                        statuses = []
                        for gc in gcs:
                            for member in gc.get('GlobalClusterMembers', []):
                                statuses.append(member.get('GlobalWriteForwardingStatus', ''))
                        if all(s in ('', 'available', 'optimizing') for s in statuses):
                            waiter_state = 'available'
                            break
                        time.sleep(30)

                    return {
                        'FailoverRegion': failover_region,
                        'TargetDbClusterIdentifier': target_cluster_id,
                        'FinalState': waiter_state
                    }

              - Name: FailoverRegion
                Selector: $.FailoverRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: TargetDbClusterIdentifier
                Selector: $.TargetDbClusterIdentifier
                Type: String
            nextStep: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret

          - name: FlipRoutingControlsAndUpdateSecret
            action: aws:executeScript
            timeoutSeconds: 600
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.11
              Handler: handler
              InputPayload:
                PrimaryRegion: '{{ PrimaryRegion }}'
                SecondaryRegion: '{{ SecondaryRegion }}'
                ActiveRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRegion }}'
                FailoverRegion: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRegion }}'
                ActiveRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.ActiveRoutingControlArn }}'
                FailoverRoutingControlArn: '{{ DetermineActiveRegion.FailoverRoutingControlArn }}'
                FailoverRegionClusterId: '{{ PerformGlobalFailover.TargetDbClusterIdentifier }}'
                SecretArn: '{{ SecretArn }}'
              Script: |-
                import time
                import boto3

                def handler(event, context):
                    active_rc = event['ActiveRoutingControlArn']
                    failover_rc = event['FailoverRoutingControlArn']

                    if active_rc and failover_rc:
                        rc_client = boto3.client(
                            'route53-recovery-cluster',
                            region_name=event['FailoverRegion']
                        )
                        rc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=active_rc,
                            RoutingControlState='Off'
                        )
                        rc_client.update_routing_control_state(
                            RoutingControlArn=failover_rc,
                            RoutingControlState='On'
                        )

                    rds = boto3.client('rds', region_name=event['FailoverRegion'])
                    writer_endpoint = None
                    deadline = time.time() + 900
                    while time.time() < deadline:
                        resp = rds.describe_db_clusters(
                            DBClusterIdentifier=event['FailoverRegionClusterId']
                        )
                        cluster = resp['DBClusters'][0]
                        writer_endpoint = cluster.get('Endpoint')
                        if writer_endpoint:
                            break
                        time.sleep(15)

                    if not writer_endpoint:
                        raise RuntimeError('Timed out waiting for writer endpoint after failover.')

                    secrets = boto3.client(
                        'secretsmanager',
                        region_name=event['FailoverRegion']
                    )
                    secrets.put_secret_value(
                        SecretId=event['SecretArn'],
                        SecretString='{{"writerEndpoint": "{}"}}'.format(writer_endpoint)
                    )

                    return {
                        'NewActiveRegion': event['FailoverRegion'],
                        'WriterEndpoint': writer_endpoint
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: NewActiveRegion
                Selector: $.NewActiveRegion
                Type: String
              - Name: WriterEndpoint
                Selector: $.WriterEndpoint
                Type: String

Description: >
  Self-contained template deploying an App Runner service for a multi-tenant
  QuickSight dashboard application. Creates an ECR repository, a task role
  with QuickSight and Directory Service permissions, and the App Runner
  service. TWO-PHASE PATTERN (CloudFormation cannot build images): Phase 1
  sources a public placeholder image (ECR Public) with auto-deployments off
  and NO custom health check (App Runner defaults are used so the placeholder
  can stabilize; the /status health check is restored in Phase 2). Phase 2
  (stack update): build and push the real image to the created repository
  with an immutable versioned tag, then stack-update the source to the
  private ECR repository (ImageIdentifier set to the repository URI with the
  chosen tag), ADD HealthCheckConfiguration (Path /status, Protocol HTTP,
  Port 8080), enable auto-deployments, add AuthenticationConfiguration, and
  create the AppRunnerAccessRole (ECR access role) in the same update since
  it is only required for private ECR pulls.

  DummyEmailPlaceholder:
    Type: String
    Default: dummy-email@example.com
    Description: Dummy email placeholder used for tenant user registration.

  AdminUserName:
    Type: String
    Default: qs-admin
    Description: Admin user name for the QuickSight integration.

  QuickSightTemplateId:
    Type: String
    Default: template-12345678
  QuickSightDataSetId:
    Type: String
    Default: dataset-12345678
  QuickSightDataSourceId:
    Type: String
    Default: datasource-12345678
  DatabaseId:
    Type: String
    Default: database-12345678
  TableId:
    Type: String
    Default: table-12345678
  FilterColumnId:
    Type: String
    Default: filter-column-12345678

Resources:
  EcrRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: quicksight-dashboard-app
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE

  AppRunnerTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: tasks.apprunner.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: QuickSightTenantProvisioning
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - quicksight:CreateNamespace
                  - quicksight:DeleteNamespace
                  - quicksight:DescribeNamespace
                  - quicksight:ListNamespaces
                  - quicksight:RegisterUser
                  - quicksight:DescribeUser
                  - quicksight:DeleteUser
                  - quicksight:ListUsers
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSet
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSet
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSet
                  - quicksight:UpdateDataSet
                  - quicksight:ListDataSets
                  - quicksight:DescribeTemplate
                  - quicksight:ListTemplates
                  - quicksight:CreateTemplate
                  - quicksight:CreateDashboard
                  - quicksight:DescribeDashboard
                  - quicksight:ListDashboards
                  - quicksight:GenerateEmbedUrlForRegisteredUser
                  - quicksight:CreateDataSource
                  - quicksight:DescribeDataSource
                  - quicksight:DeleteDataSource
                  - quicksight:PassDataSet
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ds:DescribeDirectories
                  - ds:DescribeTrusts
                  - ds:ListAuthorizedApplications
                Resource: '*'

  AppRunnerService:
    Type: AWS::AppRunner::Service
    Properties:
      InstanceConfiguration:
        Cpu: '1 vCPU'
        Memory: 2 GB
        InstanceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppRunnerTaskRole.Arn
      SourceConfiguration:
        AutoDeploymentsEnabled: false
        ImageRepository:
          ImageIdentifier: public.ecr.aws/aws-containers/hello-app-runner:latest
          ImageRepositoryType: ECR_PUBLIC
          ImageConfiguration:
            Port: '8080'
            RuntimeEnvironmentVariables:
              - Name: ALLOW_IP_RANGE
                Value: 0.0.0.0/0
              - Name: AWS_REGION
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              - Name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
                Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              - Name: DUMMY_EMAIL_PLACEHOLDER
                Value: !Ref DummyEmailPlaceholder
              - Name: ADMIN_USER_NAME
                Value: !Ref AdminUserName
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_TEMPLATE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightTemplateId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASET_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSetId
              - Name: QUICKSIGHT_DATASOURCE_ID
                Value: !Ref QuickSightDataSourceId
              - Name: DATABASE_ID
                Value: !Ref DatabaseId
              - Name: TABLE_ID
                Value: !Ref TableId
              - Name: FILTER_COLUMN_ID
                Value: !Ref FilterColumnId

Outputs:

    Description: >

      App Runner source to this repository (type ECR, auto-deployments on,
      add HealthCheckConfiguration with Path /status, Protocol HTTP, Port
      8080) and add the ECR access role (trust: build.apprunner.amazonaws.com;
      ECR GetAuthorizationToken, BatchGetImage, GetDownloadUrlForLayer and
      describe actions on this repository) in AuthenticationConfiguration.
    Value: !GetAtt EcrRepository.RepositoryUri

    Description: >

      and the /status health check activate only after the Phase 2 stack
      update switches the source to the private ECR repository.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AppRunnerService.ServiceUrl}'
