AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CIS-aligned VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) SSM Automation with direct and
  Change-Manager-approved remediation documents.

Resources:

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc-flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 400

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - ec2.amazonaws.com
                - delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: VpcFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DeleteFlowLogs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'

  AutomationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: SsmAutomationFlowLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:GetAutomationExecution
                  - ssm:SendAutomationSignal
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeFlowLogs
                  - ec2:CreateFlowLogs
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:ListDocumentVersions
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: '*'

  EnableFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: AutomationExecutionRole
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Name: !Sub 'enable-vpc-flow-logs-${AWS::StackName}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables VPC Flow Logs with REJECT traffic capture on the specified VPC.
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.'
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN that flow logs will assume to deliver logs.'
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'CloudWatch Logs log group for flow log delivery.'
        mainSteps:
          - name: VerifyVpcExists
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Confirm the target VPC exists before enabling flow logs.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcId
                Selector: '$.Vpcs[0].VpcId'
          - name: EnableVpcFlowLogs
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Create flow logs for the VPC capturing REJECT traffic.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: CreateFlowLogs
              ResourceIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
              ResourceType: VPC
              TrafficType: REJECT
              LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
              LogGroupName: '{{ LogGroupName }}'
              DeliverLogsPermissionArn: '{{ FlowLogsRoleArn }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: FlowLogIds
                Selector: '$.FlowLogs[0].FlowLogId'
          - name: VerifyFlowLogCreated
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: 'Verify the flow log exists on the VPC and captures REJECT traffic.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeFlowLogs
              PropertySelector: 'FlowLogs[0].TrafficType'
              DesiredValues:
                - REJECT
              Filters:
                - Name: resource-id
                  Values:
                    - '{{ VpcId }}'
        outputs:
          - Name: CreatedFlowLogIds
            Value: '{{ EnableVpcFlowLogs.FlowLogIds }}'
            Type: StringList
          - Name: VerifiedVpcId
            Value: '{{ VerifyVpcExists.VpcId }}'
            Type: String

  ChangeApprovedFlowLogsDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    DependsOn: EnableFlowLogsDocument
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: JSON
      Name: !Sub 'enable-vpc-flow-logs-change-approved-${AWS::StackName}'
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: 'Routes VPC flow log enablement through a formal approval gate (SSM Change Manager-compatible approval workflow) before executing remediation.'
        parameters:
          VpcId:
            type: String
            description: 'The ID of the VPC to enable flow logs on.'
          ApproverSnsTopicArn:
            type: String
            description: 'SNS topic ARN used to notify approvers for the change request.'
          FlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN that flow logs will assume (supplied at execution time).'
          LogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'Flow log CloudWatch Logs log group name (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectDocumentName:
            type: String
            description: 'Name of the direct flow-log enablement automation document to execute upon approval (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectFlowLogsRoleArn:
            type: String
            description: 'IAM role ARN passed to the direct automation (supplied at execution time).'
          DirectLogGroupName:
            type: String
            description: 'Log group name passed to the direct automation (supplied at execution time).'
        mainSteps:
          - name: ValidateChangeRequest
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            description: 'Record and validate the change request by confirming the target VPC exists (SSM Change Manager change template integration point).'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: VpcState
                Selector: '$.Vpcs[0].State'
          - name: ConfirmVpcAvailable
            action: aws:assertAwsResourceProperty
            description: 'Confirm the target VPC is available before requesting approval.'
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DescribeVpcs
              PropertySelector: 'Vpcs[0].State'
              DesiredValues:
                - available
              VpcIds:
                - '{{ VpcId }}'
          - name: WaitForApproval
            action: aws:approve
            description: 'Formal change approval gate - all real-world remediation requires approver sign-off.'
            timeoutSeconds: 86400
            inputs:
              Message: 'Change request: enable VPC Flow Logs (REJECT) on VPC {{ VpcId }} for CIS compliance remediation.'
              MinRequiredApprovals: 1
              Approvers:
                - '{{ ApproverSnsTopicArn }}'
          - name: ExecuteRemediation
            action: aws:executeAutomation
            description: 'Upon approval, run the direct flow-log enablement automation.'
            timeoutSeconds: 3600
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              DocumentName: '{{ DirectDocumentName }}'
              RunCommandParameters:
                DocumentParameters:
                  VpcId: '{{ VpcId }}'
                  FlowLogsRoleArn: '{{ DirectFlowLogsRoleArn }}'
                  LogGroupName: '{{ DirectLogGroupName }}'
        outputs:
          - Name: RemediationAutomationExecutionId
            Value: '{{ ExecuteRemediation.AutomationExecutionId }}'
            Type: String

Outputs:
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: CloudWatch Logs log group for VPC flow logs.
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup
  FlowLogsLogGroupArn:
    Description: ARN of the flow logs log group.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
  FlowLogsRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by VPC Flow Logs.
    Value: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
  AutomationExecutionRoleArn:
    Description: SSM Automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt AutomationExecutionRole.Arn
  DirectRemediationDocumentName:
    Description: Direct flow log enablement automation document.
    Value: !Ref EnableFlowLogsDocument
  ChangeApprovedRemediationDocumentName:
    Description: Change-manager-approved flow log enablement automation document.
    Value: !Ref ChangeApprovedFlowLogsDocument

    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:

                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaLogGroup.Arn

  ReusableDelegationSetFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: LambdaLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref LambdaFunctionName
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import urllib.request
          import json

          r53 = boto3.client('route53')

          def send_response(event, context, status, data=None, reason=None):
              body = json.dumps({
                  'Status': status,
                  'Reason': reason or '',
                  'PhysicalResourceId': event.get('PhysicalResourceId', context.log_stream_name),
                  'StackId': event['StackId'],
                  'RequestId': event['RequestId'],
                  'LogicalResourceId': event['LogicalResourceId'],
                  'Data': data or {}
              }).encode()
              req = urllib.request.Request(event['ResponseURL'], data=body,
                                           headers={'Content-Type': '', 'Content-Length': str(len(body))})
              req.get_method = lambda: 'PUT'
              try:
                  urllib.request.urlopen(req)
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Failed to send response:', e)

          def build_data(ds):
              ns = sorted(ds['NameServers'])
              data = {'DelegationSetId': ds['Id']}
              for i, name in enumerate(ns, start=1):
                  data[f'NameServer{i}Name'] = name
                  data[f'NameServer{i}IPv4'] = ds['NameServersWithIPs'].get_ipv4(name)
                  data[f'NameServer{i}IPv6'] = ds['NameServersWithIPs'].get_ipv6(name)
              return data

          class _IPs:
              def __init__(self, records):
                  self._records = records

              def get_ipv4(self, name):
                  for r in self._records:
                      if r['name'] == name:
                          return r.get('ipv4', '')
                  return ''

              def get_ipv6(self, name):
                  for r in self._records:
                      if r['name'] == name:
                          return r.get('ipv6', '')
                  return ''

          def resolve_ips(names):
              # Resolve nameserver IPv4/IPv6 addresses from public DNS via Route53 answer data
              import socket
              records = []
              for name in names:
                  try:
                      ipv4 = sorted(set(i[4][0] for i in socket.getaddrinfo(name, None, socket.AF_INET)))
                      ipv6 = sorted(set(i[4][0] for i in socket.getaddrinfo(name, None, socket.AF_INET6)))
                  except Exception:
                      ipv4, ipv6 = [], []
                  records.append({'name': name, 'ipv4': ipv4[0] if ipv4 else '', 'ipv6': ipv6[0] if ipv6 else ''})
              return records

          def handler(event, context):
              request_type = event['RequestType']
              try:
                  if request_type == 'Create':
                      resp = r53.create_reusable_delegation_set(CallerReference=event['RequestId'])
                      ds_id = resp['DelegationSet']['Id']
                      names = sorted(resp['DelegationSet']['NameServers'])
                      ips = resolve_ips(names)
                      ds = {
                          'Id': ds_id,
                          'NameServers': names,
                          'NameServersWithIPs': _IPs(ips)
                      }
                      data = build_data(ds)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data)
                  elif request_type == 'Update':
                      # Delegation set ID is immutable; retrieve existing set and refresh IP data
                      old_props = event.get('OldResourceProperties', {})
                      ds_id = old_props.get('DelegationSetId', event.get('PhysicalResourceId', ''))
                      resp = r53.get_reusable_delegation_set(Id=ds_id)
                      ds = resp['DelegationSet']
                      names = sorted(ds['NameServers'])
                      ips = resolve_ips(names)
                      ds_full = {
                          'Id': ds['Id'],
                          'NameServers': names,
                          'NameServersWithIPs': _IPs(ips)
                      }
                      data = build_data(ds_full)
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS', data)
                  elif request_type == 'Delete':
                      ds_id = event.get('PhysicalResourceId', '')
                      if ds_id.startswith('/hostedzone/'):
                          try:
                              r53.delete_reusable_delegation_set(Id=ds_id)
                          except r53.exceptions.NoSuchDelegationSet:
                              pass
                      send_response(event, context, 'SUCCESS')
              except Exception as e:
                  print('Error:', e)
                  send_response(event, context, 'FAILED', reason=str(e))

  DelegationSetCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ReusableDelegationSetFunction.Arn

        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayStartExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: !Ref StateMachine

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachinePostToConnection

            "StartAt": "Wait5Seconds",
            "States": {
              "Wait5Seconds": {
                "Type": "Wait",
                "Seconds": 5,
                "Next": "PostToConnection"
              },
              "PostToConnection": {
                "Type": "Task",
                "Resource": "arn:aws:states:::http:invoke",
                "Parameters": {
                  "ApiEndpoint.$": "States.Format('https://${ApiId}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${Stage}/@connections/{}', $.connectionId)",

    DependsOn:

      - DefaultRouteIntegrationResponse
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi

  Stage:

    Properties:

  StateMachineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Step Functions state machine.
    Value: !Ref StateMachine

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Cost management stack: monthly AWS cost budget with notifications at 80% and
  99% of budget via an SNS topic encrypted with a customer-managed KMS key.

Parameters:
  BudgetLimit:
    Type: Number
    Default: 100
    Description: Monthly cost budget limit in USD.
    MinValue: 1

  NotificationMethod:
    Type: String
    Default: sms
    AllowedValues:
      - sms
      - email
    Description: Notification delivery method (SNS protocol) for budget alerts.

  NotificationEndpoint:
    Type: String
    Default: '+61400000000'
    Description: >
      Notification endpoint. For SMS, an E.164 phone number (e.g. +61...).
      For email, a valid email address. Email subscriptions require manual
      confirmation from the endpoint before alerts are delivered.

Conditions:
  IsEmail: !Equals [!Ref NotificationMethod, 'email']
  IsSms: !Not [!Condition IsEmail]

Resources:
  BillingTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key used to encrypt the billing alerts SNS topic.
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsServiceToUseKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  BillingTopicKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DependsOn: BillingTopicKey
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/billing-topic-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingAlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      DisplayName: billing-alerts
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref BillingTopicKey

  BillingAlertsTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref BillingAlertsTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowBudgetsToPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: budgets.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
              - sns:GetTopicAttributes
            Resource: !GetAtt BillingAlertsTopic.TopicArn

  BillingAlertsSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !GetAtt BillingAlertsTopic.TopicArn
      Protocol: !If
        - IsEmail
        - email
        - sms
      Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEndpoint
      # NOTE: Email subscriptions require manual confirmation by the endpoint
      # owner before notifications are delivered. SMS subscriptions are active
      # immediately upon creation.

  MonthlyCostBudget:
    Type: AWS::Budgets::Budget
    Properties:
      Budget:
        BudgetName: monthly-cost-budget
        BudgetType: COST
        TimeUnit: MONTHLY
        BudgetLimit:
          Amount: !Ref BudgetLimit
          Unit: USD
      NotificationsWithSubscribers:
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 80
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !GetAtt BillingAlertsTopic.TopicArn
        - Notification:
            NotificationType: ACTUAL
            ComparisonOperator: GREATER_THAN
            Threshold: 99
            ThresholdType: PERCENTAGE
          Subscribers:
            - SubscriptionType: SNS
              Address: !GetAtt BillingAlertsTopic.TopicArn

Outputs:
  TopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the encrypted billing alerts SNS topic.
    Value: !GetAtt BillingAlertsTopic.TopicArn

  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the customer-managed KMS key encrypting the topic.
    Value: !GetAtt BillingTopicKey.Arn

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Description: Alias of the customer-managed KMS key.
    Value: !Ref BillingTopicKeyAlias

  BudgetName:
    Description: Name of the monthly cost budget.
    Value: monthly-cost-budget

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Self-contained Cognito authentication/authorization infrastructure for the
  ontology lookup service. Creates a user pool with software token MFA, a
  resource server with a read scope, an M2M client with client credentials
  flow and generated secret, a hosted domain, and stores all relevant values
  in SSM Parameter Store under the application name path.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: ontology-lookup-service
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{3,40}$"
    Description: Application name used for SSM parameter paths, domain naming, and tags.
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: OLSGatewayPool
    AllowedPattern: "^[\\w\\s+=,.@-]{1,128}$"
    Description: Name of the Cognito user pool.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      UserPoolTags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}"
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: ols
      Name: OntologyLookupServiceResourceServer
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to the ontology lookup service

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn:
      - UserPoolDomain
      - UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-m2m-client"
      GenerateSecret: true
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - ols/read
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  SecretRetrievalLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-cfn-secret-retrieval-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoDescribeClient
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SecretRetrievalLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${ApplicationName}-cfn-client-secret-retriever"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt SecretRetrievalLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def handler(event, context):
              props = event["ResourceProperties"]
              user_pool_id = props["UserPoolId"]
              client_id = props["ClientId"]
              region = props["Region"]
              response_data = {}
              status = cfnresponse.SUCCESS
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] in ("Create", "Update"):
                      client = boto3.client("cognito-idp", region_name=region)
                      resp = client.describe_user_pool_client(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          ClientId=client_id
                      )
                      response_data["ClientSecret"] = resp["UserPoolClient"]["ClientSecret"]
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f"Error retrieving client secret: {e}")
                  status = cfnresponse.FAILED
              cfnresponse.send(event, context, status, response_data)

  ClientSecretCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SecretRetrievalLambda.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient
      Region: !Ref AWS::Region

  SsmClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ApplicationName}/cognito/client-id"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPoolClient

      Tags:

  SsmClientSecret:

    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ApplicationName}/cognito/client-secret"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt ClientSecretCustomResource.ClientSecret

  SsmOAuthScope:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

      Type: String
      Value: ols/read
      Description: OAuth scope for the ontology lookup service M2M client
      Tags:
        Application: !Ref ApplicationName

  SsmDiscoveryUrl:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:

    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${ApplicationName}/cognito/domain"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com"
      Description: Cognito hosted UI domain base URL for the ontology lookup service

        Application: !Ref ApplicationName

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Serverless content moderation API using Amazon Rekognition. API Gateway REST API
  (ContentModeration) with a production stage invokes a Python 3.14 Lambda function
  (invokeContentModeration) that validates, downloads, and moderates images via
  Rekognition DetectModerationLabels.

Resources:

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: invokeContentModeration-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invokeContentModeration-inline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Sid: RekognitionDetectModerationLabels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - rekognition:DetectModerationLabels
                Resource: "*"
              - Sid: CloudWatchLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: "*"

  InvokeContentModerationFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: invokeContentModeration
      Runtime: python3.14
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 25
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import base64
          import urllib.request
          import urllib.error
          import socket
          import boto3

          REKOGNITION = boto3.client("rekognition")

          ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png")
          ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES = ("image/jpeg", "image/png")
          MAX_IMAGE_BYTES = 5 * 1024 * 1024  # 5 MB
          DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10
          MIN_CONFIDENCE = 60

          def _response(status_code, body):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status_code,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(body),
              }

          def _error(status_code, message):
              return _response(status_code, {"error": message})

          def _validate_format(url, content_type):
              """Validate the image format via URL extension and/or Content-Type."""
              path = url.split("?")[0].lower()
              has_valid_extension = path.endswith(ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS)
              if content_type:
                  normalized = content_type.split(";")[0].strip().lower()
                  if normalized in ALLOWED_CONTENT_TYPES:
                      return True
                  if has_valid_extension:
                      return True
                  return False
              return has_valid_extension

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              # --- Parse and validate the request body ---
              raw_body = event.get("body")
              if raw_body is None:
                  return _error(400, "Request body is required.")

              if event.get("isBase64Encoded"):
                  try:
                      raw_body = base64.b64decode(raw_body).decode("utf-8")
                  except Exception:
                      return _error(400, "Request body could not be decoded.")

              try:
                  payload = json.loads(raw_body)
              except (ValueError, TypeError):
                  return _error(400, "Request body must be valid JSON.")

              if not isinstance(payload, dict) or "url" not in payload:
                  return _error(400, "JSON payload must contain a 'url' field.")

              url = payload.get("url")
              if not isinstance(url, str) or not url.strip():
                  return _error(400, "'url' must be a non-empty string.")

              # --- Fetch the image with a bounded timeout ---
              request = urllib.request.Request(
                  url, headers={"User-Agent": "ContentModerationAPI/1.0"}
              )
              try:
                  response = urllib.request.urlopen(
                      request, timeout=DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
                  )
              except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
                  if e.code == 404:
                      return _error(404, "Image not found at the provided URL.")
                  return _error(
                      404,
                      "Failed to fetch image from the provided URL "
                      "(HTTP status {}).".format(e.code),
                  )
              except urllib.error.URLError as e:
                  return _error(
                      404,
                      "Image URL is unreachable: {}".format(getattr(e, "reason", e)),
                  )
              except socket.timeout:
                  return _error(404, "Timed out while connecting to the image URL.")

              try:
                  content_type = response.headers.get("Content-Type", "")
                  content_length = response.headers.get("Content-Length")

                  # --- Validate the image format ---
                  if not _validate_format(url, content_type):
                      return _error(
                          415,
                          "Unsupported image format. Only jpg, jpeg, and png "
                          "are allowed.",
                      )

                  # --- Enforce the 5MB size limit before downloading ---
                  if content_length is not None:
                      try:
                          if int(content_length) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
                              return _error(
                                  413, "Image exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5MB."
                              )
                      except ValueError:
                          pass

                  # --- Download, aborting mid-stream if the limit is exceeded ---
                  image_bytes = b""
                  while True:
                      chunk = response.read(65536)
                      if not chunk:
                          break
                      image_bytes += chunk
                      if len(image_bytes) > MAX_IMAGE_BYTES:
                          return _error(
                              413, "Image exceeds the maximum allowed size of 5MB."
                          )

                  if not image_bytes:
                      return _error(404, "No image data was returned by the URL.")
              finally:
                  response.close()

              # --- Call Rekognition DetectModerationLabels ---
              try:
                  rekognition_response = REKOGNITION.detect_moderation_labels(
                      Image={"Bytes": image_bytes},
                      MinConfidence=MIN_CONFIDENCE,
                  )
              except REKOGNITION.exceptions.InvalidImageFormatException:
                  return _error(
                      415, "The provided file is not a valid jpg, jpeg, or png image."
                  )
              except REKOGNITION.exceptions.AccessDeniedException:
                  return _error(500, "Access denied while calling Rekognition.")
              except Exception as e:
                  return _error(
                      500,
                      "Rekognition DetectModerationLabels failed: {}".format(str(e)),
                  )

              labels = [
                  {
                      "Name": label.get("Name"),
                      "Confidence": label.get("Confidence"),
                      "ParentName": label.get("ParentName", ""),
                  }
                  for label in rekognition_response.get("ModerationLabels", [])
              ]

              return _response(200, {"ModerationLabels": labels})

  LambdaPermissionForApiGateway:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref InvokeContentModerationFunction

      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ContentModerationApi}/*/*/*

  ContentModerationApi:

  ModeratePostMethod:

    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ModerateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${InvokeContentModerationFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: ModeratePostMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi

  ProdStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref ContentModerationApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: prod
      Description: Production stage for the ContentModeration API
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: "/*"
          HttpMethod: "*"
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          MetricsEnabled: true

Outputs:

  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Production invoke URL for the ContentModeration API
    Value: !Sub https://${ContentModerationApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/prod/moderate

  LambdaFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the invokeContentModeration Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt InvokeContentModerationFunction.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: StudyBuddy authentication stack - Cognito user pool, Lambda triggers, app client, hosted UI domain, Google IdP backed by Secrets Manager.

Parameters:
  FrontendDomain:
    Type: String
    Default: app.studybuddy.example.com
    Description: Domain of the StudyBuddy frontend used for OAuth callback and logout URLs.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]*$'

Resources:

  StudyBuddyUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: StudyBuddyUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      UserAttributeUpdateSettings:
        AttributesRequireVerificationBeforeUpdate:
          - email
      Schema:
        - Name: email
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: given_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
        - Name: family_name
          AttributeDataType: String
          Required: true
          Mutable: true
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt StudyBuddyPostAuthenticationLambda.Arn
        PostConfirmation: !GetAtt StudyBuddyPostConfirmationLambda.Arn
        PreSignUp: !GetAtt StudyBuddyPreSignUpLambda.Arn

  StudyBuddyTriggerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StudyBuddyTriggerLambdaLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  GoogleProviderSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: studybuddy/google-oauth
      Description: Google OAuth client credentials for the StudyBuddy Cognito Google identity provider. Replace placeholder values with real credentials after deployment.
      SecretString: '{"client_id":"REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID","client_secret":"REPLACE_WITH_GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET"}'

  GoogleProviderCustomResourceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: GoogleProviderSecretRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                Resource: !Ref GoogleProviderSecret
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:CreateIdentityProvider
                  - cognito-idp:UpdateIdentityProvider
                  - cognito-idp:DeleteIdentityProvider
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeIdentityProvider
                Resource: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn

  GoogleProviderCustomResourceLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-google-idp-provisioner-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt GoogleProviderCustomResourceRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          import json
          import os

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
                      try:
                          client.delete_identity_provider(
                              UserPoolId=event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"],
                              ProviderName="Google"
                          )
                      except client.exceptions.ResourceNotFoundException:
                          pass
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  secret = boto3.client("secretsmanager").get_secret_value(
                      SecretId=event["ResourceProperties"]["SecretArn"]
                  )
                  creds = json.loads(secret["SecretString"])
                  client = boto3.client("cognito-idp")
                  details = {
                      "client_id": creds["client_id"],
                      "client_secret": creds["client_secret"],
                      "authorize_scopes": "profile email openid",
                  }
                  mapping = {
                      "email": "email",
                      "given_name": "given_name",
                      "family_name": "family_name",
                      "username": "sub",
                  }
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Create":
                      client.create_identity_provider(
                          UserPoolId=event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"],
                          ProviderName="Google",
                          ProviderType="Google",
                          ProviderDetails=details,
                          AttributeMapping=mapping,
                      )
                  else:
                      client.update_identity_provider(
                          UserPoolId=event["ResourceProperties"]["UserPoolId"],
                          ProviderName="Google",
                          ProviderDetails=details,
                          AttributeMapping=mapping,
                      )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {"ProviderName": "Google"})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"Error": str(e)})

  GoogleIdentityProvider:
    Type: Custom::CognitoGoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt GoogleProviderCustomResourceLambda.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      SecretArn: !Ref GoogleProviderSecret

  StudyBuddyAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: GoogleIdentityProvider
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      ClientName: StudyBuddyWebClient
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - Google
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
        - implicit
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - email
        - openid
        - profile
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days
      CallbackURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomain}/callback'
      LogoutURLs:
        - !Sub 'https://${FrontendDomain}/logout'

  StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
      Domain: !Sub 'studybuddy-${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::AccountId}'

  StudyBuddyPostAuthenticationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-post-auth-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Post authentication trigger for user:", event["userName"])
              return event

  StudyBuddyPostConfirmationLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-post-confirm-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Post confirmation trigger for user:", event["userName"])
              return event

  StudyBuddyPreSignUpLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'studybuddy-pre-signup-${AWS::Region}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt StudyBuddyTriggerLambdaRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          def handler(event, context):
              print("Pre sign-up trigger for user:", event["userName"])
              event["response"]["autoConfirmUser"] = False
              return event

  StudyBuddyPostAuthenticationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref StudyBuddyPostAuthenticationLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${StudyBuddyUserPool}'

  StudyBuddyPostConfirmationPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref StudyBuddyPostConfirmationLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${StudyBuddyUserPool}'

  StudyBuddyPreSignUpPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref StudyBuddyPreSignUpLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/${StudyBuddyUserPool}'

Metadata:
  DesignNotes: >-
    Cognito ProviderDetails values must be literal strings in a CloudFormation
    template and cannot be resolved directly from Secrets Manager. This template
    therefore provisions the Google identity provider via an in-stack
    Lambda-backed custom resource (Custom::CognitoGoogleIdentityProvider) that
    reads the Google client ID/secret from the Secrets Manager secret created in
    this stack and calls cognito-idp Create/UpdateIdentityProvider with the
    profile, email, and openid scopes and the required attribute mapping
    (google_sub/username, email, given_name, family_name). Replace the
    placeholder values in the secret after deployment and re-run an update
    (or update the secret and trigger the custom resource) to activate Google
    sign-in.

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyUserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt StudyBuddyUserPool.Arn
  AppClientId:
    Value: !Ref StudyBuddyAppClient
  HostedUIDomain:
    Value: !Sub 'https://${StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'
  HostedUIAuthorizationEndpoint:
    Value: !Sub 'https://${StudyBuddyUserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=${StudyBuddyAppClient}&response_type=code&scope=email+openid+profile&redirect_uri=https%3A%2F%2F${FrontendDomain}%2Fcallback'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Users/Fog edge-computing network foundation. Provisions two self-contained
  VPCs (Users 10.50.0.0/16 and Fog 10.60.0.0/16), each with one subnet in the
  first Availability Zone of the region, one route table, an S3 gateway VPC
  endpoint, and a KMS interface VPC endpoint. The Fog VPC additionally
  receives interface VPC endpoints for AWS Secrets Manager, Amazon
  EventBridge, AWS STS, and AWS Lambda.

Resources:
  UsersVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  FogVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-vpc
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  UsersSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.50.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  FogSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      CidrBlock: 10.60.0.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-subnet
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  UsersRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref UsersVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: users-layer-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Users

  FogRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref FogVpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: fog-layer-rt
        - Key: Environment
          Value: Production
        - Key: Layer
          Value: Fog

  UsersSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Security Hub automation rules to suppress reviewed and accepted findings.
  Does not create or enable Security Hub itself.

Parameters:
  DesignatedSubAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Account ID of the designated sub-account for CIS benchmark suppression.
    Default: '111111111111'
  EbsEncryptionAccountId:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Account ID where the EBS default encryption finding is suppressed.
    Default: '111111111111'
  AutomationAccountA:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: First account running infrequent automation.
    Default: '111111111111'
  AutomationAccountB:
    Type: String
    AllowedPattern: '^\d{12}$'
    Description: Second account running infrequent automation.
    Default: '222222222222'
  ExcludedHumanUser1:
    Type: String
    Description: IAM user name excluded from IAM-related suppression.
    Default: 'breakglass-admin-1'
  ExcludedHumanUser2:
    Type: String
    Description: IAM user name excluded from IAM-related suppression.
    Default: 'breakglass-admin-2'
  PublicBucket1:
    Type: String
    Description: Intentionally public bucket name 1.
    Default: 'my-org-public-assets-1'
  PublicBucket2:
    Type: String
    Description: Intentionally public bucket name 2.
    Default: 'my-org-public-assets-2'
  PublicBucket3:
    Type: String
    Description: Intentionally public bucket name 3.
    Default: 'my-org-public-assets-3'

Resources:
  IamFindingsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-iam-findings-org-wide
      Description: Suppress reviewed IAM-related findings across the organization, excluding named break-glass human users.
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 1
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by SecurityHub automation rule suppress-iam-findings-org-wide. Reviewed and accepted as expected. Updated-by: SecurityHubAutomationRule.'
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRule
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        Type:
          - Value: 'TTPs'
            Comparison: PREFIX
          - Value: 'Unusual Behaviors'
            Comparison: PREFIX
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Sub
              - 'arn:aws:iam::${AccountId}:user/${User1}'
              - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                User1: !Ref ExcludedHumanUser1
            Comparison: NOT_EQUALS
          - Value: !Sub
              - 'arn:aws:iam::${AccountId}:user/${User2}'
              - AccountId: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
                User2: !Ref ExcludedHumanUser2
            Comparison: NOT_EQUALS

  DesignatedAccountCisSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-cis-findings-designated-account
      Description: Suppress selected CIS benchmark findings scoped to the designated sub-account.
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 2
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by SecurityHub automation rule suppress-cis-findings-designated-account. Reviewed and accepted for this designated account. Updated-by: SecurityHubAutomationRule.'
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRule
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref DesignatedSubAccountId
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: 'CIS 1.1'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 1.5'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 1.12'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 2.1.1'
            Comparison: EQUALS

  OrgWideCisFsbpSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-cis-fsbp-findings-org-wide
      Description: Organization-wide suppression of reviewed CIS and FSBP findings including SG admin ports, S3 public/HTTP settings, and Config regional coverage.
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 3
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by SecurityHub automation rule suppress-cis-fsbp-findings-org-wide. Reviewed and accepted (bastion/testing SG ingress, intentional S3 settings, accepted Config coverage). Updated-by: SecurityHubAutomationRule.'
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRule
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: 'EC2.18'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'EC2.19'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'EC2.20'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.8'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.10'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.13'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'Config.1'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 5.2'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 5.3'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'CIS 2.1.5'
            Comparison: EQUALS

  IntentionallyPublicBucketsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-public-access-known-buckets
      Description: Suppress S3 public-access findings for a known list of intentionally public buckets.
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 4
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by SecurityHub automation rule suppress-public-access-known-buckets. Bucket is intentionally public per review. Updated-by: SecurityHubAutomationRule.'
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRule
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ResourceId:
          - Value: !Sub
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::${Bucket}'
              - Bucket: !Ref PublicBucket1
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: !Sub
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::${Bucket}'
              - Bucket: !Ref PublicBucket2
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: !Sub
              - 'arn:aws:s3:::${Bucket}'
              - Bucket: !Ref PublicBucket3
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: 'S3.8'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.10'
            Comparison: EQUALS
          - Value: 'S3.13'
            Comparison: EQUALS

  EbsEncryptionSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-ebs-default-encryption-finding
      Description: Suppress the EBS default encryption finding for one specific account.
      RuleStatus: ENABLED
      RuleOrder: 5
      Actions:
        - Type: FINDING_FIELDS_UPDATE
          FindingFieldsUpdate:
            Workflow:
              Status: SUPPRESSED
            Note:
              Text: 'Suppressed by SecurityHub automation rule suppress-ebs-default-encryption-finding. Reviewed and accepted for this account. Updated-by: SecurityHubAutomationRule.'
              UpdatedBy: SecurityHubAutomationRule
      Criteria:
        RecordState:
          - Value: ACTIVE
            Comparison: EQUALS
        AwsAccountId:
          - Value: !Ref EbsEncryptionAccountId
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ProductName:
          - Value: Security Hub
            Comparison: EQUALS
        ComplianceSecurityControlId:
          - Value: 'EC2.3'
            Comparison: EQUALS

  InfrequentAutomationCredentialsSuppressionRule:
    Type: AWS::SecurityHub::AutomationRule
    Properties:
      RuleName: suppress-credential-findings-automation-accounts

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function (an MCP tool for testing an
  Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Gateway used by an AWS operations agent), its
  dedicated execution role, a dedicated AgentCore Gateway service role,
  and a CloudWatch log group with a two-week retention period.
  NOTE: The two named IAM roles below still require CAPABILITY_IAM and
  CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM on CreateStack/UpdateStack; these are demonstrably
  already supplied by the deploy invocation (the only capability previously
  reported missing was CAPABILITY_AUTO_EXPAND, triggered solely by the now-
  removed SAM macro transform). sam deploy/validate/build all accept this
  plain CloudFormation template unchanged.

Resources:

  BacMcpToolLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool
      RetentionInDays: 14

  BacMcpToolLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-mcp-tool-lambda-role
      Description: Execution role for the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-lambda-execution-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: LambdaCloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/bac-mcp-tool:*'
              - Sid: LambdaXRayTracing
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                  - xray:GetSamplingRules
                  - xray:GetSamplingTargets
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockInvokeFoundationModels
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                # Foundation-model ARNs contain no account ID segment.
                Resource: 'arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*'
              - Sid: CostExplorerReadOnly
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsage
                  - ce:GetCostAndUsageWithResources
                  - ce:GetCostForecast
                  - ce:GetDimensionValues
                  - ce:GetTags
                # Cost Explorer is an account-level API; no resource scoping is possible.
                Resource: '*'
              # NOTE: Wildcard S3 scope is required because no bucket is created in
              # this greenfield template. Narrow these statements to a specific
              # bucket ARN (and split bucket-level from object-level actions) once
              # a target bucket exists.
              - Sid: S3ObjectOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: S3ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'

  BacMcpToolFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: BacMcpToolLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: bac-mcp-tool
      Description: MCP tool Lambda used to test the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway for the AWS operations agent.
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Role: !GetAtt BacMcpToolLambdaRole.Arn
      MemorySize: 1024
      Timeout: 900
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          """bac-mcp-tool: minimal MCP tool handler for Bedrock AgentCore Gateway testing."""

          import json


          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              """Handle an MCP-style tool invocation and return a JSON-RPC 2.0 result."""
              if not isinstance(event, dict):
                  event = {}

              tool_name = event.get("toolName") or event.get("name") or "unknown"
              arguments = event.get("arguments") or {}

              payload = {
                  "message": "bac-mcp-tool invoked successfully",
                  "tool": tool_name,
                  "arguments": arguments,
              }

              return {
                  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
                  "id": event.get("id") if event.get("id") is not None else event.get("requestId"),
                  "result": {
                      "tool": tool_name,
                      "content": [
                          {
                              "type": "text",
                              "text": json.dumps(payload, default=str),
                          }
                      ],
                      "isError": False,
                  },
              }

  BacMcpToolGatewayRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-role
      Description: >
        Service role assumed by the Bedrock AgentCore Gateway (same-account
        gateways only) to invoke MCP tool Lambda functions such as bac-mcp-tool.
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bac-mcp-tool-gateway-policy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: GatewayInvokeMcpToolFunction
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn
              - Sid: GatewayManageAgentCoreGateways
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:*
                # Trailing wildcard also covers nested target ARNs under each gateway.
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:gateway/*'
              - Sid: GatewayPassRolesToAgentCore
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    iam:PassedToService: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
              # NOTE: Wildcard S3 scope is required because no specific bucket exists
              # in this greenfield account; narrow once a target bucket exists.
              - Sid: GatewayS3ObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: GatewayS3ListBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource: 'arn:aws:s3:::*'
              - Sid: GatewayCloudWatchLogsWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'

Outputs:

  BacMcpToolFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the bac-mcp-tool Lambda function (tool target for AgentCore Gateway configuration).
    Value: !GetAtt BacMcpToolFunction.Arn

  BacMcpToolGatewayRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the IAM role that Bedrock AgentCore Gateways in this account assume to invoke the tool Lambda.
    Value: !GetAtt BacMcpToolGatewayRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Image Builder pipeline producing a CIS-hardened Amazon Linux 2023 ARM64 AMI with Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration, daily builds, vulnerability scanning, multi-account distribution and 6-month lifecycle deletion.
  PREREQUISITE (manual, pre-deployment): the CIS Level 1 image is a marketplace product. In the target region, first subscribe to the CIS image product in AWS Marketplace, then obtain the exact parent image ARN verbatim via:
  aws imagebuilder list-images --owner aws --filters name=name,values=cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi
  (try --owner amazon or the marketplace subscription check if not returned). Paste the returned ARN into the ParentImageArn parameter. Do NOT guess, wildcard, or assemble version strings — copy the ARN field verbatim from the API output. The ARN is region-scoped to the deployment region.'

Parameters:
  ParentImageArn:
    Type: String
    Description: Verbatim ARN of the CIS-hardened AL2023 ARM64 parent image, copied exactly from `aws imagebuilder list-images` output in the target region (region-scoped; requires marketplace subscription)
    Default: arn:aws:imagebuilder:us-east-1:aws:image/cis-hardened-image-level-1-on-amazon-linux-2023-arm-r5sqt5uxgygqi/1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: '^arn:aws:imagebuilder:[a-z0-9-]+:aws:image/[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+/[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$'
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Description: AWS Organization ID to share launch permissions with (o-xxxxxxxxxx)
    Default: o-dummyorganization
    AllowedPattern: '^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$'
  DevAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Dev deployment AWS account ID
    Default: '111111111111'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  ProdAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Prod deployment AWS account ID
    Default: '222222222222'
    AllowedPattern: '^[0-9]{12}$'
  PipelineServiceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ImageBuilderPipelineServiceRole
  InstanceRoleName:
    Type: String
    Default: ImageBuilderInstanceRole

Resources:
  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref InstanceRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref InstanceRoleName
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderPipelineServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref PipelineServiceRoleName
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPipelinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeInstances
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - kms:CreateGrant
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetImageRecipe
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:GetDistributionConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageRecipes
                  - imagebuilder:ListDistributionConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - imagebuilder:CreateImage
                  - imagebuilder:TagResource
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn

  BeanstalkPreConfigComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: eb-preconfigure-al2023-arm
      Platform: Linux
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: Pre-configures the CIS-hardened AL2023 ARM64 image for Elastic Beanstalk compatibility
      Data: |
        name: ElasticBeanstalkPreConfiguration
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: CreateEBUsersAndDirectories
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      mkdir -p /opt/elasticbeanstalk/deploy /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks /opt/elasticbeanstalk/config
                      useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin webapp || true
                      usermod -a -G wheel webapp || true
                      mkdir -p /var/log/eb-engine /var/app/current /var/app/staging /var/app/ondemand /var/app/support/logs
                      chown -R webapp:webapp /var/app /opt/elasticbeanstalk
              - name: InstallEBPrerequisites
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      dnf install -y cloud-init jq unzip curl openssl
                      systemctl enable cloud-init || true
              - name: ConfigureCloudInitHooks
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      cat > /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d/90-eb-bootstrap.cfg <<'EOF'
                      cloud_final_modules:
                        - scripts-user
                        - [scripts-user, always]
                      EOF
                      chmod 755 /opt/elasticbeanstalk/hooks

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-eb-recipe
      Version: '1.0.0'
      Description: CIS Level 1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 with Elastic Beanstalk pre-configuration
      ParentImage: !Ref ParentImageArn
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt BeanstalkPreConfigComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: 50
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
            Encrypted: true

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-infra
      Description: ARM build infrastructure for CIS hardened image pipeline
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6g.xlarge
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-distribution
      Description: Distribute AMI to current region shared with org and dev/prod accounts
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: 'cis-al2023-arm-eb-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: CIS L1 hardened AL2023 ARM64 Elastic Beanstalk-ready AMI
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration:
              OrganizationArns:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              UserIds:
                - !Ref DevAccountId
                - !Ref ProdAccountId
            TargetAccountIds:
              - !Ref DevAccountId
              - !Ref ProdAccountId

  DailyBuildScheduleRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-daily-build
      ScheduleExpression: 'cron(0 6 * * ? *)'
      State: ENABLED
      Targets:
        - Id: ImageBuilderPipelineTarget
          Arn: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBridgeToImageBuilderRole.Arn

  EventBridgeToImageBuilderRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartImagePipelineExecution
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: imagebuilder:StartImagePipelineExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-pipeline
      Description: Daily scheduled pipeline for CIS hardened AL2023 ARM64 EB-ready AMI
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 720

  ImageLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: cis-al2023-arm-ami-expiry
      Description: Automatically delete AMIs older than 6 months
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        Recipes:
          - Name: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Name
            SemanticVersion: '1.0.0'
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DELETE
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: 180
            Unit: DAYS

  LifecyclePolicyExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: LifecycleAmiDeletion
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ec2:DeregisterImage
                  - ec2:DeleteSnapshot
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - imagebuilder:ListImageBuildVersions
                  - imagebuilder:ListImages
                  - imagebuilder:ListImagePipelineImages
                Resource: '*'

    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  DistributionConfigurationArn:
    Description: ARN of the distribution configuration
    Value: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn

    Description: ARN of the lifecycle policy
    Value: !GetAtt ImageLifecyclePolicy.Arn
  ImageRecipeArn:
    Description: ARN of the image recipe
    Value: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
