    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-nat'
  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
  PrivateRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
  EcsCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-cluster'
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  ServiceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Allow intra-VPC traffic on the container port
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          ToPort: !Ref ContainerPort
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-svc-sg'
  LogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: 30
  EcsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-execution-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonECSTaskExecutionRolePolicy
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ReadLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt LogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  EcsTaskRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-task-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs-tasks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies: !If
        - HasCustomRole
        - - PolicyName: AssumeCustomRole
            PolicyDocument:
              Version: '2012-10-17'
              Statement:
                - Effect: Allow
                  Action: sts:AssumeRole
                  Resource: !Ref CustomTaskRoleArn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  EcsAutoScalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-ecs-autoscaling-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ecs.application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: EcsServiceScaling
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecs:DescribeServices
                  - ecs:UpdateService
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
  TaskDefinition:
    Type: AWS::ECS::TaskDefinition
    Properties:
      Family: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}'
      Cpu: !Ref CpuUnits
      Memory: !Ref MemoryUnits
      NetworkMode: awsvpc
      RequiresCompatibilities:
        - FARGATE
      ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsExecutionRole.Arn
      TaskRoleArn: !GetAtt EcsTaskRole.Arn
      ContainerDefinitions:
        - Name: !Ref ServiceName
          Image: !Ref ContainerImage
          PortMappings:
            - ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
              Protocol: tcp
          LogConfiguration:
            LogDriver: awslogs
            Options:
              awslogs-group: !Ref LogGroup
              awslogs-region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
              awslogs-stream-prefix: ecs
  PrivateDnsNamespace:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::PrivateDnsNamespace
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}.svc'
      Vpc: !Ref VPC
  CloudMapService:
    Type: AWS::ServiceDiscovery::Service
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: PrivateDnsNamespace
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ServiceName
      NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
      DnsConfig:
        DnsRecords:
          - Type: SRV
            TTL: 10
          - Type: A
            TTL: 10
        NamespaceId: !Ref PrivateDnsNamespace
        RoutingPolicy: WEIGHTED
      HealthCheckCustomConfig:
        FailureThreshold: 1
  EcsService:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Service
    DependsOn: CloudMapService
    Properties:
      ServiceName: !Ref ServiceName
      Cluster: !Ref EcsCluster
      LaunchType: FARGATE
      DesiredCount: !Ref DesiredCount
      TaskDefinition: !Ref TaskDefinition
      HealthCheckGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      NetworkConfiguration:
        AwsvpcConfiguration:
          AssignPublicIp: DISABLED
          SecurityGroups:
            - !Ref ServiceSecurityGroup
          Subnets:
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet1
            - !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      ServiceRegistries:
        - RegistryArn: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
          ContainerName: !Ref ServiceName
          ContainerPort: !Ref ContainerPort
      DeploymentConfiguration:
        DeploymentCircuitBreaker:
          Enable: true
          Rollback: true
        MinimumHealthyPercent: 100
        MaximumPercent: 200
  ScaleInAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ScaleInPolicy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      AlarmDescription: Scale in when average CPU drops to or below 20 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 20
      ComparisonOperator: LessThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleInPolicy
  ScaleOutAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    DependsOn: ScaleOutPolicy
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      AlarmDescription: Scale out when average CPU reaches or exceeds 70 percent.
      Namespace: AWS/ECS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ClusterName
          Value: !Ref EcsCluster
        - Name: ServiceName
          Value: !Ref ServiceName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref ScaleOutPolicy
  ScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: EcsService
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 2
      ResourceId: !Sub 'service/${EcsCluster}/${ServiceName}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt EcsAutoScalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: ecs:service:DesiredCount
      ServiceNamespace: ecs
  ScaleOutPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-out'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 30
            ScalingAdjustment: 1
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 30
            MetricIntervalUpperBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 2
          - MetricIntervalLowerBound: 60
            ScalingAdjustment: 3
  ScaleInPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-${ServiceName}-scale-in'
      PolicyType: StepScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref ScalableTarget
      StepScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        AdjustmentType: ChangeInCapacity
        Cooldown: 300
        MetricAggregationType: Average
        StepAdjustments:
          - MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0
            ScalingAdjustment: -1
Outputs:
  ClusterName:
    Description: ECS cluster name
    Value: !Ref EcsCluster
  EcsServiceName:
    Description: ECS service name
    Value: !Ref EcsService
  CloudMapServiceDnsName:
    Description: DNS name for service discovery
    Value: !Sub '${ServiceName}.${EnvironmentName}-${AWS::StackName}.svc'
  CloudMapServiceArn:
    Description: Cloud Map service ARN
    Value: !GetAtt CloudMapService.Arn
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  Self-contained hybrid interconnect demo network backbone (VPC, TGW, conditional
  OCI VGW-attached VPN with static routes, encrypted flow logs). Inter-VPC OCI
  traffic traverses the VGW-attached VPN's static route, since the TGW VPN
  attachment ID is not addressable from CloudFormation.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  SubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.94.10.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR block for the private subnet.
  InternalHttpsIngressCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/8
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: CIDR allowed to reach TCP 443 inbound.
  OciBackboneCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.95.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$
    Description: OCI backbone CIDR for HTTPS egress and VPN static route.
  EnableVpnConnection:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create the OCI VPN connection.
  CustomerGatewayIp:
    Type: String
    Default: 203.0.113.10
    AllowedPattern: ^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}$
    Description: Public IP of the OCI customer gateway.
  CustomerGatewayBgpAsn:
    Type: Number
    Default: 65000
    Description: BGP ASN of the OCI customer gateway.

Conditions:
  CreateVpn: !Equals [!Ref EnableVpnConnection, 'true']

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref SubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref RouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub '${AWS::StackName} demo transit gateway'
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: enable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: enable
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw'

  TransitGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-tgw-attachment'

  SecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: HTTPS only - inbound from internal CIDR, outbound to OCI backbone
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref InternalHttpsIngressCidr
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  VpnGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vgw'

  VpnGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      VpnGatewayId: !Ref VpnGateway

  CustomerGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::CustomerGateway
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      BgpAsn: !Ref CustomerGatewayBgpAsn
      IpAddress: !Ref CustomerGatewayIp
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cgw'

  VPNConnection:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnection
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VpnGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Type: ipsec.1
      CustomerGatewayId: !Ref CustomerGateway
      VpnGatewayId: !Ref VpnGateway
      StaticRoutesOnly: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpn'

  VPNConnectionRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPNConnectionRoute
    Condition: CreateVpn
    DependsOn: VPNConnection
    Properties:
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref OciBackboneCidr
      VpnConnectionId: !Ref VPNConnection

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC flow log encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  FlowLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/vpc-flowlogs/${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: 30

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-to-cloudwatch
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlog'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PrivateSubnetId:
    Description: Private subnet ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Description: Transit gateway ID
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  SecurityGroupId:
    Description: Security group ID
    Value: !Ref SecurityGroup
  VpnConnectionId:
    Description: VPN connection ID
    Value: !If [CreateVpn, !Ref VPNConnection, 'VPN disabled']
  CustomerGatewayId:
    Condition: CreateVpn
    Description: Customer gateway ID
    Value: !Ref CustomerGateway
  FlowLogGroupId:
    Description: Flow log CloudWatch log group
    Value: !Ref FlowLogGroup

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained QuickSight admin console data preparation pipeline - S3 bucket (SSE-KMS), IAM role, five Glue jobs with scheduled triggers.

Resources:
  PipelineKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for QuickSight admin data prep pipeline bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  PipelineBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub 'qs-admin-dprep-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt PipelineKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  PipelineBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref PipelineBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}'
              - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GluePipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'qs-admin-dprep-glue-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AssumeGlueAndCfnRoles
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/glue-service-role-*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/cloudformation-service-role-*'
        - PolicyName: FullServiceAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: '*'
                Resource: '*'
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService':
                      - quicksight.amazonaws.com
                      - glue.amazonaws.com
              - Sid: PipelineBucketAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:DeleteObject'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}'
                  - !Sub '${PipelineBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: PipelineBucketKmsAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt PipelineKmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:*'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:*'
                Resource: '*'

  GlueJobGroupMembership:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-group-membership
      Role: !Ref GluePipelineRole
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/group_membership.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  GlueJobObjectAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-object-access
      Role: !Ref GluePipelineRole
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/object_access.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-assets
      Role: !Ref GluePipelineRole
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder_assets.py'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  GlueJobFolderLookup:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-lookup
      Role: !Ref GluePipelineRole
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder_lookup.py'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  GlueJobFolderPath:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-path
      Role: !Ref GluePipelineRole
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/scripts/folder_path.py'
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      MaxRetries: 1
      Timeout: 60

  TriggerGroupMembership:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-group-membership-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobGroupMembership

  TriggerObjectAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-object-access-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobObjectAccess

  TriggerFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-assets-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderAssets

  TriggerFolderLookup:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-lookup-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderLookup

  TriggerFolderPath:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: qs-admin-folder-path-trigger
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      StartOnCreation: true
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobFolderPath

Outputs:
  GroupMembershipS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for group membership data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/group_membership/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-GroupMembershipS3Path'

  ObjectAccessS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for object access data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/object_access/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-ObjectAccessS3Path'

  FolderAssetsS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder assets data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder_assets/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderAssetsS3Path'

  FolderLookupS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder lookup data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder_lookup/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderLookupS3Path'

  FolderPathS3Path:
    Description: S3 path for folder path data
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/data/folder_path/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-FolderPathS3Path'

  CloudTrailLogTableName:
    Description: CloudTrail log table name for downstream consumption
    Value: 'cloudtrail_log_table'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogTableName'

  CloudTrailLogS3Location:
    Description: S3 location of CloudTrail logs
    Value: !Sub 's3://${PipelineBucket}/cloudtrail-logs/'
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-CloudTrailLogS3Location'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: EC2 Image Builder pipeline with Chef recipe component, lifecycle policy, custom build workflow, and supporting IAM/S3/ECR/KMS resources.

Parameters:
  PipelineName:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-ami-pipeline
    Description: Name of the Image Builder pipeline.
  ComponentName:
    Type: String
    Default: chef-recipe-component
    Description: Name of the custom Chef recipe component.
  RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-chef-recipe
    Description: Name of the image recipe.
  BucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: imagebuilder-chef-recipes
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket hosting Chef recipe artifacts.
  EcrRepositoryName:
    Type: String
    Default: imagebuilder-scan-results
    Description: ECR repository used for image scan findings.
  LifecycleDeprecateAfterDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Deprecate AMIs older than this many days.
  LifecycleTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: al2-ecs-ami-pipeline
  DailyCronExpression:
    Type: String
    Default: cron(0 6 * * ? *)
    Description: Daily pipeline schedule in cron format (UTC).

Resources:
  RecipeBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Image Builder Chef recipe S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3ViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                'kms:ViaService': !Sub 's3.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'

  PipelineTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the Image Builder pipeline SNS topic.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilder
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
            Resource: '*'

  RecipeBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${BucketName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt RecipeBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  RecipeBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref RecipeBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSSMManagedInstanceCore'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: RecipeBucketAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt RecipeBucketKey.Arn

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-instance-profile-${AWS::Region}'
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'imagebuilder-service-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImageBuilderPipelinePermissions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                Resource: !GetAtt ImageBuilderInstanceRole.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ec2:CreateSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:CreateTags'
                  - 'ec2:DeleteSnapshot'
                  - 'ec2:DeregisterImage'
                  - 'ec2:Describe*'
                  - 'ec2:GetConsoleOutput'
                  - 'ec2:ModifyImageAttribute'
                  - 'ec2:RegisterImage'
                  - 'ec2:RunInstances'
                  - 'ec2:TerminateInstances'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'ecr:GetAuthorizationToken'
                  - 'ecr:BatchGetImage'
                  - 'ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability'
                  - 'ecr:CompleteLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:InitiateLayerUpload'
                  - 'ecr:PutImage'
                  - 'ecr:UploadLayerPart'
                  - 'ecr:DescribeRepositories'
                  - 'ecr:CreateRepository'
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/imagebuilder/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                Resource: !GetAtt PipelineTopicKey.Arn

  ScanRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    Properties:
      RepositoryName: !Ref EcrRepositoryName
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true

  ChefRecipeComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref ComponentName
      Platform: Linux
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Updates the SSM agent and executes a Chef recipe from the recipe S3 bucket.
      Data: !Sub |
        name: ${ComponentName}
        description: Update SSM agent, then download and execute Chef recipe from S3
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: UpdateSsmAgent
                action: aws:executeBashScript
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      yum update -y amazon-ssm-agent || dnf update -y amazon-ssm-agent
                      systemctl restart amazon-ssm-agent
              - name: DownloadChefRecipe
                action: aws:downloadUrlSource
                inputs:
                  - source: arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${RecipeBucket}/chef-recipe.zip
              - name: ExecuteChefRecipe
                action: aws:executeBashScript
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - |
                      set -euo pipefail
                      if ! command -v chef-client >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                        curl -L https://omnitruck.chef.io/install.sh | bash -s -- -P chef
                      fi
                      chef-client --local-mode --chef-license accept --recipe-path /tmp
      Tags:
        Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref RecipeName
      Version: 1.0.0
      Description: Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized base image with Chef recipe component.
      ParentImage: '{{resolve:ssm:/aws/service/ecs/optimized-ami/amazon-linux-2/recommended/image_id}}'
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt ChefRecipeComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            VolumeSize: 30
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-infra'
      Description: Infrastructure configuration terminating instances on failure.
      TerminateInstanceOnFailure: true
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Logging:
        S3Logs:
          S3BucketName: !Ref RecipeBucket
          S3KeyPrefix: imagebuilder-logs/
      SnsTopicArn: !Ref PipelineTopic

  PipelineTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref PipelineTopicKey

  PipelineTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref PipelineTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowImageBuilderPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref PipelineTopic

  DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-distribution'
      Description: Distribute AMI to the current account in the current region.
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMI built by Image Builder.
            AmiTags:
              Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue

  # COMMENT OBJECTIVE: The CloudFormation spec does not expose a verifiable way
  # to pass the runtime build instance ID into the workflow via WorkflowParameters
  # (no WorkflowParameter property carries the instance context). The instanceId
  # parameter is declared in the workflow document and resolved from the workflow
  # execution context ($.instanceId); if execution fails to resolve it, the
  # parameter declaration should be removed in favor of a supported context variable.
  CustomBuildWorkflow:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Workflow
    Properties:
      Name: update-ssm-agent-and-metadata
      Version: 1.0.0
      Type: BUILD
      Description: Build workflow that collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
      Data: |
        name: update-ssm-agent-and-metadata
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        description: Collects instance metadata before AMI creation.
        parameters:
          - name: instanceId
            type: string
        steps:
          - name: CollectMetadata
            action: CollectImageMetadata
            onFailure: Abort
            inputs:
              instanceId.$: '$.instanceId'

  ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref PipelineName
      Description: Daily pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2 ECS-optimized AMIs.
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: !Ref DailyCronExpression
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 120
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ImageScanningEnabled: true
        EcrConfiguration:
          RepositoryName: !Ref ScanRepository
          ContainerTags:
            - !Sub '${PipelineName}-latest'
      Workflows:
        - WorkflowArn: !GetAtt CustomBuildWorkflow.Arn

  AmiLifecyclePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::LifecyclePolicy
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${PipelineName}-ami-lifecycle'
      Description: Deprecates AMIs produced by the pipeline after the configured age.
      ExecutionRole: !GetAtt ImageBuilderServiceRole.Arn
      ResourceType: AMI_IMAGE
      ResourceSelection:
        TagMap:
          Pipeline: !Ref LifecycleTagValue
      PolicyDetails:
        - Action:
            Type: DEPRECATE
            IncludeResources:
              Amis: true
              Snapshots: false
              Containers: false
          Filter:
            Type: AGE
            Value: !Ref LifecycleDeprecateAfterDays
          ExclusionRules:
            TagMap:
              LifecycleExempt: 'true'

Outputs:
  PipelineArn:
    Description: ARN of the Image Builder pipeline.
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePipeline.Arn
  RecipeBucketName:
    Description: Name of the S3 bucket hosting Chef recipe artifacts.
    Value: !Ref RecipeBucket
  LifecyclePolicyArn:
    Description: ARN of the AMI lifecycle policy.
    Value: !GetAtt AmiLifecyclePolicy.Arn

  with a configurable retention period.

          - UseCallbacks4
          - UseCallbacks5
      - Label:

        Parameters:

    ParameterLabels:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Provisions five EC2 instances in a self-contained VPC along with 11 CloudWatch
  alarms: 5 CPU utilization alarms (all instances), 3 status check failure alarms
  (instances 1-3), and 3 attached EBS volume reachability alarms (instances 1-3).
  Instances enforce IMDSv2 and use encrypted root volumes; the subnet does not
  auto-assign public IPs.

Parameters:
  LatestAmiId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter::Value<AWS::EC2::Image::Id>
    Default: /aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
    Description: SSM path to the latest Amazon Linux 2023 AMI.
  InstanceType:
    Type: String
    Default: t3.micro
    AllowedValues:
      - t3.micro
      - t3.small
      - t3.medium
    Description: Instance type used by all five monitored instances.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment tag value applied to instances and alarms.

Resources:
  MonitoringVPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringVPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref MonitoringInternetGateway

  MonitoringPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs:
              Ref: AWS::Region
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: MonitoringVPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref MonitoringPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref MonitoringInternetGateway

  MonitoringSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref MonitoringPublicRouteTable

  MonitoringSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Monitoring target security group - no inbound rules, default egress only
      VpcId: !Ref MonitoringVPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-monitoring-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance3'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance4'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MonitoringInstance5:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Instance
    Properties:
      ImageId: !Ref LatestAmiId
      InstanceType: !Ref InstanceType
      SubnetId: !Ref MonitoringPublicSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref MonitoringSecurityGroup
      MetadataOptions:
        HttpEndpoint: enabled
        HttpTokens: required
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            Encrypted: true
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance5'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  Instance1CpuHighAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance1-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alarm for ${AWS::StackName} instance1 when average CPU utilization exceeds 80% over three consecutive 300-second periods.'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: InstanceId
          Value: !Ref MonitoringInstance1
      Statistic: Average

      EvaluationPeriods: 3
      Threshold: 80
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold

      Tags:

          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance1-cpu-high'

          Value: !Ref Environment

    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance2-cpu-high'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alarm for ${AWS::StackName} instance2 when average CPU utilization exceeds 80% over three consecutive 300-second periods.'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2

  Instance1StatusCheckFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance1-status-check-failed'
      AlarmDescription: !Sub 'Alarm for ${AWS::StackName} instance1 when the maximum status check metric reaches 1 for two consecutive 300-second periods.'
      Namespace: AWS/EC2

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Test DynamoDB table (on-demand billing, point-in-time recovery enabled) with a
  comprehensive set of 60-second CloudWatch alarms covering throttling, errors,
  latency, capacity utilization, and replication metrics.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: test-users-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB test table.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{3,255}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Table name must be 3-255 characters of a-z, A-Z, 0-9, '_', '-', and '.'.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment tag value applied to the table.

Resources:
  TestUsersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: USER_ID
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  WriteThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-write-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when write throttle events on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-throttled-requests'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when throttled requests on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ConditionalCheckFailedRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-conditional-check-failures'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when conditional check failed requests exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ConditionalCheckFailedRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB user errors for the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-system-errors'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when DynamoDB system errors for the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  TransactionConflictAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-transaction-conflicts'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when transaction conflicts on the table exceed 1 in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: TransactionConflict
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  OnlineIndexThrottleEventsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-online-index-throttle-events'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when online index throttle events exceed 10 in a 60-second period.
        Note this metric is only emitted for Global Secondary Indexes; this table
        defines none, so the alarm will remain in INSUFFICIENT_DATA.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: OnlineIndexThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  SuccessfulRequestLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-successful-request-latency'
      AlarmDescription: Triggers when average successful request latency exceeds 100 milliseconds in a 60-second period.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SuccessfulRequestLatency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Unit: Milliseconds
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioned-read-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when table-level provisioned read capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-provisioned-write-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when table-level provisioned write capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-provisioned-read-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when account-level provisioned read capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand account.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedReadCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-account-provisioned-write-capacity-utilization'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when account-level provisioned write capacity utilization exceeds 85 percent
        in a 60-second period. Note this is a provisioned-capacity metric and may report
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA on a purely on-demand account.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: AccountProvisionedWriteCapacityUtilization
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 85
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  PendingReplicationCountAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pending-replication-count'
      AlarmDescription: >
        Triggers when pending replication count exceeds 100. Note this metric is emitted
        only by DynamoDB Global Tables; a single-region table will keep this alarm in
        INSUFFICIENT_DATA unless the table is part of a Global Table.
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: PendingReplicationCount
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref TableName
        - Name: Region
          Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 5
      DatapointsToAlarm: 3
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching

  ReplicationLatencyAlarm:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Content-level PII classification scanner for objects exposed through an
  S3 Access Point using Amazon Comprehend DetectPiiEntities. Results are
  stored in DynamoDB with optional SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  AccessPointName:
    Type: String
    Default: 'replace-me-access-point-name'
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{2,49}$'
    ConstraintDescription: >
      Must be a valid S3 Access Point name (3-50 chars). The default
      'replace-me-access-point-name' is a PLACEHOLDER that MUST be overridden
      at deploy time with the real pre-existing access point name; the stack
      will fail fast at runtime otherwise.
    Description: >
      Name of the pre-existing S3 Access Point to scan, in the same account
      and region as this stack. The default is a placeholder that MUST be
      overridden with the real access point name at deploy time.
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid email address.
    Description: Optional email to subscribe to scan notifications. Leave empty to skip SNS subscription.
  CreateSnsTopic:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: Whether to create an SNS topic for scan notifications.
  CreateEndpoints:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: >
      When true AND a VPC ID is supplied, create S3 Gateway, Comprehend,
      DynamoDB, and SNS interface endpoints. Set to false if the target VPC
      already has any of these endpoints (duplicates cause rollback failure).
  VpcId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^vpc-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    Description: VPC ID if the access point has VPC network origin. Empty for internet-origin.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Subnet IDs for the Lambda (required if VpcId supplied).
  SecurityGroupId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^$|^sg-[0-9a-f]{8,17}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be empty or a valid security group ID (sg-*).
    Description: Security group ID for the Lambda (required if VpcId supplied).
  RouteTableIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Route table IDs for the S3 Gateway endpoint (required if VpcId supplied).
  LambdaMemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 512
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
  LambdaTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 600
    MinValue: 3
    MaxValue: 900
  ComprehendLanguageCode:
    Type: String
    Default: 'en'
    AllowedValues: ['en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'pt', 'ar', 'hi', 'ja', 'ko', 'zh', 'zh-TW']
  MaxFilesPerInvocation:
    Type: Number
    Default: 500
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 10000

Conditions:
  HasVpc: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VpcId, '']]
  CreateEndpoints: !And [!Condition HasVpc, !Equals [!Ref CreateEndpoints, 'true']]
  CreateTopic: !Equals [!Ref CreateSnsTopic, 'true']
  HasEmail: !Not [!Equals [!Ref NotificationEmail, '']]

Resources:
  ScanReportTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'pii-classification-reports-${AWS::StackName}'
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointName
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: AccessPointName
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: ObjectKey
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  ScanNotificationKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: CreateTopic
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for the PII scan notification SNS topic
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRolePublishToEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  ScanNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'pii-scan-notifications-${AWS::StackName}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref ScanNotificationKey
      Subscription:
        - !If
          - HasEmail
          - Protocol: email
            Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'

  ScanNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref ScanNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowLambdaRolePublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ScanNotificationTopic

  ScannerLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'pii-scanner-lambda-role-${AWS::StackName}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - !If
          - HasVpc
          - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaVPCAccessExecutionRole'
          - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiiScannerAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AccessPointRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}/object/*'
              - Sid: AccessPointMetadataCheck
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetAccessPoint
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
              - Sid: ComprehendPii
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectPiiEntities
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: DynamoDbWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !GetAtt ScanReportTable.Arn

  ScannerSnsPublishPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Condition: CreateTopic
    Properties:
      PolicyName: PiiScannerSnsPublish
      Roles:
        - !Ref ScannerLambdaRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: SnsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref ScanNotificationTopic
          - Sid: KmsForEncryptedTopic
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: !GetAtt ScanNotificationKey.Arn

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      RouteTableIds: !Ref RouteTableIds
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway

  ComprehendInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.comprehend'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  DynamoDbInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.dynamodb'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SnsInterfaceEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Condition: CreateEndpoints
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.sns'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ScannerLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'pii-scanner-${AWS::StackName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      MemorySize: !Ref LambdaMemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref LambdaTimeout
      Role: !GetAtt ScannerLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          ACCESS_POINT_NAME: !Ref AccessPointName
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:accesspoint/${AccessPointName}'
          REPORT_TABLE_NAME: !Ref ScanReportTable
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN: !If [CreateTopic, !Ref ScanNotificationTopic, '']
          LANGUAGE_CODE: !Ref ComprehendLanguageCode
          MAX_FILES: !Ref MaxFilesPerInvocation
      VpcConfig: !If
        - HasVpc
        - SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
          SecurityGroupIds: !If [HasVpc, [!Ref SecurityGroupId], !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3
          import uuid
          import random
          from datetime import datetime, timezone

          s3 = boto3.client("s3")
          s3control = boto3.client("s3control")
          comprehend = boto3.client("comprehend")
          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["REPORT_TABLE_NAME"])
          sns = boto3.client("sns")

          ACCESS_POINT_NAME = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_NAME"]
          ACCESS_POINT_ARN = os.environ["ACCESS_POINT_ARN"]
          AWS_REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", os.environ["AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"])
          ACCOUNT_ID = os.environ.get("ACCOUNT_ID", "")
          SNS_TOPIC_ARN = os.environ.get("SNS_TOPIC_ARN", "")
          LANGUAGE_CODE = os.environ.get("LANGUAGE_CODE", "en")
          MAX_FILES = int(os.environ.get("MAX_FILES", "500"))
          MAX_CHUNK_BYTES = 450000

          def validate_config():
              if "replace-me" in ACCESS_POINT_NAME:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "The AccessPointName parameter still has its placeholder "
                      "default ('replace-me-access-point-name'). Re-deploy the "
                      "stack with the real pre-existing access point name."
                  )
              parts = ACCESS_POINT_ARN.split(":")
              if len(parts) != 6 or parts[0] != "arn" or parts[2] != "s3":
                  raise ValueError("Malformed access point ARN: " + ACCESS_POINT_ARN)
              if parts[3] != AWS_REGION:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point ARN region '{}' does not match the stack "
                      "region '{}'. The access point must live in the same "
                      "region as this stack.".format(parts[3], AWS_REGION)
                  )
              if ACCOUNT_ID and parts[4] != ACCOUNT_ID:
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point ARN account '{}' does not match the stack "
                      "account. The access point must live in the same account "
                      "as this stack.".format(parts[4])
                  )

          def check_access_point_network_origin():
              acct = ACCESS_POINT_ARN.split(":")[4]
              resp = s3control.get_access_point(AccountId=acct, Name=ACCESS_POINT_NAME)
              origin = resp.get("NetworkOrigin", "")
              if origin == "VPC":
                  vpc_cfg = resp.get("VpcConfiguration", {})
                  raise ValueError(
                      "Access point '{}' has VPC network origin (VPC: {}). "
                      "This stack must be deployed with the VpcId, SubnetIds, "
                      "SecurityGroupId and RouteTableIds parameters supplied so "
                      "the scanner Lambda can run inside that VPC.".format(
                          ACCESS_POINT_NAME, vpc_cfg.get("VpcId", "unknown")
                      )
                  )
              return origin

          def paginate_objects():
              paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2")
              for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN):
                  for obj in page.get("Contents", []):
                      yield obj["Key"]

          def chunk_bytes(data, size):
              for i in range(0, len(data), size):
                  yield data[i:i + size]

          def write_findings(ap_name, key, entities):
              for e in entities:
                  dynamodb.put_item(
                      Item={
                          "AccessPointName": ap_name,
                          "ObjectKey": key,
                          "FindingId": str(uuid.uuid4()),
                          "EntityType": e["Type"],
                          "Score": str(e["Score"]),
                          "BeginOffset": e["BeginOffset"],
                          "EndOffset": e["EndOffset"],
                          "ScannedAt": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
                      }
                  )

          def notify(subject, message):
              if SNS_TOPIC_ARN:
                  sns.publish(TopicArn=SNS_TOPIC_ARN, Subject=subject[:99], Message=message)

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              validate_config()
              origin = check_access_point_network_origin()
              sample_rate = float(event.get("sample_rate", 1.0))
              scan_summary = {
                  "files_scanned": 0,
                  "files_skipped": 0,
                  "chunks_processed": 0,
                  "findings": 0,
                  "network_origin": origin,
              }
              for key in paginate_objects():
                  if scan_summary["files_scanned"] >= MAX_FILES:
                      break
                  if sample_rate < 1.0 and random.random() > sample_rate:
                      scan_summary["files_skipped"] += 1
                      continue
                  try:
                      obj = s3.get_object(Bucket=ACCESS_POINT_ARN, Key=key)
                      body = obj["Body"].read()
                  except Exception as ex:
                      scan_summary["files_skipped"] += 1
                      print("Skipped {}: {}".format(key, ex))
                      continue
                  file_findings = []
                  for chunk in chunk_bytes(body, MAX_CHUNK_BYTES):
                      text = chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
                      try:
                          resp = comprehend.detect_pii_entities(
                              Text=text, LanguageCode=LANGUAGE_CODE
                          )
                          entities = resp.get("Entities", [])
                      except Exception as ex:
                          print("Comprehend failed for {}: {}".format(key, ex))
                          entities = []
                      scan_summary["chunks_processed"] += 1
                      if entities:
                          write_findings(ACCESS_POINT_NAME, key, entities)
                          file_findings.extend(e["Type"] for e in entities)
                  scan_summary["files_scanned"] += 1
                  scan_summary["findings"] += len(file_findings)
                  if file_findings:
                      notify(
                          "PII detected in {}".format(key),
                          "Access Point: {}\nObject: {}\nEntity types: {}\nCount: {}".format(
                              ACCESS_POINT_NAME, key,
                              sorted(set(file_findings)), len(file_findings)
                          ),
                      )
              notify("PII scan summary for " + ACCESS_POINT_NAME, json.dumps(scan_summary, indent=2))
              return scan_summary

Outputs:
  ScannerFunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the PII scanner Lambda function.
    Value: !GetAtt ScannerLambda.Arn
  ReportTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table holding classification reports.
    Value: !Ref ScanReportTable
  ExampleInvocation:
    Description: Example CLI invocation of the scanner.
    Value: !Sub >-
      aws lambda invoke --function-name ${ScannerLambda} --region ${AWS::Region}
      --payload '{"sample_rate": 1.0}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out
      response.json && cat response.json
