AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Creates two Glue databases (property graph and RDF) with tables for the
  air-routes dataset, including graph label metadata, Gremlin and SPARQL
  query parameters, and air-routes ontology URIs.

Parameters:
  LpgDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database
    Description: Name of the property graph (LPG) Glue database.
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: graph-database-rdf
    Description: Name of the RDF Glue database.

Resources:
  DataBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the graph data S3 bucket.
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowGlueServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: glue.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  DataBucketKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/graph-data-bucket-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataBucketKey

  DataBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref DataBucketKey
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled

  DataBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref DataBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: ForceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt DataBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${DataBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  GraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref LpgDatabaseName
        Description: Property graph (LPG) database for air-routes tables.

  RdfGraphDatabase:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Database
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseInput:
        Name: !Ref RdfDatabaseName
        Description: RDF database for air-routes tables.

  AirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          vertex: "true"
          gremlin.query: "g.V().hasLabel('airport').out('route').limit(10).project('src','dst').by(values('code')).by(values('code'))"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/airport/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  CountryTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: country
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          vertex: "true"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/country/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  ContinentTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: continent
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          vertex: "true"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/continent/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string

  RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          edge: "true"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/route/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: src
              Type: string
            - Name: dst
              Type: string
            - Name: airlinecode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  CustomAirportTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref GraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: customairport
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          graph: gremlin
          view: "true"
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/graph/customairport/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  AirportRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: airport_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          rdf-type: "true"
          classuri: 'class:Airport'
          querymode: class
          prefix.class: 'class:'
          prefix.datatypeProperty: 'datatypeProperty:'
          prefix.objectProperty: 'objectProperty:'
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/rdf/airport_rdf/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: code
              Type: string
            - Name: desc
              Type: string
            - Name: type
              Type: string
            - Name: country
              Type: string
            - Name: elev
              Type: int
            - Name: lat
              Type: double
            - Name: lon
              Type: double

  RouteRdfTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          rdf-type: "true"
          querymode: sparql
          stripuriprefix: "true"
          prefix.class: 'class:'
          prefix.datatypeProperty: 'datatypeProperty:'
          prefix.objectProperty: 'objectProperty:'
          sparql.query: >-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE { ?route a objectProperty:route ;
            datatypeProperty:incode ?incode ; datatypeProperty:outcode ?outcode ;
            datatypeProperty:dist ?dist . } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/rdf/route_rdf/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

  RouteRdfNoPfxTable:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Table
    DependsOn: DataBucket
    Properties:
      CatalogId: !Ref AWS::AccountId
      DatabaseName: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
      TableInput:
        Name: route_rdf_nopfx
        TableType: EXTERNAL_TABLE
        Parameters:
          classification: csv
          rdf-type: "true"
          querymode: sparql
          stripuriprefix: "true"
          sparql.query: >-
            SELECT ?incode ?outcode ?dist WHERE { ?route a
            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#route> ;
            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#incode> ?incode ;
            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#outcode> ?outcode ;
            <http://www.example.com/air-routes#dist> ?dist . } LIMIT 10
        StorageDescriptor:
          Location: !Sub 's3://${DataBucket}/rdf/route_rdf_nopfx/'
          InputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.mapred.TextInputFormat
          OutputFormat: org.apache.hadoop.hive.ql.io.HiveIgnoreKeyTextOutputFormat
          SerdeInfo:
            SerializationLibrary: org.apache.hadoop.hive.serde2.OpenCSVSerde
            Parameters:
              field.delim: ','
              separatorChar: ','
          Columns:
            - Name: incode
              Type: string
            - Name: outcode
              Type: string
            - Name: dist
              Type: int

Outputs:
  LpgDatabaseName:
    Description: Property graph (LPG) Glue database name.
    Value: !Ref GraphDatabase
  RdfDatabaseName:
    Description: RDF Glue database name.
    Value: !Ref RdfGraphDatabase
  DataBucketName:
    Description: S3 bucket backing the Glue table storage locations.
    Value: !Ref DataBucket
  DataBucketKeyId:
    Description: Customer managed KMS key ID used for bucket encryption.
    Value: !Ref DataBucketKey

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  PiBot Cognito authentication. Creates two independent Cognito setups: (1) the main
  web application with a user pool, user pool client, identity pool allowing
  unauthenticated identities, and authenticated/unauthenticated IAM roles granting
  IoT operations, Kinesis Video streaming, Rekognition label detection, and standard
  Cognito Sync / Mobile Analytics actions; (2) an IoT trusted user provisioning setup
  with its own user pool, client, identity pool, and roles where the authenticated role
  grants IoT trusted user provisioning actions. Roles are attached via
  IdentityPoolRoleAttachment resources to avoid circular dependencies.

Resources:

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Main web application setup
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------

  PiBotWebAppUserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: PiBotWebAppUserPool
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email

  PiBotWebAppUserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: PiBotWebAppClient
      UserPoolId: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_USER_PASSWORD_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH

  PiBotWebAppIdentityPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::IdentityPool
    Properties:
      IdentityPoolName: PiBotWebAppIdentityPool
      AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities: true
      CognitoIdentityProviders:
        - ClientId: !Ref PiBotWebAppUserPoolClient
          ProviderName: !Sub 'cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${PiBotWebAppUserPool}'

  PiBotWebAppAuthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotWebAppIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: authenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAppAuthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream
                  - kinesisvideo:GetDataEndpoint
                  - kinesisvideo:PutMedia
                  - rekognition:DetectLabels
                  - cognito-identity:*
                  - cognito-sync:*
                  - mobileanalytics:PutEvents
                Resource: '*'

  PiBotWebAppUnauthenticatedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Federated: cognito-identity.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud: !Sub '${PiBotWebAppIdentityPool}'
              ForAnyValue:StringLike:
                cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr: unauthenticated
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PiBotWebAppUnauthenticatedAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iot:Connect
                  - iot:Publish
                  - iot:Subscribe
                  - iot:Receive
                  - iot:GetThingShadow
                  - iot:UpdateThingShadow
                  - iot:DeleteThingShadow
                  - kinesisvideo:ListStreams
                  - kinesisvideo:DescribeStream
                  - kinesisvideo:CreateStream

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Deploys a Bedrock AgentCore Gateway and Gateway Target for MCP integration
  supporting protein variant effect prediction. Two-phase workflow: deploy
  with DeployGateway=false (default) in a greenfield account to create the
  resolver, IAM role, and SSM role-ARN parameter; after a bootstrap stack
  creates the backend Lambda, Cognito authorizer, and SSM parameters
  (/agentcore/prediction-lambda-arn, /agentcore/cognito/discovery-url,
  /agentcore/cognito/client-id), update with DeployGateway=true so the
  resolver re-reads SSM and the gateway is created with real config. AgentCore
  validates the discovery hostname at create time, so placeholders cannot be
  used for the gateway itself. Check ConfigResolutionStatus before production.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: protein-engineering
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,62}$'
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and SSM parameter paths.
  GatewayDescription:
    Type: String
    Default: AgentCore Gateway for protein variant effect prediction MCP tools
    Description: Description applied to the AgentCore Gateway.
  GatewayName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: '^(|[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,62})$'
    Description: Optional gateway name. Auto-generated from ProjectName if blank.
  DeployGateway:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Set to 'true' only after the bootstrap stack has populated the required SSM parameters.

Conditions:
  UseDefaultGatewayName: !Equals [!Ref GatewayName, '']
  CreateGateway: !Equals [!Ref DeployGateway, 'true']

Resources:
  SsmConfigResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-resolver-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: get-ssm-config
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:GetParameter
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/agentcore/*'

  SsmConfigResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-ssm-config-resolver'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60

        - !Ref GatewayName
      Description: !Ref GatewayDescription

      ProtocolType: MCP
      AuthorizerType: CUSTOM_JWT

          AllowedClients:

      Description: MCP tools for submitting protein sequences and retrieving variant effect prediction results
      TargetConfiguration:
        Mcp:
          Lambda:
            LambdaArn: !GetAtt SsmConfigResolver.LambdaArn
            ToolSchema:
              - Name: invoke_endpoint
                Description: Submit protein sequences for variant effect prediction
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:

                      Type: string
                      Description: Amino acid sequence to predict variant effects for
                    mutations:
                      Type: array
                      Description: List of variant mutations to evaluate
                      Items:
                        Type: string
                  Required:
                    - sequence
              - Name: get_results
                Description: Check job completion status and retrieve prediction results
                InputSchema:
                  Type: object
                  Properties:
                    job_id:
                      Type: string
                      Description: Identifier of the prediction job to query
                  Required:
                    - job_id
      CredentialProviderConfigurations:
        - CredentialProviderType: GATEWAY_IAM_ROLE

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private VPC infrastructure with ALB subnets, Lambda subnet, optional NAT egress, KMS-encrypted artifact bucket.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  AlbSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR for ALB subnet in first AZ.
  AlbSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR for ALB subnet in second AZ.
  LambdaSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR for Lambda subnet in third AZ.
  PublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.4.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR for public subnet hosting the NAT Gateway.
  EnableNatEgress:
    Type: String
    Default: 'true'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create NAT Gateway internet egress for OAuth/IdP flows.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    Description: Environment tag value applied to all resources.

Conditions:
  CreateNatEgress: !Equals
    - !Ref EnableNatEgress
    - 'true'

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref AlbSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref LambdaSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 2
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-rt-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet2RouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-alb-rt-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  LambdaSubnetRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-lambda-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbSubnet1RouteTable

  AlbSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref AlbSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbSubnet2RouteTable

  LambdaSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref LambdaSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref LambdaSubnetRouteTable

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlbSubnet1NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbSubnet1RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  AlbSubnet2NatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref AlbSubnet2RouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  LambdaSubnetNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNatEgress
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref LambdaSubnetRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer-managed key for artifact storage bucket encryption
      Enabled: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-kms-key'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/${AWS::StackName}-artifact-key'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  ArtifactBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-artifact-bucket'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArtifactBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArtifactBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyUnencryptedUploads
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringNotEquals:
                s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption: aws:kms
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref AlbSubnet1RouteTable
        - !Ref AlbSubnet2RouteTable
        - !Ref LambdaSubnetRouteTable
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowAccessToArtifactBucket
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:ListBucket
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${ArtifactBucket.Arn}/*'

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  AlbSubnet1Id:
    Description: ALB subnet ID in first AZ
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet1
  AlbSubnet2Id:
    Description: ALB subnet ID in second AZ
    Value: !Ref AlbSubnet2
  LambdaSubnetId:
    Description: Lambda subnet ID
    Value: !Ref LambdaSubnet
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key ARN for artifact encryption
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  ArtifactBucketArn:
    Description: Artifact bucket ARN
    Value: !GetAtt ArtifactBucket.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Step Functions two-step Pass workflow with two API Gateway REST APIs (GET and POST) that start executions.

Resources:
  StateMachineExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StateMachineCloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'

  StateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: two-step-pass-workflow
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineExecutionRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: |
        {
          "Comment": "Simple two-step Pass workflow",
          "StartAt": "StepOne",
          "States": {
            "StepOne": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {"step": "one"},
              "ResultPath": "$.stepOne",
              "Next": "StepTwo"
            },
            "StepTwo": {
              "Type": "Pass",
              "Result": {"step": "two"},
              "ResultPath": "$.stepTwo",
              "End": true
            }
          }
        }

  ApiGetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionGetApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  ApiPostRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: StartExecutionPostApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

  GetRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: get-start-execution-api
      Description: API exposing GET method to start Step Functions execution

  GetRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt GetRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiGetRole.Arn
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '.*\[BadRequest\].*'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
        - StatusCode: '400'

  GetApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: GetRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi

  GetApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref GetRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref GetApiDeployment
      StageName: get-stage

  PostRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: post-start-execution-api
      Description: API exposing POST method to start Step Functions execution

  PostRootMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      ResourceId: !GetAtt PostRestApi.RootResourceId
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:states:action/StartExecution
        Credentials: !GetAtt ApiPostRole.Arn
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
          - StatusCode: '400'
            SelectionPattern: '.*\[BadRequest\].*'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: !Sub |
            {
              "stateMachineArn": "${StateMachine.Arn}",
              "input": "$util.escapeJavaScript($input.json('$'))"
            }
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
        - StatusCode: '400'

  PostApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn: PostRootMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi

  PostApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref PostRestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref PostApiDeployment
      StageName: post-stage

Outputs:
  GetApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: GET API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub https://${GetRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/get-stage
  PostApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: POST API endpoint URL
    Value: !Sub https://${PostRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/post-stage
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: State machine ARN
    Value: !GetAtt StateMachine.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Foundation IAM roles and Secrets Manager resources for the Hospitality Insights project.
  Defines Lambda execution roles for scraper, analysis, alerts, API, admin, and archival
  microservices, a Bedrock AgentCore runtime role, and placeholder Secrets Manager secrets.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights
    Description: Project name used in resource names and tags.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Environment name used in resource names, ARN scopes, and tags.

Resources:

  ScraperLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-scraper-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: SqsSend
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:SendMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: SnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: S3Write
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AnalysisLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-analysis-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ComprehendActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - comprehend:DetectSentiment
                  - comprehend:DetectEntities
                  - comprehend:DetectKeyPhrases
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: BedrockInvoke
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: S3ReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AlertsLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-alerts-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: SnsPublish
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sns:Publish
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ApiLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-api-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: StepFunctions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:StartExecution
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AdminLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-admin-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: SqsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sqs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: SnsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sns:GetTopicAttributes
                  - sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: S3Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: SecretsRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
                  - secretsmanager:DescribeSecret
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: StepFunctionsDescribe
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:states:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:stateMachine:${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: BedrockRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource: arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ArchivalLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-archival-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-archival-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: S3Write
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:AbortMultipartUpload
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBReadExport
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:ExportTableToPointInTime
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*/export/*'
              - Sid: S3ExportRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/exports/*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  BedrockAgentCoreRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-runtime-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${Environment}-agentcore-inline'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: BedrockModelInvocation
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: arn:aws:bedrock:*::foundation-model/*
              - Sid: BedrockAgentSession
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock-agentcore:InvokeAgent
                  - bedrock-agentcore:Retrieve
                  - bedrock-agentcore:RetrieveAndGenerate
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateInvocation
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetInvocation
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListInvocations
                  - bedrock-agentcore:CreateInvocationStep
                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetInvocationStep
                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListInvocationSteps
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:bedrock-agentcore:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:runtime/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: DynamoDBRead
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
              - Sid: S3Read
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}/${Environment}/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:s3:::${ProjectName}-${Environment}-*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrefixPlaceholderSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/prefix'
      Description: !Sub 'Naming prefix placeholder establishing ${ProjectName}/${Environment} convention'
      SecretString: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ScrapingBeeApiKeySecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/${Environment}/scrapingbee-api-key'
      Description: ScrapingBee API key (placeholder - rotate with a real value after creation)
      GenerateSecretString:
        SecretStringTemplate: '{}'
        GenerateStringKey: apiKey
        PasswordLength: 32
        ExcludePunctuation: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  ScraperLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the scraper Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ScraperLambdaRole.Arn
  AnalysisLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the analysis Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt AnalysisLambdaRole.Arn
  AlertsLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the alerts Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt AlertsLambdaRole.Arn
  ApiLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the API Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ApiLambdaRole.Arn
  AdminLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the admin Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt AdminLambdaRole.Arn
  ArchivalLambdaRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the archival Lambda execution role
    Value: !GetAtt ArchivalLambdaRole.Arn
  BedrockAgentCoreRuntimeRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the Bedrock AgentCore runtime role
    Value: !GetAtt BedrockAgentCoreRuntimeRole.Arn
  PrefixSecretArn:
    Description: ARN of the Secrets Manager prefix placeholder secret
    Value: !Ref PrefixPlaceholderSecret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SQS audit event queue with KMS encryption, DLQ, CloudWatch alarms, and SNS notifications.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: audit-events
    Description: Application name used for tagging and resource naming.
  AlarmEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: ops@example.com
    Description: Email address for alarm notifications.
  AlarmProtocol:
    Type: String
    Default: email
    AllowedValues:
      - email
      - email-json
      - https
    Description: Protocol for the SNS subscription.
  AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3600
    Description: Seconds before the oldest-message alarm fires.
  MaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 3
    Description: Number of receives before a message is moved to the DLQ.

Conditions:
  IsNonDev: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Environment, dev]]
  ProdLikeRetention: !Equals [!Ref Environment, prod]
  StagingRetention: !Equals [!Ref Environment, staging]

Resources:
  QueueKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName} audit queue (${Environment})'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sqs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'KMS key for ${ApplicationName} alarm topic (${Environment})'
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootAccount
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:ViaService: !Sub 'sns.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
                kms:CallerAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  DeadLetterQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-dlq-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 1209600
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 604800
          - 86400
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AuditQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      QueueName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref QueueKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      MessageRetentionPeriod: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 1209600
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 604800
          - 86400
      VisibilityTimeout: !If
        - ProdLikeRetention
        - 300
        - !If
          - StagingRetention
          - 240
          - 120
      RedrivePolicy: !If
        - IsNonDev
        - !Sub
          - '{"deadLetterTargetArn":"${DLQArn}","maxReceiveCount":${MaxReceiveCount}}'
          - DLQArn: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
        - !Ref 'AWS::NoValue'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-alarms-${Environment}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlarmTopicKey
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  AlarmSubscription:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Subscription
    Properties:
      TopicArn: !Ref AlarmTopic
      Protocol: !Ref AlarmProtocol
      Endpoint: !Ref AlarmEmail

  OldestMessageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}-oldest-message-age'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when the oldest message in the audit queue exceeds the threshold.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Maximum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: !Ref AgeOfOldestMessageThreshold
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

  DlqAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-audit-${Environment}-dlq-messages'
      AlarmDescription: Alarm when messages appear in the dead letter queue.
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.QueueName
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlarmTopic

Outputs:
  AuditQueueUrl:
    Description: URL of the primary audit queue.
    Value: !Ref AuditQueue
  AuditQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the primary audit queue.
    Value: !GetAtt AuditQueue.Arn
  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: ARN of the dead letter queue.
    Value: !GetAtt DeadLetterQueue.Arn
  AlarmTopicArn:
    Description: ARN of the alarm notification topic.
    Value: !Ref AlarmTopic
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for queue encryption.
    Value: !GetAtt QueueKey.Arn
  AlarmTopicKmsKeyArn:
    Description: ARN of the KMS key used for the alarm topic.
    Value: !GetAtt AlarmTopicKey.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Cognito User Pool for researchapp/AgentCore with MFA (optional TOTP), email-as-username,
  admin/customer groups, custom resource server read scope, web (auth code) and
  machine (client credentials) clients, a standalone Lambda to add users to the
  customer group, and SSM parameters under /app/researchapp/agentcore/.
  NOTE: The Cognito domain prefix is globally unique across all AWS accounts.
  The default may be taken in your region; override the DomainPrefix parameter
  if deployment fails with an availability error.

Parameters:
  UserPoolName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateGatewayPool
    Description: Name of the Cognito User Pool.
  MachineAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateMachineClient
    Description: Name of the machine-to-machine app client.
  WebAppClientName:
    Type: String
    Default: TemplateWebClient
    Description: Name of the web app client.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: researchapp-agentcore-tmpl
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9\-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    Description: >-
      Globally unique lowercase Cognito domain prefix (3-63 chars, lowercase
      letters, numbers, hyphens). Must be unique across all AWS accounts in the region.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Ref UserPoolName
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Welcome to researchapp. Your verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'researchapp - Verify your email'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  CustomerGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: customer
      Precedence: 2
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      Identifier: !Ref UserPool
      Name: researchapp-resource-server
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: read
          ScopeDescription: Read access to researchapp resources

  WebAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref WebAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
        - !Sub '${UserPool}/read'
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:8501/
        - https://example.com/auth/callback
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  MachineAppClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Ref MachineAppClientName
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub '${UserPool}/read'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoGroupManagement
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:ListUsersInGroup
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
        - PolicyName: CloudWatchLogs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'

  AddUserToCustomerGroupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${UserPoolName}-add-to-customer-group'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          USER_POOL_ID: !Ref UserPool
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          cognito = boto3.client("cognito-idp")

          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              user_pool_id = os.environ["USER_POOL_ID"]
              username = event.get("userName") or event.get("username")
              if not username:
                  raise ValueError("userName is required")
              cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                  UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                  GroupName="customer",
                  Username=username,
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": f"User {username} added to customer group"}

  SSMUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/user-pool-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SSMWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/web-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebAppClient

  SSMMachineClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref MachineAppClient

  SSMMachineClientSecret:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /app/researchapp/agentcore/machine-client-secret

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL API for cryptocurrency ticker data backed by DynamoDB.

Resources:
  CryptoTickerAPI:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: CryptoTickerAPI
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY
      XrayEnabled: false

  CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Definition: |
        type Query {
          ticker(symbol: String!): TickerInfo
        }

        type TickerInfo {
          symbol: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
          priceHistory(limit: Int, nextToken: String): PriceHistoryConnection
        }

        type PriceRecord {
          ticker: String
          price: Float
          timestamp: String
        }

        type PriceHistoryConnection {
          items: [PriceRecord]
          nextToken: String
        }

  CryptoTickerAPIKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    DependsOn: CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId

  APIDataTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: APIDataTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: hk
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: sk
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: hk
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: sk
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  DynamoDBAccessRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole

  DynamoDBAccessPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: AppSyncDynamoDBAccess
      Roles:
        - !Ref DynamoDBAccessRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:PutItem
              - dynamodb:Query
              - dynamodb:GetItem
              - dynamodb:Scan
            Resource: !GetAtt APIDataTable.Arn

  CoinGeckoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: CoinGeckoDataSource
      Type: HTTP
      HttpConfig:
        Endpoint: https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3

  APIDataTableDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: APIDataTableDataSource
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt DynamoDBAccessRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref APIDataTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  FetchCoinGeckoPriceFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - CoinGeckoDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: FetchCoinGeckoPrice
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt CoinGeckoDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "method": "GET",
          "resourcePath": "/simple/price",
          "params": {
            "query": {
              "ids": "$ctx.args.symbol",
              "vs_currencies": "usd"
            }
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.result)
          #set($price = $ctx.result.get("$ctx.args.symbol").get("usd"))
          #set($timestamp = $util.time.nowISO8601())
          {
            "symbol": "$ctx.args.symbol",
            "price": $price,
            "timestamp": "$timestamp"
          }
        #else
          $util.error("Unable to fetch price for symbol $ctx.args.symbol")
        #end

  PutPriceRecordFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - APIDataTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      Name: PutPriceRecord
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      FunctionVersion: '2018-05-29'
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "operation": "PutItem",
          "key": {
            "hk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.symbol),
            "sk": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          },
          "attributeValues": {
            "ticker": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.symbol),
            "price": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.price),
            "timestamp": $util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.prev.result.timestamp)
          }
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.result)

  TickerResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - FetchCoinGeckoPriceFunction
      - PutPriceRecordFunction
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: Query
      FieldName: ticker
      Kind: PIPELINE
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        {
          "version": "2018-05-29",
          "payload": {}
        }
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        $util.toJson($ctx.prev.result)
      PipelineConfig:
        Functions:
          - !GetAtt FetchCoinGeckoPriceFunction.FunctionId
          - !GetAtt PutPriceRecordFunction.FunctionId

  PriceHistoryResolver:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::Resolver
    DependsOn:
      - CryptoTickerGraphQLSchema
      - APIDataTableDataSource
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt CryptoTickerAPI.ApiId
      TypeName: TickerInfo
      FieldName: priceHistory
      Kind: UNIT
      DataSourceName: !GetAtt APIDataTableDataSource.Name
      RequestMappingTemplate: |
        #set($request = {})
        $request.put("version", "2018-05-29")
        $request.put("operation", "Query")
        $request.put("scanIndexForward", false)
        $request.put("limit", $util.defaultIfNull($ctx.args.limit, 25))
        #set($q = {})
        $q.put("expression", "hk = :hk")
        #set($e = {})
        $e.put(":hk", $util.parseJson($util.dynamodb.toDynamoDBJson($ctx.source.symbol)))
        $q.put("expressionValues", $e)
        $request.put("query", $q)
        #if($ctx.args.nextToken)
          $request.put("exclusiveStartKey", $util.parseJson($util.base64Decode($ctx.args.nextToken).toString()))
        #end
        $util.toJson($request)
      ResponseMappingTemplate: |
        #if($ctx.error)
          $util.error($ctx.error.message, $ctx.error.type)
        #end
        #set($result = {})
        $result.put("items", $ctx.result.items)
        #if($ctx.result.nextToken)
          $result.put("nextToken", $util.base64Encode($ctx.result.nextToken.toString()))
        #end
        $util.toJson($result)
