AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  MediaPackage v2 live streaming channel group/channel with conditional HLS and/or
  DASH origin endpoints, conditional S3 archive and VOD source buckets
  (KMS-encrypted with an in-template CMK) with a MediaPackage access role,
  and environment/custom tagging.

Parameters:
  LogicalResourceNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: livestream
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$
    MaxLength: 64
    Description: Logical prefix used for resource names.
  NameSuffix:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]*$
    MaxLength: 32
    Description: >
      Optional suffix appended to MediaPackage resource names to guarantee
      uniqueness against any orphaned resources from prior deployments.
  HlsSegmentDurationSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 6
    Description: Segment duration in seconds for the HLS endpoint.
  ManifestName:
    Type: String
    Default: index
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,256}$
    Description: Manifest name for the origin endpoints.
  StartoverWindowSeconds:
    Type: Number
    Default: 300
    Description: Startover window in seconds for both endpoints.
  OutputType:
    Type: String
    Default: APPLE_HLS
    AllowedValues:
      - APPLE_HLS
      - ISO_DASH
      - ALL
    Description: Which origin endpoint(s) to create.
  ArchiveBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: >
      If supplied (non-empty), the archive S3 bucket is named with this value to
      support live-to-VOD workflows.
  VodSourceBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: ^([a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?$
    MaxLength: 63
    Description: >
      If supplied (non-empty), the VOD source S3 bucket is named with this value.
  EnvironmentTag:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag applied to all taggable resources.
  CustomTagKey:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag key.
  CustomTagValue:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional custom tag value.

Conditions:
  HasArchiveBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ArchiveBucketName, ""]]
  HasVodBucket: !Not [!Equals [!Ref VodSourceBucketName, ""]]
  HasCustomTag: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CustomTagKey, ""]]
  IsOutputTypeAll: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ALL"]
  IsOutputTypeHls: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "APPLE_HLS"]
  IsOutputTypeDash: !Equals [!Ref OutputType, "ISO_DASH"]
  CreateHlsEndpoint: !Or [!Condition IsOutputTypeHls, !Condition IsOutputTypeAll]
  CreateDashEndpoint: !Or [!Condition IsOutputTypeDash, !Condition IsOutputTypeAll]

Resources:
  MediaPackageBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "Customer managed key for ${LogicalResourceNamePrefix} MediaPackage S3 buckets"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasVodBucket
        - !Ref VodSourceBucketName
        - !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-vod-source-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  VodSourceBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref VodSourceBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt VodSourceBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  ArchiveBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !If
        - HasArchiveBucket
        - !Ref ArchiveBucketName
        - !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-archive-${AWS::Region}-${AWS::AccountId}"
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  ArchiveBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ArchiveBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: "s3:*"
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: false

  MediaPackageRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: mediapackage.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mediapackage-s3-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: ReadVodSource
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${VodSourceBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ArchiveReadWrite
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "${ArchiveBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Sid: ArchiveList
                Effect: Allow
                Action: s3:ListBucket
                Resource: !GetAtt ArchiveBucket.Arn
              - Sid: KmsBucketKeyUse
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt MediaPackageBucketKey.Arn

  LiveChannelGroup:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::ChannelGroup
    Properties:
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      Description: Channel group for the live streaming workflow
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  LiveChannel:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::Channel
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      Description: Live streaming channel
      InputType: HLS
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  # NOTE: MediaPackage v2 has no per-endpoint "Origination" ALLOW/DENY control
  # equivalent to v1. The live-to-VOD intent (DENY when ArchiveBucketName is
  # supplied) is preserved by gating the archive bucket provisioning; harvesting
  # is performed against the channel/endpoint by the downstream harvester.
  HlsOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateHlsEndpoint
    Properties:
      OriginEndpointName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-hls${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      ContainerType: TS
      Description: HLS origin endpoint
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Segment:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: !Ref HlsSegmentDurationSeconds
      HlsManifests:
        - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentTag
        - !If
          - HasCustomTag
          - Key: !Ref CustomTagKey
            Value: !Ref CustomTagValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  DashOriginEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::MediaPackageV2::OriginEndpoint
    Condition: CreateDashEndpoint
    Properties:
      OriginEndpointName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-dash${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-channel${NameSuffix}"
      ChannelGroupName: !Sub "${LogicalResourceNamePrefix}-group${NameSuffix}"
      ContainerType: CMAF
      Description: DASH origin endpoint
      StartoverWindowSeconds: !Ref StartoverWindowSeconds
      Segment:
        SegmentDurationSeconds: 2
      DashManifests:
        - ManifestName: !Ref ManifestName
      Tags:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >-
  IAM roles, instance profiles, and managed policies for the Cluster API
  Provider AWS (CAPA), covering EC2-based and EKS-based cluster lifecycle
  management.

Resources:

  CAPAControlPlanePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-control-plane
      Description: Broad permissions for CAPA control plane (EC2, ELB, ASG, KMS).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:*
            Resource: '*'

  CAPAControllersPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers
      Description: Extensive permissions for CAPA controllers (EC2, ELB, ASG, IAM, EKS).
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - elasticloadbalancing:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - autoscaling:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateAccessEntry
              - eks:DeleteAccessEntry
              - eks:DescribeAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAccessEntries
              - eks:UpdateAccessEntry
              - eks:ListAssociatedAccessPolicies
              - eks:AssociateAccessPolicy
              - eks:DisassociateAccessPolicy
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource:
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/autoscaling.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAutoScaling'
              - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/eks.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForAmazonEKS'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com
                  - autoscaling.amazonaws.com
                  - eks.amazonaws.com

  CAPAControllersEKSPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-controllers-eks
      Description: EKS cluster and nodegroup management permissions for CAPA.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - eks:CreateCluster
              - eks:DescribeCluster
              - eks:UpdateClusterVersion
              - eks:UpdateClusterConfig
              - eks:DeleteCluster
              - eks:CreateNodegroup
              - eks:DescribeNodegroup
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupVersion
              - eks:UpdateNodegroupConfig
              - eks:DeleteNodegroup
              - eks:ListClusters
              - eks:ListNodegroups
              - eks:DescribeUpdate
              - eks:TagResource
              - eks:UntagResource
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetPolicy
              - iam:GetPolicyVersion
              - iam:PassRole
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - kms:CreateGrant
              - kms:DescribeKey
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
              - kms:ReEncryptFrom
              - kms:ReEncryptTo
              - kms:ListGrants
              - kms:RevokeGrant
              - kms:RetireGrant
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringLike:
                kms:RequestAlias: 'alias/cluster-api-provider-aws-*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                iam:AWSServiceName:
                  - eks.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-nodegroup.amazonaws.com
                  - eks-fargate-pods.amazonaws.com

  CAPANodesPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      ManagedPolicyName: capa-nodes
      Description: Node permissions for CAPA-managed Kubernetes worker nodes.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:DescribeInstances
              - ec2:DescribeRegions
              - ec2:DescribeVolumes
              - ec2:DescribeTags
              - ec2:AttachVolume
              - ec2:DetachVolume
              - ec2:CreateTags
              - ec2:DeleteTags
              - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
              - ec2:AssignPrivateIpAddresses
              - ec2:UnassignPrivateIpAddresses
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage
              - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
              - ecr:UploadLayerPart
              - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
              - ecr:PutImage
            Resource: '*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - secretsmanager:GetSecretValue
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:secretsmanager:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:secret:aws.cluster.x-k8s.io/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:GetParameter
              - ssm:GetParameters
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/*'
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::capa-bootstrap-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}/*'

  CAPAControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlanePolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy

  CAPAControllersRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-controllers
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pods.eks.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - sts:AssumeRole
              - sts:TagSession
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersPolicy
        - !Ref CAPAControllersEKSPolicy

  CAPANodesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-nodes
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSWorkerNodePolicy'
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKS_CNI_Policy'
        - !Ref CAPANodesPolicy

  CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-control-plane
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControlPlaneRole

  CAPAControllersInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-controllers
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPAControllersRole

  CAPANodesInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      InstanceProfileName: capa-nodes
      Path: /
      Roles:
        - !Ref CAPANodesRole

  EKSControlPlaneRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: capa-eks-control-plane
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/AmazonEKSClusterPolicy'

Outputs:

  ControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA control plane role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControlPlaneRole.Arn

  ControllersRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA controllers role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPAControllersRole.Arn

  NodesRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the CAPA nodes role.
    Value: !GetAtt CAPANodesRole.Arn

  ControlPlaneInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA control plane instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPAControlPlaneInstanceProfile

  ControllersInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA controllers instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPAControllersInstanceProfile

  NodesInstanceProfile:
    Description: Name of the CAPA nodes instance profile.
    Value: !Ref CAPANodesInstanceProfile

  EKSControlPlaneRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the dedicated EKS control plane role.
    Value: !GetAtt EKSControlPlaneRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Configurable DynamoDB table with optional sort key, billing mode switch,
  point-in-time recovery, optional customer-managed KMS encryption, and
  optional CloudWatch alarms publishing to an encrypted SNS topic.

Parameters:
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "id"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$"
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute.
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: Type of the partition key attribute.
  UseSortKey:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Whether to define a sort key.
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: "sortKey"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$"
    Description: Name of the sort key attribute.
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
    Description: Type of the sort key attribute.
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
    Description: DynamoDB billing mode.
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Read capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Write capacity units (used only when BillingMode is PROVISIONED).
  EnablePITR:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Enable point-in-time recovery.
  EnableCMK:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Use a customer-managed KMS key for server-side encryption.
  EnableAlerting:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
    Description: Create CloudWatch alarms and an SNS topic for alerting.
  AlarmThreshold:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Threshold for alarm metrics (sum over period).
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: "Optional custom table name. Leave empty to let DynamoDB auto-generate."
  Application:
    Type: String
    Default: "myapp"
    Description: Application tag value.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: "dev"
    AllowedValues: ["dev", "test", "staging", "prod"]
    Description: Environment tag value.

Conditions:
  HasSortKey: !Equals [!Ref UseSortKey, "true"]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnablePITR, "true"]
  CMKEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableCMK, "true"]
  AlertingEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableAlerting, "true"]
  HasCustomTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]]

Resources:
  Table:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasCustomTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      AttributeDefinitions: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
      KeySchema: !If
        - HasSortKey
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
        - - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
            KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      SSESpecification: !If
        - CMKEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
          KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KMSKey
        - !Ref "AWS::NoValue"
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref Application
        - Key: Environment

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  EC2 Image Builder pipeline building custom Amazon Linux 2023 AMIs for x86_64
  and arm64 with Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access.
  AMIs are distributed publicly and shared with an AWS Organization.

Parameters:
  X86RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-al2023-x86-recipe
    Description: Name of the x86_64 image recipe.
  Arm64RecipeName:
    Type: String
    Default: custom-al2023-arm64-recipe
    Description: Name of the arm64 image recipe.
  ImageVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: 1.0.0
    AllowedPattern: ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$
    Description: Semantic version for the image recipes and pipelines.
  RootVolumeSize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 32
    MinValue: 8
    MaxValue: 1024
    Description: Root EBS volume size in GiB for the built AMIs.
  OrganizationId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    AllowedPattern: ^$|^o-[a-z0-9]{10,32}$
    Description: >
      Optional AWS Organization ID (o-xxxxxxxxxx) to share the AMIs with.
      Leave empty to skip organization sharing.

Conditions:
  HasOrganizationId: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OrganizationId, '']]

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  BuildSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-subnet'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  SubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  BuilderSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Image Builder build instances and VPC endpoints
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable

  SSMEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssm'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  SSMMessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ssmmessages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  EC2MessagesEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ec2messages'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref BuildSubnet
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true

  ImageBuilderInstanceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:DescribeAssociation
                  - ssm:GetDeployablePatchSnapshotForInstance
                  - ssm:GetDocument
                  - ssm:DescribeDocument
                  - ssm:GetManifest
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:ListAssociations
                  - ssm:ListInstanceAssociations
                  - ssm:PutInventory
                  - ssm:PutComplianceItems
                  - ssm:PutConfigurePackageResult
                  - ssm:UpdateAssociationStatus
                  - ssm:UpdateInstanceAssociationStatus
                  - ssm:UpdateInstanceInformation
                  - ssmmessages:CreateControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:CreateDataChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenControlChannel
                  - ssmmessages:OpenDataChannel
                  - ec2messages:AcknowledgeMessage
                  - ec2messages:GetEndpoint
                  - ec2messages:GetMessages
                  - ec2messages:SendReply
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponent
                  - imagebuilder:GetComponentVersion
                  - imagebuilder:GetInfrastructureConfiguration
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponents
                  - imagebuilder:ListComponentVersions
                  - imagebuilder:ListInfrastructureConfigurations
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:PutImage
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-instance-role'

  ImageBuilderInstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceRole

  ImageBuilderPipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: imagebuilder.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-policy'
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - imagebuilder:*
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ec2:DescribeSnapshots
                  - ec2:CreateSnapshot
                  - ec2:RegisterImage
                  - ec2:CreateTags
                  - ec2:ModifyImageAttribute
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                  - sns:Publish
                  - lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-pipeline-role'

  SoftwareComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-software-component'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Installs Docker, Docker Compose, Python packages, and SSM sudo access
      Data: |
        name: SoftwareInstallation
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: build
            steps:
              - name: InstallPackages
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - dnf install -y docker python3.12 python3.12-pip
                    - systemctl enable docker
                    - curl -SL https://github.com/docker/compose/releases/latest/download/docker-compose-linux-x86_64 -o /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - chmod +x /usr/local/bin/docker-compose
                    - ln -sf /usr/local/bin/docker-compose /usr/bin/docker-compose
                    - python3.12 -m pip install --no-cache-dir synapseclient pandas pysftp
                    - echo 'ssm-user ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user
                    - chmod 440 /etc/sudoers.d/ssm-user

  TestComponent:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::Component
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-test-component'
      Platform: Linux
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      Description: Verifies Docker Compose and Python package imports
      Data: |
        name: VerificationTests
        schemaVersion: 1.0
        phases:
          - name: test
            steps:
              - name: VerifyDockerCompose
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - docker-compose --version
              - name: VerifyPythonImports
                action: ExecuteBash
                inputs:
                  commands:
                    - python3.12 -c "import synapseclient, pandas, pysftp"

  X86ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref X86RecipeName
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-x86_64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-recipe'

  Arm64ImageRecipe:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImageRecipe
    Properties:
      Name: !Ref Arm64RecipeName
      Version: !Ref ImageVersion
      ParentImage: ssm:/aws/service/ami-amazon-linux-latest/al2023-ami-kernel-default-arm64
      Components:
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt SoftwareComponent.Arn
        - ComponentArn: !GetAtt TestComponent.Arn
      BlockDeviceMappings:
        - DeviceName: /dev/xvda
          Ebs:
            VolumeSize: !Ref RootVolumeSize
            VolumeType: gp3
            DeleteOnTermination: true
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-recipe'

  InfrastructureConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::InfrastructureConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'
      InstanceProfileName: !Ref ImageBuilderInstanceProfile
      InstanceTypes:
        - m6i.large
        - m7g.large
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !GetAtt BuilderSecurityGroup.GroupId
      SubnetId: !Ref BuildSubnet
      InstanceMetadataOptions:
        HttpTokens: required
        HttpPutResponseHopLimit: 2
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-infra-config'

  X86DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-dist-config'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-x86_64-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 x86_64 AMI built by Image Builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration: !If
              - HasOrganizationId
              - UserGroups:
                  - all
                OrganizationArns:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              - UserGroups:
                  - all
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
              Architecture: x86_64
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-dist-config'

  Arm64DistributionConfiguration:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::DistributionConfiguration
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-dist-config'
      Distributions:
        - Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          AmiDistributionConfiguration:
            Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-al2023-arm64-${ImageVersion}-{{ imagebuilder:buildDate }}'
            Description: Custom Amazon Linux 2023 arm64 AMI built by Image Builder
            LaunchPermissionConfiguration: !If
              - HasOrganizationId
              - UserGroups:
                  - all
                OrganizationArns:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:organizations::${AWS::AccountId}:organization/${OrganizationId}'
              - UserGroups:
                  - all
            AmiTags:
              StackName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}'
              Architecture: arm64
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-dist-config'

  X86ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline'
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt X86ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt X86DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: rate(7 days)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-x86-pipeline'

  Arm64ImagePipeline:
    Type: AWS::ImageBuilder::ImagePipeline
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline'
      ImageRecipeArn: !GetAtt Arm64ImageRecipe.Arn
      InfrastructureConfigurationArn: !GetAtt InfrastructureConfiguration.Arn
      DistributionConfigurationArn: !GetAtt Arm64DistributionConfiguration.Arn
      ImageTestsConfiguration:
        ImageTestsEnabled: true
        TimeoutMinutes: 60
      Schedule:
        ScheduleExpression: rate(7 days)
        PipelineExecutionStartCondition: EXPRESSION_MATCH_ONLY
      Tags:
        Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-arm64-pipeline'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: AgentOps e-commerce analytics demo - Cognito User Pool with seeded test users

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: agentops-ecommerce-users
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      MfaConfiguration: OPTIONAL
      EnabledMfas:
        - SOFTWARE_TOKEN_MFA
      EmailVerificationMessage: 'Your AgentOps demo verification code is {####}.'
      EmailVerificationSubject: 'AgentOps Demo - Verify your email'
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 8
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: false
      Schema:
        - Name: role
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
          StringAttributeConstraints:
            MinLength: '1'
            MaxLength: '256'

  UserPoolResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: agentops-demo
      Name: agentops-demo-resource-server

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: agentops-web-client
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      CallbackURLs:
        - http://localhost:3000/auth/callback
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 30
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: days

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-${AWS::Region}-agentops'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: admin
      Precedence: 1
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamAlphaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-alpha
      Precedence: 10
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  TeamBetaGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: team-beta
      Precedence: 20
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  SeederLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CognitoSeederAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:AdminCreateUser
                  - cognito-idp:AdminSetUserPassword
                  - cognito-idp:AdminAddUserToGroup
                  - cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SeederFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-user-seeder'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt SeederLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DEMO_PASSWORD: Demo1234!
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          cognito = boto3.client('cognito-idp')
          DEMO_PASSWORD = os.environ['DEMO_PASSWORD']

          USERS = [
              {'username': 'alice@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'member'},
              {'username': 'bob@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'member'},
              {'username': 'charlie@demo.local', 'group': 'team-alpha', 'role': 'team_admin'},
              {'username': 'dave@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'member'},
              {'username': 'eve@demo.local', 'group': 'team-beta', 'role': 'team_admin'},
              {'username': 'admin@demo.local', 'group': 'admin', 'role': 'admin'},
          ]

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return

                  user_pool_id = event['ResourceProperties']['UserPoolId']

                  for user in USERS:
                      try:
                          cognito.admin_create_user(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=user['username'],
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'email', 'Value': user['username']},
                                  {'Name': 'email_verified', 'Value': 'true'},
                                  {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': user['role']},
                              ],
                              MessageAction='SUPPRESS',
                          )
                      except cognito.exceptions.UsernameExistsException:
                          cognito.admin_update_user_attributes(
                              UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                              Username=user['username'],
                              UserAttributes=[
                                  {'Name': 'custom:role', 'Value': user['role']},
                              ],
                          )

                      cognito.admin_set_user_password(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          Username=user['username'],
                          Password=DEMO_PASSWORD,
                          Permanent=True,
                      )
                      cognito.admin_add_user_to_group(
                          UserPoolId=user_pool_id,
                          GroupName=user['group'],
                          Username=user['username'],
                      )

                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(f'Seeding failed: {e}')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)})

  UserSeeder:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - AdminGroup
      - TeamAlphaGroup
      - TeamBetaGroup
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      UserPoolClientId: !Ref UserPoolClient

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !Ref UserPoolClient
  Region:
    Value: !Ref AWS::Region
  SeederFunctionArn:
    Value: !GetAtt SeederFunction.Arn

    Default: client-vpn-usage-reporting
    Description: Base name for all resources.

Resources:
  UsagePerEndpointQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}usage-per-endpoint'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-attempt(?<connectionId>[^\s"]*)/
        | filter ispresent(connectionId)
        | stats count(*) as connectionAttempts by coalesce(connection-endpoint-ip, "unknown") as endpoint
        | sort connectionAttempts desc

  UsagePerAuthTypeQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}usage-per-auth-type'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /authentication\s*:\s*(?<authType>[^\s,}]+)/
        | filter ispresent(authType)
        | stats count(*) as connections by authType
        | sort connections desc

  DistinctUsersQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}distinct-users'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /username(?:['"])?\s*[:=]\s*['"]?(?<userName>[^'",\s}]+)/
        | filter ispresent(userName)
        | stats count_distinct(userName) as distinctUsers, count(*) as totalConnections

  ConnectionDurationsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FolderPrefix}connection-durations'
      LogGroupNames:
        - !Ref LogGroupName
      QueryString: |
        fields @timestamp, @message
        | parse @message /connection-duration(?:-time)?\s*[:=]\s*['"]?(?<durationSeconds>\d+)/
        | filter ispresent(durationSeconds)
        | stats avg(durationSeconds) as avgDurationSeconds, max(durationSeconds) as maxDurationSeconds, min(durationSeconds) as minDurationSeconds, count(*) as sessions by bin(1h) as sessionHour
        | sort sessionHour desc

  ClientVpnDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Sub '${Name}-${Environment}-client-vpn-dashboard'
      DashboardBody: !Sub |
        {
          "widgets": [
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${UsagePerEndpointQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Total Usage per Endpoint",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 0,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${UsagePerAuthTypeQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Usage per Authentication Type (AD/SAML, Mutual Auth, Mixed Auth)",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 0,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${DistinctUsersQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Distinct Users",
                "view": "table"
              }
            },
            {
              "type": "log",
              "x": 12,
              "y": 6,
              "width": 12,
              "height": 6,
              "properties": {
                "QueryDefinitionId": "${ConnectionDurationsQuery}",
                "region": "${AWS::Region}",
                "title": "Connection Durations",
                "view": "table"
              }
            }
          ]
        }

    Description: URL of the Client VPN usage reporting dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${AWS::AccountId}.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${Name}-${Environment}-client-vpn-dashboard'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Hospitality Insights prod Cognito user pool with post-auth Lambda trigger, groups, optional SSO and hosted UI domain.

Parameters:
  SsoLoginUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: SAML IdP login/metadata URL. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  SsoProviderName:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Name of the SAML identity provider. Leave empty to disable SSO.
  DomainPrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Prefix for the Cognito hosted UI domain. Leave empty to skip domain creation.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9-]{0,63}$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: prod
    AllowedValues:
      - prod
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: hospitality-insights

Conditions:
  SsoEnabled: !And
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoLoginUrl, '']]
    - !Not [!Equals [!Ref SsoProviderName, '']]
  DomainEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref DomainPrefix, '']]

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-userpool'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      UsernameAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
          TemporaryPasswordValidityDays: 7
      Schema:
        - Name: last_login
          AttributeDataType: String
          Mutable: true
          Required: false
      LambdaConfig:
        PostAuthentication: !GetAtt PostAuthLambda.Arn

  PostAuthLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-postauth-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PostAuthLambdaPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: cognito-idp:AdminUpdateUserAttributes
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:cognito-idp:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:userpool/*'

  PostAuthLambda:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-post-auth-trigger'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt PostAuthLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import logging
          import boto3

          logger = logging.getLogger()
          logger.setLevel(os.environ.get('LOG_LEVEL', 'INFO'))
          client = boto3.client('cognito-idp')

          def handler(event, context):
              logger.info("Post-authentication event received for user pool %s", event.get('userPoolId'))
              try:
                  user_attrs = event.get('request', {}).get('userAttributes', {})
                  username = user_attrs.get('sub') or event.get('userName')
                  client.admin_update_user_attributes(
                      UserPoolId=event['userPoolId'],
                      Username=username,
                      UserAttributes=[
                          {
                              'Name': 'custom:last_login',
                              'Value': event['request'].get('timestamp', '')
                          }
                      ]
                  )
              except Exception:
                  logger.exception("Failed to update custom:last_login attribute")
                  raise
              return event

  LambdaCognitoPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref PostAuthLambda
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: cognito-idp.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  UserPoolClientSso:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Properties:
      ClientName: !Sub '${ApplicationName}-${Environment}-client-sso'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
        - !Ref SsoProviderName
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: false
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      RefreshTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours
        RefreshToken: hours

  SamlIdentityProvider:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolIdentityProvider
    Condition: SsoEnabled
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ProviderName: !Ref SsoProviderName
      ProviderType: SAML
      ProviderDetails:
        IDPSignout: 'true'
        MetadataURL: !Ref SsoLoginUrl

  AdminGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: Admin
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 1

  RegularUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: RegularUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 2

  PowerUserGroup:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolGroup
    Properties:
      GroupName: PowerUser
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Precedence: 3

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Condition: DomainEnabled
    Properties:
      Domain: !Ref DomainPrefix
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

Outputs:
  UserPoolId:
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  UserPoolArn:
    Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
  UserPoolClientId:
    Value: !If
      - SsoEnabled
      - !Ref UserPoolClientSso
      - !Ref UserPoolClient
  HostedUiDomain:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: WebSocket API with $connect, $default, $disconnect routes backed by Lambda and DynamoDB session tracking.

Parameters:
  StageName:
    Type: String
    Default: api
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-z0-9-]+$"
    Description: Name of the WebSocket API stage.

Resources:
  SessionTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sessions"
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: connectionId
          KeyType: HASH
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: expireAt
        Enabled: true

  ConnectLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ConnectPutItem
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  DefaultLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DefaultExecuteApi
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: execute-api:Invoke
                Resource: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/*/@connections/*

  DisconnectLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DisconnectDeleteItem
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: dynamodb:DeleteItem
                Resource: !GetAtt SessionTable.Arn

  ConnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt ConnectLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import time
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              domain = event["requestContext"]["domainName"]
              stage = event["requestContext"]["stage"]
              item = {
                  "connectionId": connection_id,
                  "connectedAt": int(time.time()),
                  "expireAt": int(time.time()) + 86400,
                  "endpoint": f"https://{domain}/{stage}",
              }
              qs = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
              if qs:
                  item["queryParams"] = qs
              headers = event.get("headers") or {}
              if headers.get("user-agent"):
                  item["userAgent"] = headers["user-agent"]
              table.put_item(Item=item)
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Connected."}

  DefaultFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt DefaultLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              domain = event["requestContext"]["domainName"]
              stage = event["requestContext"]["stage"]
              endpoint = f"https://{domain}/{stage}"
              client = boto3.client("apigatewaymanagementapi", endpoint_url=endpoint)
              body = event.get("body") or ""
              client.post_to_connection(ConnectionId=connection_id, Data=body.encode("utf-8"))
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"echoed": body})}

  DisconnectFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 10
      Role: !GetAtt DisconnectLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SESSION_TABLE: !Ref SessionTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["SESSION_TABLE"])

          def handler(event, context):
              connection_id = event["requestContext"]["connectionId"]
              table.delete_item(Key={"connectionId": connection_id})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": "Disconnected."}

  WebSocketApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-websocket"
      ProtocolType: WEBSOCKET
      RouteSelectionExpression: "$request.body.action"

  ConnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ConnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DefaultIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DefaultFunction.Arn}/invocations

  DisconnectIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DisconnectFunction.Arn}/invocations

  ConnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $connect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${ConnectIntegration}

  DefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $default
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DefaultIntegration}

  DisconnectRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      RouteKey: $disconnect
      Target: !Sub integrations/${DisconnectIntegration}

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref WebSocketApi
      StageName: !Ref StageName
      AutoDeploy: true

  ConnectInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ConnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$connect

  DefaultInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DefaultFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$default

  DisconnectInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DisconnectFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${WebSocketApi}/${StageName}/$disconnect

Outputs:
  WebSocketEndpoint:
    Description: WebSocket (wss) endpoint for clients.
    Value: !Sub "wss://${WebSocketApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${StageName}"
  SessionTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table tracking client sessions.
    Value: !Ref SessionTable

Description: Basic VPC with a single public subnet for testing purposes.
Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Description: VPC network address (/16 range)
    AllowedValues:
      - 172.18.0.0
      - 172.19.0.0
      - 172.20.0.0
      - 172.21.0.0
      - 172.22.0.0
      - 172.23.0.0
    Default: 172.18.0.0
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment tag value
    Default: test
    AllowedValues:
      - test
      - dev
      - staging

    Type: String
    Description: Name prefix for resources
    Default: testing-vpc
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,64}$'

  VpcToSubnetCidr:
    "172.18.0.0":
      SubnetCidr: 172.18.0.0/22
    "172.19.0.0":
      SubnetCidr: 172.19.0.0/22
    "172.20.0.0":
      SubnetCidr: 172.20.0.0/22
    "172.21.0.0":
      SubnetCidr: 172.21.0.0/22

      SubnetCidr: 172.22.0.0/22

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  FIS chaos engineering experiment template blocking network traffic to a target
  region and pausing cross-region replication for transit gateways, subnets,
  S3 buckets, and DynamoDB global tables tagged ChaosAllowed=true.

Parameters:
  TargetRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-west-2
    Description: Target region to which application network traffic will be blocked.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
  ReplicationPauseDuration:
    Type: String
    Default: PT20M
    Description: ISO 8601 duration for which cross-region replication is paused.
    AllowedPattern: '^PT(\d+[HMS])+$'
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - test
      - staging
  Project:
    Type: String
    Default: ChaosEngineering
  LogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    AllowedValues: [1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, 3653]

Resources:
  FisKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for FIS experiment CloudWatch log group encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowFisRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  FisKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub "alias/fis-chaos-logs-${AWS::Region}"
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FisKmsKey

  FisLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DependsOn: FisKmsKey
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/fis/chaos-experiments-${AWS::Region}"
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt FisKmsKey.Arn
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionInDays
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  FisExperimentRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "fis-chaos-experiment-role-${AWS::Region}"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: fis.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref "AWS::AccountId"
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref Project

  FisExperimentRolePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::RolePolicy
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Ref FisExperimentRole
      PolicyName: fis-chaos-experiment-inline-policy
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: Ec2NetworkDisruption
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ec2:CreateTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:DeleteTransitGatewayRoute
              - ec2:SearchTransitGatewayRoutes
              - ec2:ModifyTransitGateway
              - ec2:CreateRoute
              - ec2:ReplaceRoute
              - ec2:DeleteRoute
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGateways
              - ec2:DescribeTransitGatewayRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeRouteTables
              - ec2:DescribeSubnets
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: "true"
          - Sid: SsmBlockTrafficDocument
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:SendCommand
            Resource:
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::document/AWSFIS-Run-BlockTrafficToRegion"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::document/AWS-RunShellScript"
              - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ec2:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:instance/*"
          - Sid: SsmDescribeInstances
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - ssm:DescribeInstanceInformation
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: S3ReplicationPause
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - s3:GetReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:PutReplicationConfiguration
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:ListBuckets
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: "true"
          - Sid: DynamoDbReplicationPause
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTable
              - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTable
              - dynamodb:DescribeGlobalTableSettings
              - dynamodb:UpdateGlobalTableSettings
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:ResourceTag/ChaosAllowed: "true"
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - logs:CreateLogStream
              - logs:PutLogEvents
              - logs:DescribeLogStreams
            Resource: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn
          - Sid: FisTargetResolution
            Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - fis:ListExperimentResolvedTargets
              - tag:GetResources
            Resource: "*"

  ChaosExperimentTemplate:
    Type: AWS::FIS::ExperimentTemplate
    Properties:
      Description: Chaos experiment blocking regional network traffic and pausing cross-region replication
      Tags:
        Environment: !Ref Environment
        Project: !Ref Project
      RoleArn: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
      StopConditions:
        - Source: none
      Actions:
        BlockTrafficToTargetRegion:
          ActionId: aws:ssm:send-command
          Description: Block application network traffic from local region to target region via AWS-provided SSM document
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ReplicationPauseDuration
            documentArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::document/AWSFIS-Run-BlockTrafficToRegion"
            documentVersion: "$LATEST"
            documentParameters: !Sub '{"region":"${TargetRegion}","duration":"${ReplicationPauseDuration}"}'
          Targets:
            Instances: InstanceTarget
        DisruptTransitGatewayConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:ssm:send-command
          Description: Disrupt transit gateway cross-region connectivity via AWS-provided SSM document
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ReplicationPauseDuration
            documentArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::document/AWSFIS-Run-BlockTrafficToRegion"
            documentVersion: "$LATEST"
            documentParameters: !Sub '{"region":"${TargetRegion}","duration":"${ReplicationPauseDuration}"}'
          Targets:
            Instances: InstanceTarget
        DisruptSubnetConnectivity:
          ActionId: aws:ec2:subnet-route-table-blackhole-route
          Description: Blackhole subnet route table traffic to disrupt subnet network connectivity
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ReplicationPauseDuration
            routes: 0.0.0.0/0
          Targets:
            Subnets: SubnetTarget
        PauseS3Replication:
          ActionId: aws:ssm:send-command
          Description: Pause S3 cross-region replication by disabling replication rules on tagged buckets for the configured duration
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ReplicationPauseDuration
            documentArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}::document/AWS-RunShellScript"
            documentVersion: "$LATEST"
            documentParameters: !Sub '{"commands":["for B in $(aws s3api list-buckets --query \"Buckets[?starts_with(Name, '\''chaos'\'')].Name\" --output text); do RC=$(aws s3api get-replication-configuration --bucket $B 2>/dev/null); if [ -n \"$RC\" ]; then echo \"$RC\" | jq \"(.Rules[].Status)=\\\"Disabled\\\"\" > /tmp/rc.json && aws s3api put-bucket-replication --bucket $B --replication-configuration file:///tmp/rc.json; fi; done"],"executionTimeout":"3600"}'
          Targets:
            Instances: InstanceTarget
        PauseDynamoDbReplication:
          ActionId: aws:dynamodb:global-table-pause-replication
          Description: Pause DynamoDB global table cross-region replication
          Parameters:
            duration: !Ref ReplicationPauseDuration
          Targets:
            GlobalTables: DynamoGlobalTableTarget
      Targets:
        InstanceTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:instance
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        TransitGatewayTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:transit-gateway
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        SubnetTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:ec2:subnet
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        S3BucketTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:s3:bucket
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
        DynamoGlobalTableTarget:
          ResourceType: aws:dynamodb:global-table
          ResourceTags:
            ChaosAllowed: "true"
          SelectionMode: ALL
      LogConfiguration:
        LogSchemaVersion: 2
        CloudWatchLogsConfiguration:
          LogGroupArn: !GetAtt FisLogGroup.Arn

Outputs:
  ExperimentTemplateId:
    Description: FIS Experiment Template ID
    Value: !Ref ChaosExperimentTemplate
  FisRoleArn:
    Description: IAM role assumed by FIS during experiments
    Value: !GetAtt FisExperimentRole.Arn
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Encrypted CloudWatch log group for experiment logs
    Value: !Ref FisLogGroup
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS key used for log encryption
    Value: !GetAtt FisKmsKey.Arn
