AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark Section 3 - Log-based monitoring controls: CloudTrail log group, KMS key, SNS topic, metric filters, alarms, and Logs Insights query definitions'

Resources:
  CloudTrailLogKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogs
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub 'logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'sns.amazonaws.com'
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:sns:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'

  CloudTrailLogKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cis-benchmark-cloudtrail-logs-${AWS::Region}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailLogKmsKey

  AlarmNotificationTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub 'cis-benchmark-alarms-${AWS::Region}'
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref CloudTrailLogKmsKey

  AlarmNotificationTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchAlarmsPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: 'cloudwatch.amazonaws.com'
            Action: 'sns:Publish'
            Resource: !Ref AlarmNotificationTopic
            Condition:
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudwatch:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:alarm:*'

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DependsOn: CloudTrailLogKmsKeyAlias
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/cloudtrail/cis-benchmark-${AWS::Region}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogKmsKey.Arn

  UnauthorizedApiCallsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation") || ($.errorCode = "AccessDenied*") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  UnauthorizedApiCallsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedApiCalls
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.1 - Unauthorized API call attempts detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: UnauthorizedApiCalls
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  UnauthorizedApiCallsQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.1-UnauthorizedApiCalls
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, errorCode, errorMessage, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn | filter ispresent(errorCode) and (errorCode = "*UnauthorizedOperation" or errorCode = "AccessDenied*") | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  ConsoleLoginWithoutMfaFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginWithoutMfa
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  ConsoleLoginWithoutMfaAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.2-ConsoleLoginWithoutMfa
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.2 - Console sign-in without MFA detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: ConsoleLoginWithoutMfa
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  ConsoleLoginWithoutMfaQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.2-ConsoleLoginWithoutMfa
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn, additionalEventData.MFAUsed | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and additionalEventData.MFAUsed != "Yes" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  RootUsageFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.userIdentity.type = "Root") && ($.userIdentity.invokedBy NOT EXISTS) && ($.eventType != "AwsServiceEvent") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: RootUsage
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  RootUsageAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.3-RootUsage
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.3 - Root account usage detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: RootUsage
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  RootUsageQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.3-RootUsage
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.type, userIdentity.arn | filter userIdentity.type = "Root" and eventType != "AwsServiceEvent" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  IamPolicyChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = DeleteGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = PutUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicy) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicy) || ($.eventName = CreatePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = DeletePolicyVersion) || ($.eventName = AttachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachRolePolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachUserPolicy) || ($.eventName = AttachGroupPolicy) || ($.eventName = DetachGroupPolicy) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  IamPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.4-IamPolicyChanges
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.4 - IAM policy changes detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: IamPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  IamPolicyChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.4-IamPolicyChanges
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn | filter eventName in ["DeleteGroupPolicy","DeleteRolePolicy","DeleteUserPolicy","PutGroupPolicy","PutRolePolicy","PutUserPolicy","CreatePolicy","DeletePolicy","CreatePolicyVersion","DeletePolicyVersion","AttachRolePolicy","DetachRolePolicy","AttachUserPolicy","DetachUserPolicy","AttachGroupPolicy","DetachGroupPolicy"] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  CloudTrailConfigChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = CreateTrail) || ($.eventName = UpdateTrail) || ($.eventName = DeleteTrail) || ($.eventName = StartLogging) || ($.eventName = StopLogging) || ($.eventName = PutEventSelectors) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  CloudTrailConfigChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.5 - CloudTrail configuration changes detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: CloudTrailConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  CloudTrailConfigChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.5-CloudTrailConfigChanges
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn | filter eventName in ["CreateTrail","UpdateTrail","DeleteTrail","StartLogging","StopLogging","PutEventSelectors"] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  ConsoleLoginFailuresFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventName = "ConsoleLogin") && ($.errorMessage = "Failed authentication") }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  ConsoleLoginFailuresAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.6-ConsoleLoginFailures
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.6 - Console sign-in failures detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: ConsoleLoginFailures
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  ConsoleLoginFailuresQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.6-ConsoleLoginFailures
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, errorMessage, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn | filter eventName = "ConsoleLogin" and errorMessage = "Failed authentication" | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = "DisableKey") || ($.eventName = "ScheduleKeyDeletion")) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: KmsKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.7-KmsKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.7 - KMS key disabled or scheduled for deletion
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: KmsKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  KmsKeyDisableOrDeletionQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.7-KmsKeyDisableOrScheduledDeletion
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId | filter eventSource = "kms.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["DisableKey","ScheduleKeyDeletion"] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  S3BucketPolicyChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = PutBucketAcl) || ($.eventName = PutBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = PutBucketCors) || ($.eventName = PutBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = PutBucketReplication) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketPolicy) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketCors) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketLifecycle) || ($.eventName = DeleteBucketReplication)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  S3BucketPolicyChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.8-S3BucketPolicyChanges
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.8 - S3 bucket policy changes detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: S3BucketPolicyChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  S3BucketPolicyChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:
      Name: CIS-3.8-S3BucketPolicyChanges
      LogGroupNames: [!Ref CloudTrailLogGroup]
      QueryString: 'fields @timestamp, eventTime, eventName, eventSource, sourceIPAddress, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.bucketName | filter eventSource = "s3.amazonaws.com" and eventName in ["PutBucketAcl","PutBucketPolicy","PutBucketCors","PutBucketLifecycle","PutBucketReplication","DeleteBucketPolicy","DeleteBucketCors","DeleteBucketLifecycle","DeleteBucketReplication"] | sort @timestamp desc | limit 100'

  AwsConfigChangesFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref CloudTrailLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ ($.eventSource = "config.amazonaws.com") && (($.eventName = StopConfigurationRecorder) || ($.eventName = DeleteDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutDeliveryChannel) || ($.eventName = PutConfigurationRecorder)) }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricNamespace: CISBenchmark
          MetricName: AwsConfigChanges
          MetricValue: '1'
          DefaultValue: 0
  AwsConfigChangesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: CIS-3.9-AwsConfigChanges
      AlarmDescription: CIS 3.9 - AWS Config configuration changes detected
      Namespace: CISBenchmark
      MetricName: AwsConfigChanges
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions: [!Ref AlarmNotificationTopic]
  AwsConfigChangesQuery:
    Type: AWS::Logs::QueryDefinition
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Fully event-driven Security Hub organization onboarding for AWS Control Tower.
  Creates /superwerker/ SSM parameters, SSM automation documents for landing zone
  bootstrap and new-account onboarding, IAM roles for SSM automation and
  EventBridge targets, and EventBridge rules reacting to Control Tower lifecycle
  events. Account IDs are resolved at runtime from Parameter Store.

Resources:

  AuditAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Description: Account ID of the Security Hub delegated administrator (audit) account.

  LogArchiveAccountIdParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/log-archive-account-id
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
      Description: Account ID of the Control Tower log archive account. Update after deployment with the actual log archive account ID.

  RegionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: /superwerker/region
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      Description: Control Tower home region.

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: security-hub-onboarding-automation-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: security-hub-onboarding-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: AssumeControlTowerExecution
                Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::*:role/AWSControlTowerExecution'
              - Sid: SecurityHubActions
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - securityhub:EnableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:DisableSecurityHub
                  - securityhub:EnableOrganizationAdminAccount
                  - securityhub:ListOrganizationAdminAccounts
                  - securityhub:CreateMembers
                  - securityhub:DeleteMembers
                  - securityhub:InviteMembers
                  - securityhub:DisassociateMembers
                  - securityhub:GetMembers
                  - securityhub:AcceptInvitation
                  - securityhub:GetMasterAccount
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: ReadSuperwerkerParameters
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/superwerker/*'

  EventBusTargetRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: security-hub-onboarding-event-target-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: events.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: start-automation
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ssm:StartAutomationExecution
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${LandingZoneBootstrapDocument}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${NewAccountOnboardingDocument}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:PassRole
                Resource: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    'iam:PassedToService': ssm.amazonaws.com

  LandingZoneBootstrapDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: security-hub-landing-zone-bootstrap
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub org-wide bootstrap after Control Tower landing zone setup/update finishes.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          automationRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the SSM automation role (passed by the EventBridge target).
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: GetLogArchiveAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/log-archive-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInAuditAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']
                    creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **creds)
                    sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)
                    sh.enable_organization_admin_account(AdminAccountId=audit_account_id)

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubBootstrap'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
          - name: EnableSecurityHubInLogArchiveAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    log_archive_account_id = events['LogArchiveAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']
                    audit_creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    audit_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **audit_creds)
                    audit_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': log_archive_account_id}])
                    audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[log_archive_account_id])
                    log_creds = assume(log_archive_account_id)
                    log_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **log_creds)
                    master = audit_sh.get_master_account().get('Master', {})
                    if master.get('InvitationId'):
                        log_sh.accept_invitation(
                            MasterId=master.get('AccountId', audit_account_id),
                            InvitationId=master.get('InvitationId')
                        )

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubBootstrap'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                LogArchiveAccountId: '{{ GetLogArchiveAccountId.Value }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  NewAccountOnboardingDocument:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: security-hub-new-account-onboarding
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        description: Enables Security Hub in newly provisioned Control Tower accounts and associates them with the audit account.
        assumeRole: '{{ automationRoleArn }}'
        parameters:
          automationRoleArn:
            type: String
            default: ''
            description: ARN of the SSM automation role (passed by the EventBridge target).
          newAccountId:
            type: String
            description: Account ID of the newly provisioned account.
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetAuditAccountId
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ssm
              Api: GetParameter
              Name: /superwerker/audit-account-id
            outputs:
              - Name: Value
                Selector: $.Parameter.Value
          - name: OnboardNewAccount
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: handler
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def handler(events, context):
                    audit_account_id = events['AuditAccountId']
                    new_account_id = events['NewAccountId']
                    region = events['Region']

                    new_creds = assume(new_account_id)
                    new_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **new_creds)
                    new_sh.enable_security_hub(EnableDefaultStandards=True)

                    audit_creds = assume(audit_account_id)
                    audit_sh = boto3.client('securityhub', region_name=region, **audit_creds)
                    audit_sh.create_members(AccountDetails=[{'AccountId': new_account_id}])
                    audit_sh.invite_members(AccountIds=[new_account_id])

                    members = audit_sh.get_members(AccountIds=[new_account_id]).get('Members', [])
                    invitation_id = members[0].get('InvitationId') if members else None
                    if invitation_id:
                        new_sh.accept_invitation(
                            MasterId=audit_account_id,
                            InvitationId=invitation_id
                        )

                def assume(account_id):
                    sts = boto3.client('sts')
                    resp = sts.assume_role(
                        RoleArn=f'arn:aws:iam::{account_id}:role/AWSControlTowerExecution',
                        RoleSessionName='SecurityHubOnboarding'
                    )
                    return {
                        'aws_access_key_id': resp['Credentials']['AccessKeyId'],
                        'aws_secret_access_key': resp['Credentials']['SecretAccessKey'],
                        'aws_session_token': resp['Credentials']['SessionToken'],
                    }
              InputPayload:
                AuditAccountId: '{{ GetAuditAccountId.Value }}'
                NewAccountId: '{{ newAccountId }}'
                Region: !Ref 'AWS::Region'

  CreateManagedAccountRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: security-hub-on-new-managed-account
      Description: Triggers Security Hub onboarding when Control Tower successfully provisions a new managed account.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          action:
            - CreateManagedAccount
          event:
            - Succeeded
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubNewAccountOnboarding
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${NewAccountOnboardingDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBusTargetRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputPathsMap:
              account: $.detail.accountId
            InputTemplate: !Sub |-
              {
                "DocumentName": "security-hub-new-account-onboarding",
                "automationRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/security-hub-onboarding-automation-role",
                "newAccountId": <account>
              }

  LandingZoneUpdateRule:
    Type: AWS::Events::Rule
    Properties:
      Name: security-hub-on-landing-zone-update
      Description: Triggers Security Hub bootstrap when Control Tower landing zone setup/update finishes successfully.
      State: ENABLED
      EventPattern:
        source:
          - aws.controltower
        detail-type:
          - Control Tower Lifecycle Event
        detail:
          action:
            - UpdateLandingZone
          event:
            - Succeeded
      Targets:
        - Id: SecurityHubLandingZoneBootstrap
          Arn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:automation-definition/${LandingZoneBootstrapDocument}'
          RoleArn: !GetAtt EventBusTargetRole.Arn
          InputTransformer:
            InputTemplate: !Sub |-
              {
                "DocumentName": "security-hub-landing-zone-bootstrap",
                "automationRoleArn": "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/security-hub-onboarding-automation-role"
              }

Outputs:
  LandingZoneBootstrapDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the landing zone bootstrap SSM automation document.
    Value: !Ref LandingZoneBootstrapDocument
  NewAccountOnboardingDocumentName:
    Description: Name of the new account onboarding SSM automation document.
    Value: !Ref NewAccountOnboardingDocument
  CreateManagedAccountRuleName:
    Description: EventBridge rule for newly provisioned managed accounts.
    Value: !Ref CreateManagedAccountRule
  LandingZoneUpdateRuleName:
    Description: EventBridge rule for landing zone setup/update completion.
    Value: !Ref LandingZoneUpdateRule
  SSMAutomationRoleArn:
    Description: ARN of the SSM automation execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Shared EKS IAM roles, GuardDuty detector (15-min findings), registry log groups, and condition-gated AWSQS Kubernetes ResourceVersion registrations.

# ============================================================================
# OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE (free-text comments — no length limit here)
#
# MANDATORY DEPLOY-TIME OVERRIDES:
#   - BastionBucketName: override the placeholder default with the real target
#     bucket name via --parameter-overrides. The default is syntactically valid
#     only.
#   - KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage / KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage /
#     EksClusterHandlerPackage: REQUIRED at deploy time for registry
#     registration. Leave the empty defaults and pass the real S3 handler
#     package ARNs via --parameter-overrides. The corresponding ResourceVersion
#     resources are condition-gated, so the stack deploys roles/GuardDuty/log
#     groups cleanly when these inputs are not supplied.
#
# PERMISSIONS BOUNDARY (OPTIONAL — commented out):
#   To enable, uncomment AS ONE ATOMIC CHANGE:
#     1. The PermissionsBoundaryArn Parameter below.
#     2. A Conditions entry: HasPermissionsBoundary: !Not [!Equals [!Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn, ""]]
#     3. A `PermissionBoundary: !Ref PermissionsBoundaryArn` property in each
#        of the eight role resources.
#   The condition makes the boundary load-bearing only in environments that
#   require it; when absent, the template deploys cleanly.
# ============================================================================

Parameters:
  EnvironmentAlias:
    Type: String
    Default: "eks"
    Description: Short alias used as the prefix for all IAM role and log group names.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,20}$"
  EnvironmentHash:
    Type: String
    Default: "001"
    Description: Short hash suffix appended to role names to avoid collisions.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9]{1,8}$"
  BastionBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: "replace-me-example-bucket"
    Description: >
      **MUST BE OVERRIDDEN AT DEPLOY TIME** — existing S3 bucket name that scopes the
      bastion role's S3 GetObject access. The default is a syntactically valid
      placeholder only; pass the real bucket name via --parameter-overrides.
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9.-]{1,253}[a-zA-Z0-9]$"
  KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::Kubernetes::Resource ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.
  KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::Kubernetes::Helm ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.
  EksClusterHandlerPackage:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: >
      REQUIRED AT DEPLOY TIME — leave empty default and pass the real S3 handler
      package ARN via --parameter-overrides. Gates the condition-gated
      AWSQS::EKS::Cluster ResourceVersion; it cannot register without it.

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # OPTIONAL: PermissionsBoundary (commented out). See the OPERATIONAL GUIDANCE
  # comment block above the Parameters section for the full enablement steps.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # PermissionsBoundaryArn:
  #   Type: String
  #   Description: ARN of the IAM managed policy to apply as a permissions boundary
  #     to all roles. Only enable in environments that require it.

Conditions:
  HasK8sResourcePackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesResourceHandlerPackage, ""]]
  HasK8sHelmPackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref KubernetesHelmHandlerPackage, ""]]
  HasEksClusterPackage: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EksClusterHandlerPackage, ""]]

Resources:
  GuardDutyDetector:
    Type: AWS::GuardDuty::Detector
    Properties:
      Enable: true
      FindingPublishingFrequency: FIFTEEN_MINUTES

  LogGroupK8sResource:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/cloudformation/registry/awsqs-kubernetes-resource"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LogGroupK8sHelm:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/awsqs-kubernetes-helm-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LogGroupEksCluster:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}/cloudformation/registry/awsqs-eks-cluster"
      RetentionInDays: 90

  LambdaDiscoveryRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-discovery-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: read-only-resource-discovery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:Describe*
                  - eks:List*
                  - cloudformation:Describe*
                  - cloudformation:List*
                  - cloudformation:Get*
                  - s3:List*
                  - s3:Get*
                  - ec2:Describe*
                  - logs:Describe*
                  - logs:Get*
                  - cloudtrail:Describe*
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                Resource: "*"

  LambdaCallerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-lambda-caller-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: caller-identity-cfn-cloudtrail
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:GetCallerIdentity
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
                  - cloudformation:ListStacks
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:GetLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudtrail:LookupEvents
                  - cloudtrail:GetTrailStatus
                  - cloudtrail:DescribeTrails
                Resource: "*"

  EksNodegroupDescribeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-eks-nodegroup-describe-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: eks.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: eks-nodegroup-describe
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups
                  - eks:DescribeCluster
                  - eks:ListClusters
                Resource: "*"

  CfnExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${EnvironmentAlias}-${EnvironmentHash}-cfn-execution-role"
      MaxSessionDuration: 8400
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudformation.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: cfn-execution-broad

                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload

                  - s3:PutObject

                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup

                Resource: "*"

        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:

        - PolicyName: cfn-hooks-broad

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:

                  - secretsmanager:ListSecrets

                  - kms:DescribeKey

                  - eks:ListNodegroups

                  - lambda:GetFunction

                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents

                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricData

                  - ssm:GetParameter

        Version: "2012-10-17"

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - eks:DescribeNodegroup
                  - eks:ListNodegroups

                  - codebuild:ListBuilds

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'

Description: >
  Comprehensive SQS test infrastructure: FIFO queues, DLQs, standard queue,
  KMS encryption, and CloudWatch alarms. All alarms have actions disabled.

Resources:

  SqsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for SQS queue encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSqsUseOfKey
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sqs.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'

  FifoQueueNoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  FifoQueueWithDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      ContentBasedDeduplication: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt FifoDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  StandardDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt StandardDlq.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: 5

  SeparateFifoDlq:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      FifoQueue: true
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref SqsKmsKey
      KmsDataKeyReusePeriodSeconds: 300

  StandardQueueMessagesSentAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-messages-sent
      AlarmDescription: Sum of messages sent on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 1
      TreatMissingData: breaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  FifoWithDlqAnomalyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-fifo-with-dlq-sent-anomaly
      AlarmDescription: Anomaly detection band on messages sent for FIFO queue with DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanUpperThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      ThresholdMetricId: ad1
      Metrics:
        - Id: ad1
          Expression: ANOMALY_DETECTION_BAND(m1, 2)
          Label: MessagesSentExpected
          ReturnData: true
        - Id: m1
          MetricStat:
            Metric:
              Namespace: AWS/SQS
              MetricName: NumberOfMessagesSent
              Dimensions:
                - Name: QueueName
                  Value: !GetAtt FifoQueueWithDlq.QueueName
            Period: 300
            Stat: Average
          ReturnData: true
      TreatMissingData: missing

  StandardQueueSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqSentMessageSizeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-sent-message-size
      AlarmDescription: Maximum sent message size on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: SentMessageSize
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 183500
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alert when standard DLQ has visible messages
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardDlq.QueueName

  FifoDlqVisibleMessagesAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-fifo-dlq-visible-messages
      AlarmDescription: Alert when FIFO DLQ has visible messages
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Sum
      Threshold: 0
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt FifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 15
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardQueueNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-queue-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of in-flight messages on standard queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 108000
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt StandardQueue.QueueName

  SeparateFifoDlqNotVisibleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-separate-fifo-dlq-not-visible
      AlarmDescription: Maximum number of in-flight messages on separate FIFO queue
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateNumberOfMessagesNotVisible
      Namespace: AWS/SQS
      Period: 300
      Statistic: Maximum
      Threshold: 18000
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Dimensions:
        - Name: QueueName
          Value: !GetAtt SeparateFifoDlq.QueueName

  StandardDlqOldestMessageAgeAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: test-standard-dlq-oldest-message-age
      AlarmDescription: Maximum age of oldest message on standard DLQ
      ActionsEnabled: false
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      MetricName: ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Private ROSA networking with egress VPC, NAT, and Transit Gateway (PrivateLink-ready).

Parameters:
  RosaVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  AzCount:
    Type: String
    Default: '3'
    AllowedValues: ['1', '3']
  RosaSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.0.0/17
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  RosaSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.128.0/18
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  RosaSubnet3Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.1.192.0/18
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressVpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressPublicSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.128.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  EgressPrivateSubnetCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/20
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
  CreateElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
  EnableFlowLogs:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']

Conditions:
  CreateElbRole: !Equals [!Ref CreateElbServiceLinkedRole, 'true']
  FlowLogsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableFlowLogs, 'true']
  TwoExtraSubnets: !Equals [!Ref AzCount, '3']

Resources:
  RosaVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-vpc}
  EgressVpc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-vpc}

  RosaSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-1}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}
  RosaSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-2}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}
  RosaSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref RosaSubnet3Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [2, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-3}
        - {Key: kubernetes.io/role/internal-elb, Value: '1'}

  EgressPublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPublicSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-public}
  EgressPrivateSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      CidrBlock: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnetCidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-private}

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
  IgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  NatEip:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-nat}

  EgressPublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
  EgressPublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
  EgressPublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPublicRouteTable

  EgressPrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
  EgressPrivateNatRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway
  EgressPrivateTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  EgressPrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref EgressPrivateRouteTable

  TransitGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGateway
    Properties:
      AutoAcceptSharedAttachments: enable
      DefaultRouteTableAssociation: disable
      DefaultRouteTablePropagation: disable
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-tgw}
  TransitGatewayRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTable
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway

  RosaTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      SubnetIds: !If
        - TwoExtraSubnets
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1, !Ref RosaSubnet2, !Ref RosaSubnet3]
        - [!Ref RosaSubnet1]
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-attachment}
  EgressTgwAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayAttachment
    DependsOn: IgwAttachment
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
      VpcId: !Ref EgressVpc
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: egress-attachment}

  RosaAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
  EgressAttachmentAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRouteTableAssociation
    DependsOn: RosaAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  TgwRouteToRosa:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: RosaAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref RosaVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref RosaTgwAttachment
  TgwRouteToEgress:
    Type: AWS::EC2::TransitGatewayRoute
    DependsOn: EgressAttachmentAssociation
    Properties:
      TransitGatewayRouteTableId: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: !Ref EgressVpcCidr
      TransitGatewayAttachmentId: !Ref EgressTgwAttachment

  RosaRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref RosaVpc
      Tags:
        - {Key: Name, Value: rosa-private-rt}
  RosaDefaultTgwRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: RosaTgwAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      TransitGatewayId: !Ref TransitGateway
  RosaSubnet1RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
  RosaSubnet2RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable
  RosaSubnet3RtAssoc:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref RosaSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref RosaRouteTable

  ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: lambda.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CreateSlr
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: iam:CreateServiceLinkedRole
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForElasticLoadBalancing'
  ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3, cfnresponse
          def handler(event, context):
              if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                  try:
                      boto3.client('iam').create_service_linked_role(
                          AWSServiceName='elasticloadbalancing.amazonaws.com',
                          Description='ELB service-linked role for ROSA')
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'slr')
                  except Exception as e:
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'error': str(e)}, 'slr')
              else:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {}, 'slr')
  ElbServiceLinkedRole:
    Type: Custom::ELBServiceLinkedRole
    Condition: CreateElbRole
    DependsOn: ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunctionRole
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ElbServiceLinkedRoleFunction.Arn

  FlowLogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for VPC Flow Logs
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: CloudWatchLogsAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: logs.amazonaws.com}
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
  FlowLogsKmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/vpc-flow-logs-${AWS::AccountId}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/vpc/flow-logs/${AWS::StackName}'
      RetentionInDays: 365
      KmsKeyId: !Ref FlowLogsKmsKey

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: {Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com}
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FlowLogsDelivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn

  RosaVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref RosaVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'
  EgressVpcFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Condition: FlowLogsEnabled
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref EgressVpc
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      MaxAggregationInterval: 60
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      LogFormat: '${version} ${account-id} ${interface-id} ${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action} ${log-status}'

Outputs:
  RosaVpcId:
    Value: !Ref RosaVpc
  EgressVpcId:
    Value: !Ref EgressVpc
  RosaSubnet1Id:
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet1
  RosaSubnet2Id:
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet2
  RosaSubnet3Id:
    Condition: TwoExtraSubnets
    Value: !Ref RosaSubnet3
  EgressPublicSubnetId:
    Value: !Ref EgressPublicSubnet
  EgressPrivateSubnetId:
    Value: !Ref EgressPrivateSubnet
  TransitGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref TransitGateway
  TransitGatewayRouteTableId:
    Value: !Ref TransitGatewayRouteTable
  NatGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref NatGateway
  NatEipAllocationId:
    Value: !GetAtt NatEip.AllocationId
  InternetGatewayId:
    Value: !Ref InternetGateway

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  PCI DSS remediation prerequisites and nine SSM Automation documents for
  automated remediation of PCI DSS controls.

Resources:
  CloudTrailKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key for CloudTrail log encryption (PCI DSS remediation)
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: "kms:*"
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsEncryption
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub "logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com"
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:Describe*
            Resource: "*"
            Condition:
              ArnEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-logs*"

  CloudTrailLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 1827
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt CloudTrailKmsKey.Arn

  SSMAutomationRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ssm-automation-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ssm.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/IAMFullAccess
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess

  CloudTrailCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-cloudtrail-cw-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudtrail.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: CloudTrailCloudWatchLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:PutRetentionPolicy
                Resource: "*"

  RemediateCloudTrailEncryptionDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-remediate-cloudtrail-encryption"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate
          KMSKeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID/ARN to encrypt the trail
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailEncryptionAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              KmsKeyId: '{{ KMSKeyId }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
            outputs:
              - Name: TrailARN
                Selector: $.TrailARN
                Type: String
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  EnableKmsKeyRotationDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-enable-kms-key-rotation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          KeyId:
            type: String
            description: KMS key ID/ARN to enable rotation on
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableKeyRotation
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: kms
              Api: EnableKeyRotation
              KeyId: '{{ KeyId }}'

  IntegrateCloudTrailCloudWatchDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-integrate-cloudtrail-cloudwatch"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to integrate
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateTrailCloudWatchIntegration
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  UpdateIamPasswordPolicyDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-update-iam-password-policy"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters: {}
        mainSteps:
          - name: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: iam
              Api: UpdateAccountPasswordPolicy
              MinimumPasswordLength: 14
              RequireUppercaseCharacters: true
              RequireLowercaseCharacters: true
              RequireNumbers: true
              RequireSymbols: true
              AllowUsersToChangePassword: true
              HardExpiry: true
              MaxPasswordAge: 90
              PasswordReusePrevention: 24

  EnableTrailValidationDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-enable-trail-log-validation"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          TrailName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CloudTrail trail to remediate
        mainSteps:
          - name: EnableValidationMultiRegionAndCloudWatch
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: UpdateTrail
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'
              EnableLogFileValidation: true
              IsMultiRegionTrail: true
              IncludeGlobalServiceEvents: true
              CloudWatchLogsLogGroupArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailLogGroup.Arn
              CloudWatchLogsRoleArn: !GetAtt CloudTrailCloudWatchRole.Arn
          - name: StartLogging
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: cloudtrail
              Api: StartLogging
              Name: '{{ TrailName }}'

  RevokeDefaultSecurityGroupRulesDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-revoke-default-sg-rules"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          SecurityGroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to revoke all rules from
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetIngressRules
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                SecurityGroupId: '{{ SecurityGroupId }}'
              Script: |-
                import boto3

                def script_handler(events, context):
                    security_group_id = events['InputPayload']['SecurityGroupId']
                    ec2 = boto3.client('ec2')
                    response = ec2.describe_security_group_rules(
                        Filters=[{'Name': 'group-id', 'Values': [security_group_id]}]
                    )
                    ingress_ip = []
                    ingress_sg = []
                    egress_ip = []
                    egress_sg = []
                    for rule in response['SecurityGroupRules']:
                        permission = {
                            'IpProtocol': rule['IpProtocol'],
                            'FromPort': rule.get('FromPort', -1) if rule['IpProtocol'] != '-1' else -1,
                            'ToPort': rule.get('ToPort', -1) if rule['IpProtocol'] != '-1' else -1,
                            'IpRanges': [{'CidrIp': rule['CidrIpv4']}] if rule['CidrIpv4'] else [],
                            'Ipv6Ranges': [{'CidrIpv6': rule['CidrIpv6']}] if rule['CidrIpv6'] else [],
                            'PrefixListIds': [{'PrefixListId': rule['PrefixListId']}] if rule['PrefixListId'] else []
                        }
                        if 'ReferencedGroupInfo' in rule:
                            if not rule['IsEgress']:
                                ingress_sg.append({
                                    'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                    'SourceSecurityGroupId': rule['ReferencedGroupInfo']['GroupId']
                                })
                            else:
                                egress_sg.append({
                                    'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                    'DestinationSecurityGroupId': rule['ReferencedGroupInfo']['GroupId']
                                })
                        elif not rule['IsEgress']:
                            ingress_ip.append({
                                'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                'IpPermissions': [permission]
                            })
                        else:
                            egress_ip.append({
                                'GroupId': security_group_id,
                                'IpPermissions': [permission]
                            })
                    return {
                        'IngressIpRules': ingress_ip,
                        'IngressSgRules': ingress_sg,
                        'EgressIpRules': egress_ip,
                        'EgressSgRules': egress_sg
                    }
            outputs:
              - Name: IngressIpRules
                Selector: $.Payload.IngressIpRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: IngressSgRules
                Selector: $.Payload.IngressSgRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: EgressIpRules
                Selector: $.Payload.EgressIpRules
                Type: StringMap
              - Name: EgressSgRules
                Selector: $.Payload.EgressSgRules
                Type: StringMap
          - name: RevokeIngressIpRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.IngressIpRules }}'
          - name: RevokeIngressSgRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupIngress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.IngressSgRules }}'
          - name: RevokeEgressIpRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.EgressIpRules }}'
          - name: RevokeEgressSgRules
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: RevokeSecurityGroupEgress
              IpPermissions: '{{ GetIngressRules.EgressSgRules }}'

  DeleteSecurityGroupDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-delete-security-group"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          GroupId:
            type: String
            description: ID of the security group to delete
        mainSteps:
          - name: DeleteSecurityGroup
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: DeleteSecurityGroup
              GroupId: '{{ GroupId }}'

  ReleaseElasticIpDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-release-elastic-ip"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          AllocationId:
            type: String
            description: Allocation ID of the Elastic IP to release
        mainSteps:
          - name: ReleaseAddress
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: ec2
              Api: ReleaseAddress
              AllocationId: '{{ AllocationId }}'

  SanitizeCodeBuildProjectDoc:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Document
    Properties:
      DocumentType: Automation
      DocumentFormat: YAML
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-sanitize-codebuild-env-vars"
      Content:
        schemaVersion: '0.3'
        assumeRole: !GetAtt SSMAutomationRole.Arn
        parameters:
          ProjectName:
            type: String
            description: Name of the CodeBuild project to sanitize
        mainSteps:
          - name: GetProject
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: BatchGetProjects
              names:
                - '{{ ProjectName }}'
            outputs:
              - Name: Project
                Selector: $.projects[0]
                Type: StringMap
          - name: FilterEnvVars
            action: aws:executeScript
            inputs:
              Runtime: python3.12
              Handler: script_handler
              InputPayload:
                Project: '{{ GetProject.Project }}'
              Script: |-
                def script_handler(events, context):
                    project = events['InputPayload']['Project']
                    env = project.get('environment', {})
                    env_vars = env.get('environmentVariables', []) or []
                    sanitized = [
                        v for v in env_vars
                        if v.get('name') not in ('AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID', 'AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY')
                    ]
                    env['environmentVariables'] = sanitized
                    return {'SanitizedEnvironment': env}
            outputs:
              - Name: SanitizedEnvironment
                Selector: $.Payload.SanitizedEnvironment
                Type: StringMap
          - name: UpdateProject
            action: aws:executeAwsApi
            inputs:
              Service: codebuild
              Api: UpdateProject
              name: '{{ ProjectName }}'
              environment: '{{ FilterEnvVars.SanitizedEnvironment }}'
