AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Telemetry monitoring for Claude Desktop (CoWork) usage - log group, dual-schema metric filters, and dashboard. Estimated cost is derived at the dashboard layer via metric math because pricing-metric multiplication is unsupported inside metric filter MetricValue expressions. Default prices (per token) - input 0.000003, output 0.000015, cache read 0.0000003, cache creation 0.00000375.'
Parameters:
  DashboardName:
    Type: String
    Default: ClaudeDesktop-CoWork-Telemetry
    Description: Name of the CloudWatch dashboard to create.
    AllowedPattern: '^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: Dashboard name may contain only letters, digits, dot, underscore, and hyphen (URL-safe).
  MetricsRegion:
    Type: String
    Default: us-east-1
    Description: Region whose metrics the dashboard displays.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z]{2}(-gov)?-[a-z]+-\d$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid AWS region name, e.g. us-east-1.
  PricePerInputToken:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.000003
    Description: Price per input token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PricePerOutputToken:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.000015
    Description: Price per output token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PriceCacheRead:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.0000003
    Description: Price per cache read token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
  PriceCacheWrite:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.00000375
    Description: Price per cache creation token (USD) used in dashboard cost math.
Resources:
  CoWorkEventsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-events'
      RetentionInDays: 90
  LocalAgentInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-input-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  LocalAgentOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-output-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.output_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  LocalAgentCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-cache-read'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  LocalAgentCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-cache-creation'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  LocalAgentSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-local-session-turns'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.user_id = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '1'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user_id'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.model'
  DesktopInputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-input-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: InputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.input_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  DesktopOutputTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-output-tokens'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.output_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: OutputTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.output_tokens'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  DesktopCacheReadTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-cache-read'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheReadTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_read_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  DesktopCacheCreationTokensFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-cache-creation'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens > 0 }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: CacheCreationTokens
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '$.message.usage.cache_creation_input_tokens'
          DefaultValue: 0
          Unit: Count
  DesktopSessionTurnsFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-desktop-session-turns'
      LogGroupName: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.user = * }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: SessionTurns
          MetricNamespace: ClaudeDesktop/CoWork
          MetricValue: '1'
          Unit: Count
          Dimensions:
            - Key: User
              Value: '$.user'
            - Key: Model
              Value: '$.message.model'
  CoWorkDashboard:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Dashboard
    Properties:
      DashboardName: !Ref DashboardName
      DashboardBody: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "widgets": [
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Input Tokens",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 6, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Output Tokens",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Tokens (In + Out)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens"], [".", "OutputTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 18, "y": 0, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Cache Hit Tokens (Read + Creation)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens"], [".", "CacheCreationTokens"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Estimated Cost ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(in)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "cost", "label": "Estimated Cost ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 6, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Total Session Turns",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns"]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "period": 300,
                 "title": "Average Cost per Turn ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc2", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns", {"id": "t", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "(SUM(in2)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out2)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr2)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc2)*${PriceCacheWrite})/SUM(t)", "id": "avgcost", "label": "Avg $/Turn", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 18, "y": 4, "width": 6, "height": 4,
               "properties": {"view": "singleValue", "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Active Users (turns > 0)",
                 "metrics": [[{"expression": "SEARCH('{${Namespace},User} SessionTurns SUM>0', 'Sum', 3600)", "id": "au1", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "COUNT(au1)", "id": "au2", "label": "Active Users"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Token Usage Trend (1h)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "tin", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "tout", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(tin)", "id": "ein", "label": "Input Tokens"}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(tout)", "id": "eout", "label": "Output Tokens"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 12, "y": 8, "width": 12, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": false, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Estimated Cost Trend (1h)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "in3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "out3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "cr3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "cc3", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(in3)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(out3)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(cr3)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(cc3)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "costtrend", "label": "Estimated Cost ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]]}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 0, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Token Usage by User",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"stat": "Sum"}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"stat": "Sum"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 8, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Estimated Cost by User ($)",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "InputTokens", {"id": "uin", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "OutputTokens", {"id": "uout", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheReadTokens", {"id": "ucr", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             ["${Namespace}", "CacheCreationTokens", {"id": "ucc", "stat": "Sum", "visible": false}],
                             [{"expression": "SUM(uin)*${PricePerInputToken}+SUM(uout)*${PricePerOutputToken}+SUM(ucr)*${PriceCacheRead}+SUM(ucc)*${PriceCacheWrite}", "id": "ucost", "label": "Cost by User ($)", "region": "${MetricsRegion}"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "metric", "x": 16, "y": 14, "width": 8, "height": 6,
               "properties": {"view": "timeSeries", "stacked": true, "region": "${MetricsRegion}", "stat": "Sum", "period": 3600,
                 "title": "Session Activity by User",
                 "metrics": [["${Namespace}", "SessionTurns", {"stat": "Sum"}]],
                 "groupBy": "User"}},
              {"type": "log", "x": 0, "y": 20, "width": 24, "height": 8,
               "properties": {"view": "table", "region": "${MetricsRegion}",
                 "title": "Recent Raw CoWork Events (newest first)",
                 "query": "SOURCE logGroup = '${LogGroupName}' | FIELDS @timestamp, @message | SORT @timestamp DESC | LIMIT 100"}}
            ]
          }
        - Namespace: 'ClaudeDesktop/CoWork'
          MetricsRegion: !Ref MetricsRegion
          LogGroupName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-cowork-events'
          PricePerInputToken: !Ref PricePerInputToken
          PricePerOutputToken: !Ref PricePerOutputToken
          PriceCacheRead: !Ref PriceCacheRead
          PriceCacheWrite: !Ref PriceCacheWrite
Outputs:

    Description: Direct console URL to the CoWork telemetry dashboard.
    Value: !Sub 'https://console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=${AWS::Region}#dashboards:name=${DashboardName}'
  LogGroupName:
    Description: Log group receiving CoWork telemetry events.
    Value: !Ref CoWorkEventsLogGroup

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained CDK bootstrap environment (file assets, container assets, KMS, publishing/deployment roles)

Parameters:
  Qualifier:
    Type: String
    Default: hnb659fds
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-z0-9]{1,10}$'
    ConstraintDescription: Qualifier must be lowercase alphanumeric, up to 10 characters.
    Description: Short identifier to uniquely qualify bootstrap resources.
  TrustedAccounts:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Comma-delimited list of trusted account root ARNs, recorded for cross-account bootstrap federation (e.g. arn:aws:iam::123456789012:root). Granting of cross-account assume-role is applied as a post-bootstrap update.
  BootstrapVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: '1'
    Description: Bootstrap version tracked in SSM.

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub 'CDK bootstrap key (${Qualifier})'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub 'alias/cdk-${AWS::StackName}-${Qualifier}'
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  AssetBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  AssetBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AssetBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'
          - Sid: AllowFilePublishingPut
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
            Action:
              - s3:PutObject
              - s3:DeleteObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
          - Sid: AllowDeploymentRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - s3:GetBucketLocation
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'

  AssetRepository:
    Type: AWS::ECR::Repository
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ImageTagMutability: IMMUTABLE
      ImageScanningConfiguration:
        ScanOnPush: true
      EncryptionConfiguration:
        EncryptionType: KMS
        KmsKey: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
      LifecyclePolicy:
        LifecyclePolicyText: |
          {
            "rules": [
              {
                "rulePriority": 1,
                "description": "Expire untagged images",
                "selection": {
                  "tagStatus": "untagged",
                  "countType": "sinceImagePushed",
                  "countUnit": "days",
                  "countNumber": 7
                },
                "action": {"type": "expire"}
              }
            ]
          }
      RepositoryPolicyText:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowPullAccountRoot
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action:
              - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
              - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
              - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
              - ecr:BatchGetImage

  FilePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: FilePublishing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  ImagePublishingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
                - !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ImagePublishing
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:PutImage
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:InitiateLayerUpload
                  - ecr:UploadLayerPart
                  - ecr:CompleteLayerUpload
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                Resource: !GetAtt AssetRepository.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:Encrypt
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey*
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  LookupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: Lookup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:GetCallerIdentity
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DescribeAvailabilityZones
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeImages
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                  - ssm:GetParametersByPath
                  - cloudfront:ListDistributions
                Resource: '*'

  DeploymentActionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DeploymentActions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
                  - cloudformation:CreateStack
                  - cloudformation:UpdateStack
                  - cloudformation:DeleteStack
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
                  - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
                  - cloudformation:GetTemplate
                  - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketLocation
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt AssetBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${AssetBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ecr:GetAuthorizationToken
                  - ecr:BatchCheckLayerAvailability
                  - ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer
                  - ecr:BatchGetImage
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/cdk-${Qualifier}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  CloudFormationExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AdministratorAccess'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: PassRole
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:PassRole
                Resource: '*'

  BootstrapVersionParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
      Description: CDK bootstrap version

Outputs:
  AssetBucketName:
    Value: !Ref AssetBucket
  AssetRepositoryUri:
    Value: !GetAtt AssetRepository.RepositoryUri
  KmsKeyArn:
    Value: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
  FilePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt FilePublishingRole.Arn
  ImagePublishingRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt ImagePublishingRole.Arn
  LookupRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt LookupRole.Arn
  DeploymentActionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt DeploymentActionRole.Arn
  CloudFormationExecutionRoleArn:
    Value: !GetAtt CloudFormationExecutionRole.Arn
  BootstrapVersionParameterName:
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersionParameter
  BootstrapVersionValue:
    Value: !Ref BootstrapVersion
  TrustedAccountsConfigured:
    Value: !Ref TrustedAccounts

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Elastic Beanstalk Blue-Green template. Creates (or reuses) an application,
  deploys a sample application version, and creates the blue environment.
  A green environment can be enabled for traffic swapping, then terminated
  after routing traffic back to blue. The platform ARN is resolved at deploy
  time by an in-template Lambda custom resource, and all networking and
  instance-profile dependencies are created in-template (greenfield-safe).
  NOTE: on failure, capture 'aws cloudformation describe-stack-events' and
  'aws elasticbeanstalk describe-events' BEFORE rollback deletes evidence.

Parameters:
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-_]{0,99}$'
    Description: Name of the Elastic Beanstalk application (new or existing).
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: MyApp-env
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9-]{0,48}$'
    Description: Name of the blue Elastic Beanstalk environment.
  CreateGreenEnvironment:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues:
      - 'true'
      - 'false'
    Description: Whether to create a temporary green environment clone for traffic routing.

Conditions:
  CreateApplication: !Equals
    - !Ref ApplicationName
    - MyApp
  CreateGreen: !Equals
    - !Ref CreateGreenEnvironment
    - 'true'

Resources:
  Application:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Application
    Condition: CreateApplication
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Blue-Green Elastic Beanstalk application

  ApplicationVersion:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::ApplicationVersion
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      Description: Sample application version
      SourceBundle:
        S3Bucket: !Sub 'elasticbeanstalk-samples-${AWS::Region}'
        S3Key: python-sample.zip

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetA:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 0
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-a'

  PublicSubnetB:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      AvailabilityZone: !Select
        - 1
        - !GetAZs ''
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${EnvironmentName}-public-b'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetARouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetA
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetBRouteAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetB
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  InstanceSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Beanstalk instance security group
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  EC2Role:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: ec2.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSElasticBeanstalkWebTier

  EC2InstanceProfile:
    Type: AWS::IAM::InstanceProfile
    Properties:
      Roles:
        - !Ref EC2Role

  PlatformResolverRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ListPlatformVersions
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: elasticbeanstalk:ListPlatformVersions
                Resource: '*'

  PlatformResolverFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt PlatformResolverRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          BRANCH_CANDIDATES = [
              'Python 3.13 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
              'Python 3.12 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
              'Python 3.11 running on 64bit Amazon Linux 2023',
          ]

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] == 'Delete':
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  eb = boto3.client('elasticbeanstalk')
                  arn = None
                  for branch in BRANCH_CANDIDATES:
                      resp = eb.list_platform_versions(
                          Filters=[
                              {'Attribute': 'PlatformBranchName', 'Operation': '=', 'Values': [branch]},
                              {'Attribute': 'PlatformStatus', 'Operation': '=', 'Values': ['Ready']},
                          ],
                          MaxRecords=1,
                      )
                      platforms = resp.get('PlatformSummaryList', [])
                      if platforms:
                          detail = eb.describe_platform_version(
                              PlatformArn=platforms[0]['PlatformArn']
                          )
                          arn = detail['PlatformDescription']['PlatformArn']
                          break
                  if not arn:
                      raise RuntimeError('No Ready AL2023 Python platform found in region')
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {'PlatformArn': arn})
              except Exception as e:
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {'Message': str(e)})

  PlatformResolver:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt PlatformResolverFunction.Arn

  BlueEnvironment:
    Type: AWS::ElasticBeanstalk::Environment
    Properties:
      ApplicationName: !If
        - CreateApplication
        - !Ref Application
        - !Ref ApplicationName
      EnvironmentName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      PlatformArn: !GetAtt PlatformResolver.PlatformArn
      OptionSettings:
        - Namespace: aws:elasticbeanstalk:environment
          OptionName: EnvironmentType
          Value: SingleInstance
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: VPCId
          Value: !Ref VPC
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: Subnets
          Value: !Ref PublicSubnetA
        - Namespace: aws:ec2:vpc
          OptionName: AssociatePublicIpAddress
          Value: 'true'
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: SecurityGroups
          Value: !Ref InstanceSecurityGroup
        - Namespace: aws:autoscaling:launchconfiguration
          OptionName: IamInstanceProfile
          Value: !Ref EC2InstanceProfile

  GreenEnvironment:

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Self-contained AWS Service Catalog environment for an ML workshop with two
  portfolios (admin lead and end users), seven products, per-product launch
  constraint roles, and end-user roles with least-privilege access.
  Product templates are seeded into an in-stack, privately encrypted S3
  bucket fronted by a WAF-protected CloudFront distribution with an Origin
  Access Control, so LoadTemplateFromURL resolves over HTTPS only without
  exposing the bucket publicly.

Parameters:
  RootS3Url:
    Type: String
    Description: >
      Root S3 URL where the nested CloudFormation product templates are stored.
      If left at the default, an in-stack bucket seeded with valid product
      templates is used instead.
    Default: USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET
    AllowedPattern: ^(https://.*|USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET)$
  EnvironmentPrefix:
    Type: String
    Description: Environment prefix used for resource naming and tagging.
    Default: user-1
    AllowedPattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$

Conditions:
  UseInStackBucket: !Equals [!Ref RootS3Url, 'USE_IN_STACK_BUCKET']

Resources:

  ############################################################################
  # KMS key, private template bucket, CloudFront + WAF fronting
  ############################################################################
  TemplateBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: KMS key encrypting the ML workshop Service Catalog template bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: RootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: SeederAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: '*'

  TemplateBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-ml-workshop-sc-templates-${AWS::AccountId}'
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt TemplateBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  TemplateOriginAccessControl:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::OriginAccessControl
    Properties:
      OriginAccessControlConfig:
        Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-oac'
        OriginAccessControlOriginType: s3
        SigningBehavior: always
        SigningProtocol: sigv4

  TemplateWebACL:
    Type: AWS::WAFv2::WebACL
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-webacl'
      Scope: CLOUDFRONT
      DefaultAction:
        Allow: {}
      Description: WAF for the ML workshop Service Catalog template distribution
      Rules:
        - Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          Priority: 0
          OverrideAction:
            None: {}
          Statement:
            ManagedRuleGroupStatement:
              VendorName: AWS
              Name: AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet
          VisibilityConfig:
            CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
            MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-CommonRuleSetMetric'
            SampledRequestsEnabled: true
      VisibilityConfig:
        CloudWatchMetricsEnabled: true
        MetricName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-TemplateWebACLMetric'
        SampledRequestsEnabled: true

  TemplateBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref TemplateBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: CloudFrontOACRead
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudfront.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetObject
            Resource: !Sub '${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                AWS:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:cloudfront::${AWS::AccountId}:distribution/${TemplateDistribution}'

  TemplateDistribution:
    Type: AWS::CloudFront::Distribution
    Properties:
      DistributionConfig:
        Enabled: true
        Comment: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop Service Catalog template distribution'
        DefaultRootObject: ''
        WebACLId: !GetAtt TemplateWebACL.Arn
        Origins:
          - Id: template-bucket-origin
            DomainName: !GetAtt TemplateBucket.RegionalDomainName
            S3OriginConfig:
              OriginAccessIdentity: ''
            OriginAccessControlId: !GetAtt TemplateOriginAccessControl.Id
        DefaultCacheBehavior:
          TargetOriginId: template-bucket-origin
          ViewerProtocolPolicy: https-only
          CachePolicyId: 4135ea2d-6df8-44a3-9df3-4b5a84be39ad
        ViewerCertificate:
          CloudFrontDefaultCertificate: true

  TemplateSeedRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: seed-templates
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub '${TemplateBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !GetAtt TemplateBucketKey.Arn

  TemplateSeedFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sc-template-seeder'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt TemplateSeedRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BUCKET_NAME: !Ref TemplateBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import cfnresponse
          import boto3

          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          BUCKET = os.environ['BUCKET_NAME']
          REGION = boto3.session.Session().region_name
          ACCOUNT = boto3.client('sts').get_caller_identity()['Account']

          HEADER = "AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'\n"

          TEMPLATES = {}

          TEMPLATES["vpc-endpoints.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
          Parameters:
            VpcCidr:
              Type: String
              Default: 10.0.0.0/16
          Resources:
            WorkshopVPC:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
              Properties:
                CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
                Tags:
                  - Key: Name
                    Value: ml-workshop-vpc
            PrivateSubnetA:
              Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref WorkshopVPC
                CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
                AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
            PrivateSubnetB:
              Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref WorkshopVPC
                CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Ref VpcCidr, 4, 8]]
                AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
            PrivateRouteTable:
              Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref WorkshopVPC
            S3Endpoint:
              Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
              Properties:
                VpcId: !Ref WorkshopVPC
                ServiceName: __S3_SERVICE_NAME__
                RouteTableIds: [!Ref PrivateRouteTable]
          Outputs:
            VpcId:
              Value: !Ref WorkshopVPC
            PrivateSubnetIds:
              Value: !Join [',', [!Ref PrivateSubnetA, !Ref PrivateSubnetB]]
          """.replace('__S3_SERVICE_NAME__', 'com.amazonaws.' + REGION + '.s3')

          TEMPLATES["iam-kms-s3.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets.
          Resources:
            DataKey:
              Type: AWS::KMS::Key
              Properties:
                Description: ML workshop data encryption key
                EnableKeyRotation: true
                KeyPolicy:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Sid: RootAccess
                      Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        AWS: __ROOT_ARN__
                      Action: kms:*
                      Resource: '*'
            DataBucket:
              Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
              DeletionPolicy: Retain
              UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
              Properties:
                BucketEncryption:
                  ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
                    - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
                        SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
                        KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref DataKey
                PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
                  BlockPublicAcls: true
                  BlockPublicPolicy: true
                  IgnorePublicAcls: true
                  RestrictPublicBuckets: true
            WorkshopRole:
              Type: AWS::IAM::Role
              Properties:
                AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      Action: sts:AssumeRole
                ManagedPolicyArns:
                  - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
          Outputs:
            DataBucketName:
              Value: !Ref DataBucket
            DataKeyArn:
              Value: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            WorkshopRoleArn:
              Value: !GetAtt WorkshopRole.Arn
          """.replace('__ROOT_ARN__', 'arn:aws:iam::' + ACCOUNT + ':root')

          TEMPLATES["aws-dataexchange.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - AWS Data Exchange dataset.
          Parameters:
            DataSetName:
              Type: String
              Default: ml-workshop-third-party-data
            DataSetDescription:
              Type: String
              Default: Third-party data licensed for the ML workshop.
          Resources:
            WorkshopDataSet:
              Type: AWS::DataExchange::DataSet
              Properties:
                AssetType: S3_SNAPSHOT
                Name: !Ref DataSetName
                Description: !Ref DataSetDescription
          Outputs:
            DataSetId:
              Value: !Ref WorkshopDataSet
          """

          TEMPLATES["infrastructure.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - Core infrastructure for the ML application.
          Parameters:
            VpcId:
              Type: String
            PrivateSubnetIds:
              Type: String
            DataBucketName:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            AppSecurityGroup:
              Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
              Properties:
                GroupDescription: ML workshop application security group
                VpcId: !Ref VpcId
                SecurityGroupEgress:
                  - IpProtocol: '-1'
                    CidrIp: 0.0.0.0/0
            ConfigTable:
              Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
              Properties:
                Name: /MLWorkshop/AppConfig
                Type: String
                Value: !Ref DataBucketName
          Outputs:
            AppSecurityGroupId:
              Value: !Ref AppSecurityGroup
          """

          TEMPLATES["application.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - ML application.
          Parameters:
            AppSecurityGroupId:
              Type: String
            PrivateSubnetIds:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            AppFunction:
              Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
              Properties:
                Runtime: python3.12
                Handler: index.handler
                Code:
                  ZipFile: |
                    def handler(event, context):
                        return {'statusCode': 200, 'body': 'ML workshop app'}
                Role: !GetAtt AppFunctionRole.Arn
            AppFunctionRole:
              Type: AWS::IAM::Role
              Properties:
                AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
                      Action: sts:AssumeRole
                ManagedPolicyArns:
                  - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
          Outputs:
            AppFunctionArn:
              Value: !GetAtt AppFunction.Arn
          """

          TEMPLATES["sagemaker-notebook.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - SageMaker notebook instance.
          Parameters:
            NotebookInstanceType:
              Type: String
              Default: ml.t3.medium
            PrivateSubnetIds:
              Type: String
            AppSecurityGroupId:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            NotebookRole:
              Type: AWS::IAM::Role
              Properties:
                AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      Action: sts:AssumeRole
                ManagedPolicyArns:
                  - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonSageMakerFullAccess
                  - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
            NotebookInstance:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::NotebookInstance
              Properties:
                InstanceType: !Ref NotebookInstanceType
                RoleArn: !GetAtt NotebookRole.Arn
                SubnetId: !Select [0, !Split [',', !Ref PrivateSubnetIds]]
                SecurityGroupIds: [!Ref AppSecurityGroupId]
          Outputs:
            NotebookName:
              Value: !Ref NotebookInstance
          """

          TEMPLATES["third-party-ml-model.template.yaml"] = HEADER + """\
          Description: Product template - Third-party ML model endpoint.
          Parameters:
            ModelDataUrl:
              Type: String
              Default: s3://aws-ml-blog-artifacts/model.tar.gz
            PrivateSubnetIds:
              Type: String
            AppSecurityGroupId:
              Type: String
          Resources:
            ModelExecutionRole:
              Type: AWS::IAM::Role
              Properties:
                AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
                  Version: '2012-10-17'
                  Statement:
                    - Effect: Allow
                      Principal:
                        Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
                      Action: sts:AssumeRole
                ManagedPolicyArns:
                  - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AmazonS3ReadOnlyAccess
            WorkshopModel:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::Model
              Properties:
                ExecutionRoleArn: !GetAtt ModelExecutionRole.Arn
                PrimaryContainer:
                  Image: __ECR_IMAGE__
                  ModelDataUrl: !Ref ModelDataUrl
            EndpointConfig:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::EndpointConfig
              Properties:
                ProductionVariants:
                  - VariantName: all-traffic
                    ModelName: !GetAtt WorkshopModel.ModelName
                    InstanceType: ml.t2.medium
                    InitialInstanceCount: 1
            Endpoint:
              Type: AWS::SageMaker::Endpoint
              Properties:
                EndpointConfigName: !GetAtt EndpointConfig.EndpointConfigName
          Outputs:
            EndpointName:
              Value: !Ref Endpoint
          """.replace('__ECR_IMAGE__', ACCOUNT + '.dkr.ecr.' + REGION + '.amazonaws.com/ml-workshop-inference:latest')

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event['RequestType'] in ('Create', 'Update'):
                      for key, body in TEMPLATES.items():
                          s3.put_object(
                              Bucket=BUCKET,
                              Key=key,
                              Body=body.encode('utf-8'),
                              ContentType='text/plain'
                          )
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {})

  TemplateSeed:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn: TemplateBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt TemplateSeedFunction.Arn

  ############################################################################
  # Portfolios
  ############################################################################
  AdminPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-admin-portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshopAdminTeam
      Description: !Sub 'Admin team portfolio for ${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Team
          Value: admin

  EndUserPortfolio:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::Portfolio
    Properties:
      DisplayName: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-enduser-portfolio'
      ProviderName: MLWorkshopEndUsers
      Description: !Sub 'End user portfolio for ${EnvironmentPrefix} ML workshop'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix
        - Key: Team
          Value: enduser

  ############################################################################
  # Products (URL: CloudFront in-stack, or RootS3Url when overridden)
  ############################################################################
  VPCProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-vpc-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: VPC with private subnets and VPC endpoints.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/vpc-endpoints.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  IAMKMSBucketProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-iam-kms-s3-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: IAM roles with KMS keys and S3 buckets.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/iam-kms-s3.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  DataExchangeProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-data-exchange-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: AWS Data Exchange dataset product.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/aws-dataexchange.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  InfrastructureProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-infrastructure-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Core infrastructure for the ML application.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/infrastructure.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ApplicationProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-application-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: ML application product.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/application.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  SageMakerNotebookProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-sagemaker-notebook-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: SageMaker notebook instance.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/sagemaker-notebook.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ThirdPartyMLModelProduct:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::CloudFormationProduct
    DependsOn: TemplateSeed
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${EnvironmentPrefix}-third-party-ml-model-product'
      Owner: MLWorkshop
      Description: Third-party ML model product.
      ProvisioningArtifactParameters:
        - Name: v1.0
          Info:
            LoadTemplateFromURL: !Join
              - ''
              - - !If [UseInStackBucket, !Sub 'https://${TemplateDistribution.DomainName}', !Ref RootS3Url]
                - '/third-party-ml-model.template.yaml'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentPrefix

  ############################################################################
  # Portfolio-Product Associations
  ############################################################################
  AdminPortfolioVPCAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref VPCProduct

  AdminPortfolioIAMKMSAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref IAMKMSBucketProduct

  AdminPortfolioDataExchangeAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref DataExchangeProduct

  AdminPortfolioInfraAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref AdminPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  EndUserPortfolioInfraAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref InfrastructureProduct

  EndUserPortfolioAppAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ApplicationProduct

  EndUserPortfolioNotebookAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref SageMakerNotebookProduct

  EndUserPortfolioMLModelAssoc:
    Type: AWS::ServiceCatalog::PortfolioProductAssociation
    Properties:
      PortfolioId: !Ref EndUserPortfolio
      ProductId: !Ref ThirdPartyMLModelProduct

  ############################################################################
  # Launch constraint roles (one per product/portfolio)
  ############################################################################
  LaunchRoleBasePolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::ManagedPolicy
    Properties:
      Description: Common permissions required by all Service Catalog launch constraint roles.
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action:
              - cloudformation:CreateStack
              - cloudformation:DeleteStack
              - cloudformation:DescribeStacks
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackEvents
              - cloudformation:DescribeStackResources
              - cloudformation:UpdateStack
              - cloudformation:CreateChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DeleteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:DescribeChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ExecuteChangeSet
              - cloudformation:ValidateTemplate
              - cloudformation:GetTemplate
              - cloudformation:SetStackPolicy
              - cloudformation:CreateUploadBucket
              - cloudformation:SignalResource
              - cloudformation:TagResource
              - cloudformation:List*
              - s3:GetObject
              - s3:ListBucket
              - iam:GetRole
              - iam:GetRolePolicy
              - iam:PassRole
              - iam:CreateRole
              - iam:DeleteRole
              - iam:PutRolePolicy
              - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
              - iam:AttachRolePolicy
              - iam:DetachRolePolicy
              - iam:TagRole
              - iam:ListRoles
            Resource: '*'

  VPCProductLaunchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Environment VPC with IPv4/IPv6 dual-stack support for staging or production.
  Three public subnets, two private subnets, IGW, egress-only IGW, optional NAT
  Gateway, two network ACLs, placement group, and DHCP options set.

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Description: Target environment (staging or production)
    AllowedValues:
      - staging
      - production
    Default: staging
  DeployNat:
    Type: String
    Description: Whether to deploy a NAT Gateway with Elastic IP for the private subnets
    AllowedValues:
      - "true"
      - "false"
    Default: "false"

Conditions:
  ShouldDeployNat: !Equals [!Ref DeployNat, "true"]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentCidrs:
    staging:
      VpcCidr: 10.100.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.100.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.100.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.100.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.100.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.100.11.0/24
      DomainName: staging.internal
    production:
      VpcCidr: 10.200.0.0/16
      PublicSubnet1Cidr: 10.200.0.0/24
      PublicSubnet2Cidr: 10.200.1.0/24
      PublicSubnet3Cidr: 10.200.2.0/24
      PrivateSubnet1Cidr: 10.200.10.0/24
      PrivateSubnet2Cidr: 10.200.11.0/24
      DomainName: production.internal

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, VpcCidr]
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vpc-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  VPCIpv6CidrBlock:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCCidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AmazonProvidedIpv6CidrBlock: true

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-igw-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  EgressOnlyInternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EgressOnlyInternetGateway
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  DhcpOptions:
    Type: AWS::EC2::DHCPOptions
    Properties:
      DomainName: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, DomainName]
      DomainNameServers:
        - AmazonProvidedDNS
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-dhcp-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DhcpOptionsAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCDHCPOptionsAssociation
    Properties:
      DhcpOptionsId: !Ref DhcpOptions
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [0, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [1, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: presentation

  PublicSubnet3:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PublicSubnet3Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [2, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-3-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: compute

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet1Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [3, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: application

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    DependsOn: VPCIpv6CidrBlock
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      CidrBlock: !FindInMap [EnvironmentCidrs, !Ref Environment, PrivateSubnet2Cidr]
      Ipv6CidrBlock: !Select [4, !Cidr [!Select [0, !GetAtt VPC.Ipv6CidrBlocks], 256, 64]]
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Tier
          Value: data

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-public-rt-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PublicRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet3RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet3
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGatewayEIP:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  NatGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatGatewayEIP.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-nat-${Environment}"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  PrivateRouteIPv4:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: ShouldDeployNat
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway

  PrivateRouteIPv6:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable
      DestinationIpv6CidrBlock: ::/0
      EgressOnlyInternetGatewayId: !Ref EgressOnlyInternetGateway

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable

  PublicNetworkAcl:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NetworkAcl
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
