AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained serverless Movies API (Lambda + DynamoDB + API Gateway REST API with CORS)

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Stage name for the API Gateway deployment.
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$'

Resources:

  MoviesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'Movies-${EnvironmentName}'
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: title
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: title
          KeyType: HASH
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      DeletionProtectionEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        Enabled: true
        AttributeName: expiresAt
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
        - 'arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBCrudPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'dynamodb:GetItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:PutItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:UpdateItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:DeleteItem'
                  - 'dynamodb:Query'
                  - 'dynamodb:Scan'
                Resource: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateApiGatewayLogGroups
                Effect: Allow
                Action: 'logs:CreateLogGroup'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: WriteApiGatewayLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'logs:CreateLogStream'
                  - 'logs:DescribeLogStreams'
                  - 'logs:PutLogEvents'
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/apigateway/*:log-stream:*'

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiAccessLogs:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/apigateway/movies-api-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-create-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  ReadMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-read-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  UpdateMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-update-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  DeleteMovieLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/aws/lambda/movies-delete-${EnvironmentName}'
      RetentionInDays: 1
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api

  CreateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: CreateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-create-${EnvironmentName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
              if 'title' not in body:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Missing required attribute: title'})
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              return _response(201, {'message': 'Movie created', 'movie': body})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(payload)
              }

  ReadMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: ReadMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-read-${EnvironmentName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              title = path_params.get('title')
              if title:
                  result = table.get_item(Key={'title': title})
                  item = result.get('Item')
                  if item is None:
                      return _response(404, {'message': 'Movie not found'})
                  return _response(200, item)
              result = table.scan()
              return _response(200, {'movies': result.get('Items', [])})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(payload, default=str)
              }

  UpdateMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: UpdateMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-update-${EnvironmentName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              title = path_params.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Missing path parameter: title'})
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Invalid JSON body'})
              if not body:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Request body must contain attributes to update'})
              title_value = body.pop('title', title)
              if title_value != title:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Body title must match path parameter title'})
              update_expression = 'SET ' + ', '.join(f'#{k} = :{k}' for k in body)
              expression_attribute_names = {f'#{k}': k for k in body}
              expression_attribute_values = {f':{k}': v for k, v in body.items()}
              result = table.update_item(
                  Key={'title': title},
                  UpdateExpression=update_expression,
                  ExpressionAttributeNames=expression_attribute_names,
                  ExpressionAttributeValues=expression_attribute_values,
                  ReturnValues='ALL_NEW'
              )
              return _response(200, {'message': 'Movie updated', 'movie': result.get('Attributes', {})})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(payload, default=str)
              }

  DeleteMovieFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn: DeleteMovieLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub 'movies-delete-${EnvironmentName}'
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref MoviesTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os
          import json
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['TABLE_NAME'])

          def handler(event, context):
              path_params = event.get('pathParameters') or {}
              title = path_params.get('title')
              if not title:
                  return _response(400, {'message': 'Missing path parameter: title'})
              table.delete_item(Key={'title': title})
              return _response(200, {'message': f'Movie {title} deleted'})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  'statusCode': status,
                  'headers': {
                      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                      'Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '*'
                  },
                  'body': json.dumps(payload)
              }

  MoviesRestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub 'movies-api-${EnvironmentName}'
      Description: Regional REST API for movie CRUD operations with CORS support
      FailOnWarnings: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Project
          Value: movies-api
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL

  MovieModel:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Model
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ContentType: 'application/json'
      Name: MovieModel
      Schema:
        $schema: 'http://json-schema.org/draft-04/schema#'
        type: object
        required:
          - title
        properties:
          title:
            type: string

  BodyValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      Name: body-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: true
      ValidateRequestParameters: false

  ParamValidator:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RequestValidator
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      Name: param-validator
      ValidateRequestBody: false
      ValidateRequestParameters: true

  MoviesResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt MoviesRestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: Movies

  MovieTitleResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ParentId: !Ref MoviesResource
      PathPart: '{title}'

  MoviesPostMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: CreateMovie
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyValidator
      RequestModels:
        'application/json': !Ref MovieModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesPutMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: PUT
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: UpdateMovie
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref BodyValidator
      RequestModels:
        'application/json': !Ref MovieModel
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${UpdateMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesDeleteMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: DELETE
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: DeleteMovie
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${DeleteMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MovieTitleGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      OperationName: ReadMovie
      RequestValidatorId: !Ref ParamValidator
      RequestParameters:
        'method.request.path.title': true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${ReadMovieFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  MoviesOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MoviesResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '''Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'''
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods': '''POST,PUT,DELETE,OPTIONS'''
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '''*'''
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{}'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers': false
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods': false
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin': false

  MovieTitleOptionsMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref MovieTitleResource
      HttpMethod: OPTIONS
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: MOCK
        IntegrationResponses:
          - StatusCode: '200'
            ResponseParameters:
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers': '''Content-Type,X-Amz-Date,Authorization,X-Api-Key,X-Amz-Security-Token'''
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods': '''GET,OPTIONS'''
              'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin': '''*'''
            ResponseTemplates:
              application/json: '{}'
        RequestTemplates:
          application/json: '{"statusCode": 200}'
      MethodResponses:
        - StatusCode: '200'
          ResponseParameters:
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Headers': false
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Methods': false
            'method.response.header.Access-Control-Allow-Origin': false

  CreateMovieInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateMovieFunction
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesRestApi}/*/*/Movies'

  ReadMovieInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref ReadMovieFunction
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesRestApi}/*/*/Movies/*'

  UpdateMovieInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref UpdateMovieFunction
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesRestApi}/*/*/Movies'

  DeleteMovieInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref DeleteMovieFunction
      Action: 'lambda:InvokeFunction'
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${MoviesRestApi}/*/*/Movies'

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - ApiGatewayAccount
      - MoviesPostMethod
      - MoviesPutMethod
      - MoviesDeleteMethod
      - MovieTitleGetMethod
      - MoviesOptionsMethod
      - MovieTitleOptionsMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref MoviesRestApi
      Description: Movies API deployment bound to the environment stage
      StageName: !Ref EnvironmentName
      StageDescription:
        Description: !Sub '${EnvironmentName} stage of the Movies API'
        TracingEnabled: true
        AccessLogSetting:
          DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogs.Arn
          Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","resourcePath":"$context.resourcePath","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
        MethodSettings:
          - ResourcePath: '/*'
            HttpMethod: '*'
            LoggingLevel: INFO
            MetricsEnabled: true
            DataTraceEnabled: false
            ThrottlingBurstLimit: 500
            ThrottlingRateLimit: 1000

Outputs:
  ApiInvokeUrl:
    Description: Invoke URL for the Movies API stage
    Value: !Sub 'https://${MoviesRestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${EnvironmentName}'
  MoviesTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table name
    Value: !Ref MoviesTable
  MoviesTableArn:
    Description: DynamoDB table ARN
    Value: !GetAtt MoviesTable.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: SageMaker Studio MLOps engineer user profile with scoped execution roles and optional self-contained domain.

Parameters:
  ExistingDomainId:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional existing SageMaker Studio domain ID. Leave empty to create a new domain.
  SecurityGroupIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional security group IDs associated with the existing domain.
  SubnetIds:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional subnet IDs associated with the existing domain.

Conditions:
  CreateNewDomain: !Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']
  UseExistingDomain: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExistingDomainId, '']]
  UsingProvidedSGs: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SecurityGroupIds], '']]
  UsingProvidedSubnets: !Not [!Equals [!Join ['', !Ref SubnetIds], '']]

Resources:
  MLOpsExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'sagemaker-mlops-execution-role-${AWS::Region}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sagemaker.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: MLOpsPipelineMonitoringGovernance
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: PipelinesReadOnlyAndExecutions

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-vpc

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Condition: CreateNewDomain

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 10.0.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-subnet

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  StudioSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for SageMaker Studio domain
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: sagemaker-studio-sg

  SageMakerDomain:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::Domain
    Condition: CreateNewDomain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      DomainName: mlops-studio-domain
      AuthMode: IAM
      AppNetworkAccessType: PublicInternetOnly
      DefaultUserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PublicSubnet
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      DomainSettings:
        SecurityGroupIds:
          - !Ref StudioSecurityGroup

  ExistingDomainSGRecord:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Condition: UsingProvidedSGs
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/sagemaker-studio/${AWS::StackName}/existing-domain-security-groups'
      Type: StringList
      Value: !Join [',', !Ref SecurityGroupIds]
      Description: Security group IDs supplied for use with the existing SageMaker Studio domain (traceability record only).

  ExistingDomainSubnetRecord:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Condition: UsingProvidedSubnets
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/sagemaker-studio/${AWS::StackName}/existing-domain-subnets'
      Type: StringList
      Value: !Join [',', !Ref SubnetIds]
      Description: Subnet IDs supplied for use with the existing SageMaker Studio domain (traceability record only).

  MLOpsUserProfile:
    Type: AWS::SageMaker::UserProfile
    Properties:
      DomainId: !If
        - UseExistingDomain
        - !Ref ExistingDomainId
        - !Ref SageMakerDomain
      UserProfileName: mlops-engineer
      UserSettings:
        ExecutionRole: !GetAtt PerUserExecutionRole.Arn

  UserProfileArn:

    Value: !GetAtt MLOpsExecutionRole.Arn

    Description: ARN of the per-user SageMaker execution role.
    Value: !GetAtt PerUserExecutionRole.Arn

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >-
  CloudWatch monitoring for cross-language database encryption SDK performance
  benchmarks. Creates a CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
  benchmark result events, plus 40 CloudWatch Logs metric filters (eight per
  language: Java, .NET/DotNet, Python, Go, Rust) that publish memory efficiency,
  peak memory, throughput latency, and concurrency latency metrics into
  per-language CloudWatch namespaces with a Language dimension.

Parameters:
  BenchmarkLogGroupName:
    Type: String
    Description: >-
      Name of the CloudWatch Logs log group that receives structured JSON
      benchmark result events.
    Default: /benchmarks/encryption-sdk/performance
    AllowedPattern: '^[\.\/#A-Za-z0-9\-_]+$'
    ConstraintDescription: >-
      Log group name may only contain letters, digits, underscores, hyphens,
      slashes, dots, and the '#' character.

Mappings:
  Languages:
    Java:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Java
    DotNet:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/DotNet
    Python:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Python
    Go:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Go
    Rust:
      MetricNamespace: EncryptionBenchmarks/Rust

Resources:
  BenchmarkLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroupName
      RetentionInDays: 30

  JavaMemoryEfficiencyRatioFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter
    Properties:
      FilterName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-java-memory-efficiency-ratio'
      LogGroupName: !Ref BenchmarkLogGroup
      FilterPattern: '{ $.language = "Java" && $.test_type = "memory" }'
      MetricTransformations:
        - MetricName: MemoryEfficiencyRatio
          MetricNamespace: !FindInMap [Languages, Java, MetricNamespace]
          MetricValue: '$.memory_efficiency_ratio'
          Dimensions:
            - Key: Language
              Value: '$.language'

  JavaPeakMemoryFilter:
    Type: AWS::Logs::MetricFilter

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Self-contained AppSync GraphQL Todo API with JS pipeline resolvers and DynamoDB

Resources:
  TodoTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: TodoTable
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: owner
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: id
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: owner-index
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: owner
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  AppSyncServiceRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: appsync.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TodoTable}'
                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${TodoTable}/index/*'

  GraphQLApi:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLApi
    Properties:
      Name: TodoAPIwithJs
      AuthenticationType: API_KEY

  GraphQLApiKey:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::ApiKey
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Description: Default API Key

  GraphQLSchema:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Definition: |
        schema {
          query: Query
          mutation: Mutation
          subscription: Subscription
        }

        type Todo {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
          owner: String
          version: Int
          createdAt: AWSDateTime
          updatedAt: AWSDateTime
        }

        input CreateTodoInput {
          title: String!
          content: String
          owner: String
        }

        input UpdateTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          title: String
          content: String
          owner: String
          version: Int
        }

        input DeleteTodoInput {
          id: ID!
          version: Int
        }

        input TodoFilterInput {
          id: IDFilterInput
          title: StringFilterInput
          content: StringFilterInput
          owner: StringFilterInput
        }

        input IDFilterInput {
          ne: ID
          eq: ID
          le: ID
          lt: ID
          ge: ID
          gt: ID
          contains: ID
          notContains: ID
          beginsWith: ID
          in: [ID]
          notIn: [ID]
        }

        input StringFilterInput {
          ne: String
          eq: String
          le: String
          lt: String
          ge: String
          gt: String
          contains: String
          notContains: String
          beginsWith: String
          in: [String]
          notIn: [String]
        }

        enum SortDirection {
          ASC
          DESC
        }

        type TodoConnection {
          items: [Todo]
          nextToken: String
        }

        type Query {
          getTodo(id: ID!): Todo
          listTodos(filter: TodoFilterInput, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
          queryTodosByOwner(owner: String!, sortDirection: SortDirection, filter: TodoFilterInput, limit: Int, nextToken: String): TodoConnection
        }

        type Mutation {
          createTodo(input: CreateTodoInput!): Todo
          updateTodo(input: UpdateTodoInput!): Todo
          deleteTodo(input: DeleteTodoInput!): Todo
        }

        type Subscription {
          onCreateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["createTodo"])
          onUpdateTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["updateTodo"])
          onDeleteTodo: Todo @aws_subscribe(mutations: ["deleteTodo"])
        }

  TodoDataSource:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::DataSource
    DependsOn: GraphQLSchema
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: TodoDs
      Type: AMAZON_DYNAMODB
      ServiceRoleArn: !GetAtt AppSyncServiceRole.Arn
      DynamoDBConfig:
        TableName: !Ref TodoTable
        AwsRegion: !Ref AWS::Region

  CreateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: CreateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const { args } = ctx;
          const id = util.autoId();
          const createdAt = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const values = {
            title: args.input.title,
            content: args.input.content,
            owner: args.input.owner,
            version: 1,
            createdAt: createdAt,
            updatedAt: createdAt,
          };
          return {
            operation: 'PutItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: id }),
            attributeValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(values),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  UpdateTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: UpdateTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const input = ctx.args.input;
          const id = input.id;
          const updatedAt = util.time.nowISO8601();
          const names = {};
          const vals = {};
          const sets = [];
          const fields = ['title', 'content', 'owner'];
          let i = 0;
          for (const k of fields) {
            if (input[k] !== undefined) {
              names['#k' + i] = k;
              vals[':v' + i] = input[k];
              sets.push('#k' + i + ' = :v' + i);
              i = i + 1;
            }
          }
          names['#u'] = 'updatedAt';
          vals[':u'] = updatedAt;
          sets.push('#u = :u');
          return {
            operation: 'UpdateItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: id }),
            update: {
              expression: 'SET ' + sets.join(', '),
              expressionNames: names,
              expressionValues: util.dynamodb.toMapValues(vals),
            },
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  DeleteTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: DeleteTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'DeleteItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.input.id }),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  GetTodoFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: GetTodoFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          return {
            operation: 'GetItem',
            key: util.dynamodb.toMapValues({ id: ctx.args.id }),
          };
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return ctx.result;
        }

  ListTodosFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: ListTodosFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const req = {
            operation: 'Scan',
          };
          if (ctx.args.limit !== undefined) {
            req.limit = ctx.args.limit;
          }
          if (ctx.args.nextToken !== undefined) {
            req.nextToken = ctx.args.nextToken;
          }
          if (ctx.args.filter !== undefined) {
            req.filter = util.transform.toDynamoDBFilterExpression(ctx.args.filter);
          }
          return req;
        }
        export function response(ctx) {
          return { items: ctx.result.items, nextToken: ctx.result.nextToken };
        }

  QueryTodosByOwnerFunction:
    Type: AWS::AppSync::FunctionConfiguration
    DependsOn: [GraphQLSchema, TodoDataSource]
    Properties:
      ApiId: !GetAtt GraphQLApi.ApiId
      Name: QueryTodosByOwnerFunction
      DataSourceName: TodoDs
      Runtime:
        Name: APPSYNC_JS
        RuntimeVersion: '1.0.0'
      Code: |
        import { util } from '@aws-appsync/utils';
        export function request(ctx) {
          const req = {
            operation: 'Query',
            index: 'owner-index',
            query: {
              expression: '#owner = :owner',
              expressionNames: { '#owner': 'owner' },
              expressionValues: { ':owner': util.dynamodb.toDynamoDB(ctx.args.owner) },
            },

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Data Master project - self-contained IAM role set for data pipeline (ingestion through analytics).
  IMPORTANT: Both parameters carry PLACEHOLDER defaults required by validation tooling. They MUST be
  overridden at deployment time (via --parameters or a parameter file) with:
  - KmsKeyArn: the real pre-existing KMS key ARN in the target account/region (the template does not
    create a KMS key). Default placeholder: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:000000000000:key/replace-me-at-deploy-time
  - TargetAccountId: the 12-digit target AWS account ID for STS AssumeRole scoping.
    Default placeholder: 000000000000
  Failure to override the defaults will create roles whose KMS and DMS statements reference
  non-existent resources (the 000000000000 account/key does not exist).

Parameters:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Type: String
    Description: ARN of existing KMS key used for raw data encryption. PLACEHOLDER default must be overridden at deploy time.
    Default: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:000000000000:key/replace-me-at-deploy-time
    AllowedPattern: "^arn:aws:kms:[a-z0-9-]+:[0-9]{12}:key/.+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid KMS key ARN
  TargetAccountId:
    Type: String
    Description: Target AWS Account ID used to scope STS AssumeRole trust policies. PLACEHOLDER default must be overridden at deploy time.
    Default: "000000000000"
    AllowedPattern: "^[0-9]{12}$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a 12-digit AWS account ID

Metadata:
  AWS::CloudFormation::Interface:
    ParameterGroups:
      - Label:
          default: Required Deploy-Time Inputs (placeholders MUST be overridden)
        Parameters:
          - KmsKeyArn
          - TargetAccountId
    ParameterLabels:
      KmsKeyArn:
        default: "Existing KMS key ARN for raw data encryption (placeholder default; override at deploy time)"
      TargetAccountId:
        default: "Target AWS account ID for STS AssumeRole scoping (placeholder default; override at deploy time)"

Resources:

  DmsKinesisRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-dms-kinesis-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dms.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-kinesis-write
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:PutRecord
                  - kinesis:PutRecords
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:ListStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:kinesis:*:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - iam:CreateRole
                  - iam:DeleteRole
                  - iam:GetRole
                  - iam:PassRole
                  - iam:TagRole
                  - iam:UntagRole
                  - iam:PutRolePolicy
                  - iam:DeleteRolePolicy
                  - iam:ListRolePolicies
                  - ec2:DescribeVpcs
                  - ec2:DescribeInternetGateways
                  - ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces
                  - ec2:DescribeAddresses
                  - ec2:DescribeSecurityGroups
                  - ec2:DescribeSubnets
                  - ec2:DeleteNetworkInterface
                  - ec2:CreateNetworkInterface
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${TargetAccountId}:role/dms-vpc-role-*"
        - PolicyName: dm-dms-assume-cross-account
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: sts:AssumeRole
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${TargetAccountId}:role/dm-*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  EventBridgePipesRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-eventbridge-pipes-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: pipes.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: dm-pipes-forward-firehose
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord
                  - firehose:PutRecordBatch
                  - firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream
                  - firehose:ListDeliveryStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:firehose:*:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - sqs:ReceiveMessage
                  - sqs:DeleteMessage
                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                  - sqs:GetQueueUrl
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kinesis:DescribeStream
                  - kinesis:DescribeStreamSummary
                  - kinesis:GetRecords
                  - kinesis:GetShardIterator
                  - kinesis:ListShards
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:kinesis:*:${AWS::AccountId}:stream/dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeStream
                  - dynamodb:GetRecords
                  - dynamodb:GetShardIterator
                  - dynamodb:ListStreams
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:dynamodb:*:${AWS::AccountId}:table/dm-*/stream/*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  LambdaProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lambda-processor-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:

                  - kinesis:DescribeStream

              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - firehose:PutRecord

                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:firehose:*:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                  - s3:PutObject
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  LambdaRouterRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-lambda-router-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:

                  - sqs:GetQueueAttributes
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:sqs:*:${AWS::AccountId}:dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow

                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:events:*:${AWS::AccountId}:event-bus/dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:GetObject
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:s3:::dm-*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: kms:Decrypt
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: DataMaster
        - Key: Component
          Value: Roles

  ProcessingControllerRole:

    Properties:
      RoleName: dm-processing-controller-role
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow

      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:

            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow

                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !Ref KmsKeyArn
        - PolicyName: dm-controller-pipeline
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:

      Tags:

              - Effect: Allow

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >-
  Cross-region failover health monitoring for the existing Remittance API Gateway API,
  the existing GetRemittances and CreateRemittance Lambda functions, and the existing
  dbcluster1-instance1 RDS instance. This template creates ONLY AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
  and AWS::CloudWatch::CompositeAlarm resources and references the pre-existing
  monitored resources strictly via metric dimension NAME strings (ApiName,
  FunctionName, DBInstanceIdentifier).

Resources:

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # API Gateway metric alarms (existing API referenced via ApiName: Remittance)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RemittanceApi4XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-4xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average 4XXError count above 0 over a
        300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 4XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RemittanceApi5XXErrorAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-5xx-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average 5XXError count above 1 over a
        60 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: 5XXError
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RemittanceApiLatencyAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: remittance-api-latency
      AlarmDescription: >-
        Remittance API Gateway health: average Latency at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/ApiGateway
      MetricName: Latency
      Dimensions:
        - Name: ApiName
          Value: Remittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda metric alarms (existing functions referenced via FunctionName)
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  GetRemittancesErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: summed Errors above 0 over a 60 second
        period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  GetRemittancesInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-invocations
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: summed Invocations above 2 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  GetRemittancesDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: getremittances-duration
      AlarmDescription: >-
        GetRemittances Lambda health: average Duration at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: GetRemittances
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-errors
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: summed Errors above 0 over a 60 second
        period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Errors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 0
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceInvocationsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-invocations
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: summed Invocations above 2 over a 60
        second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Invocations
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 2
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  CreateRemittanceDurationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: createremittance-duration
      AlarmDescription: >-
        CreateRemittance Lambda health: average Duration at or above 10000
        milliseconds over a 900 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/Lambda
      MetricName: Duration
      Dimensions:
        - Name: FunctionName
          Value: CreateRemittance
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 900
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 10000
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: missing
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # RDS metric alarms (existing instance referenced via DBInstanceIdentifier)
  # TreatMissingData intentionally left unset so the CloudWatch default (missing)
  # applies.
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
  RdsCpuUtilizationAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-cpu-utilization
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average CPUUtilization at or above 70
        percent over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: CPUUtilization
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 70
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsDatabaseConnectionsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-database-connections
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average DatabaseConnections at or
        above 100 over a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: DatabaseConnections
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      DatapointsToAlarm: 1
      Threshold: 100
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      Tags:
        - Key: Application
          Value: Remittance
        - Key: Purpose
          Value: CrossRegionFailoverHealth

  RdsDeadlocksAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: dbcluster1-instance1-deadlocks
      AlarmDescription: >-
        dbcluster1-instance1 RDS health: average Deadlocks at or above 10 over
        a 300 second period.
      Namespace: AWS/RDS
      MetricName: Deadlocks
      Dimensions:
        - Name: DBInstanceIdentifier
          Value: dbcluster1-instance1
      Statistic: Average

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  QuickSight admin suite monitoring and data extraction pipeline.
  Seven Glue jobs (five Python Shell on Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9, two ETL on Glue 5.0 G.1X),
  seven scheduled triggers (every 3 hours), five CloudWatch metric streams feeding
  five DirectPut Firehose delivery streams, all writing to a private S3 bucket
  encrypted with a customer managed KMS key.
  NOTE: Glue 3.0 / Python 3.9 shell jobs are user-specified legacy versions -
  confirm compatibility before deployment; they are intentionally NOT upgraded.

Parameters:
  ScriptBucketName:
    Type: String
    Default: admin-suite-scripts
    Description: >
      Name of the predefined S3 bucket containing the Glue job scripts.
      Scripts are expected under s3://<ScriptBucketName>/scripts/<job_name>.py.
      This bucket must exist prior to deployment (it hosts the job code).

Resources:
  OutputBucketKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for admin-suite output bucket encryption
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowFirehoseServiceUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: firehose.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - 'kms:Encrypt'
              - 'kms:Decrypt'
              - 'kms:ReEncrypt*'
              - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
              - 'kms:DescribeKey'
            Resource: '*'

  OutputBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketNamespace: 'account-regional'
      BucketNamePrefix: admin-suite-
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: 'aws:kms'
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      OwnershipControls:
        Rules:
          - ObjectOwnership: BucketOwnerEnforced

  OutputBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref OutputBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLSRequestsOnly
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
              - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  PipelineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub 'admin-suite-pipeline-role-${AWS::AccountId}'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - glue.amazonaws.com
                - cloudformation.amazonaws.com
                - firehose.amazonaws.com
                - streams.metrics.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: 'sts:AssumeRole'
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSGlueServiceRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: AdminSuitePipelineInlinePolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: QuickSightReadOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'quicksight:Describe*'
                  - 'quicksight:List*'
                  - 'quicksight:Search*'
                  - 'quicksight:GetDashboardEmbedUrl'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSource'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeDataSet'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDataSets'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDataSources'
                  - 'quicksight:ListDashboardVersions'
                  - 'quicksight:ListAnalyses'
                  - 'quicksight:ListFolders'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeFolder'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTopic'
                  - 'quicksight:ListTopics'
                  - 'quicksight:DescribeTemplate'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:quicksight:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
              - Sid: GlueJobOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'glue:StartJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRun'
                  - 'glue:GetJobRuns'
                  - 'glue:GetJob'
                  - 'glue:GetJobs'
                  - 'glue:BatchStopJobRun'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:glue:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:job/etl_job_admin_suite_*'
              - Sid: S3BucketAndObjectAccess
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                  - 's3:PutObject'
                  - 's3:PutObjectAcl'
                  - 's3:ListBucket'
                  - 's3:GetBucketLocation'
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt OutputBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub '${OutputBucket.Arn}/*'
              - Sid: KmsBucketEncryption
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'kms:Encrypt'
                  - 'kms:Decrypt'
                  - 'kms:GenerateDataKey*'
                  - 'kms:DescribeKey'
                Resource: !GetAtt OutputBucketKmsKey.Arn
              - Sid: ReadScriptsFromScriptBucket
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 's3:GetObject'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:s3:::${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/*'
              - Sid: CloudWatchMetricsAndStreams
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricData'
                  - 'cloudwatch:ListMetrics'
                  - 'cloudwatch:PutMetricStream'
                  - 'cloudwatch:GetMetricStream'
                  - 'cloudwatch:DeleteMetricStream'
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: FirehosePutOperations
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'firehose:PutRecord'
                  - 'firehose:PutRecordBatch'
                  - 'firehose:DescribeDeliveryStream'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:firehose:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:deliverystream/admin-suite-metric-stream-*'
              - Sid: IAMPassRole
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - 'iam:PassRole'
                  - 'iam:GetRole'
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/admin-suite-pipeline-role-${AWS::AccountId}'

  GlueJobAssetsAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'assets-access/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_assets_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'assets-metadata/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobFolderAssets:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_folder_assets.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'folder-assets/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobQMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_metadata.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'q-metadata/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobQAccess:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_q_access
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '3.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      Command:
        Name: pythonshell
        PythonVersion: '3.9'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_q_access.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'q-access/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobDsProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_ds_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'ds-properties/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

  GlueJobDatasourceProperties:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Job
    Properties:
      Name: etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineRole.Arn
      GlueVersion: '5.0'
      ExecutionProperty:
        MaxConcurrentRuns: 1
      Timeout: 120
      MaxRetries: 0
      WorkerType: G.1X
      NumberOfWorkers: 2
      Command:
        Name: glueetl
        PythonVersion: '3'
        ScriptLocation: !Sub 's3://${ScriptBucketName}/scripts/etl_job_admin_suite_datasource_properties.py'
      DefaultArguments:
        '--AWS_REGION': !Sub '${AWS::Region}'
        '--AWS_ACCOUNT_ID': !Sub '${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--OUTPUT_BUCKET': !Ref OutputBucket
        '--OUTPUT_PREFIX': !Sub 'datasource-properties/${AWS::AccountId}'
        '--enable-metrics': 'true'
        '--enable-continuous-cloudwatch-log': 'true'

    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-trigger-assets-access
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsAccess

  TriggerAssetsMetadata:
    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:
      Name: admin-suite-trigger-assets-metadata
      Type: SCHEDULED
      Schedule: 'cron(0 */3 * * ? *)'
      Actions:
        - JobName: !Ref GlueJobAssetsMetadata

    Type: AWS::Glue::Trigger
    Properties:

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  General-purpose networking foundation. Provisions a VPC with two public and two
  private subnets across two Availability Zones, per-AZ managed NAT gateways, an
  internet gateway, VPC flow logs delivered to CloudWatch Logs, an S3 gateway
  endpoint, and ECR interface endpoints. Public subnets are public by route-table
  association (default route to the internet gateway) but do NOT auto-assign public
  IPv4 addresses on launch; workloads requiring public IPs must set
  AssociatePublicIpAddress explicitly in their launch templates or network
  interfaces. Exports core network identifiers for consumption by downstream stacks.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
    AllowedPattern: '^(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])\.){3}([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]|1[0-9]{2}|2[0-4][0-9]|25[0-5])(/(1[6-9]|2[0-8]))$'
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid IPv4 CIDR block between /16 and /28 (e.g., 10.0.0.0/16).
  FlowLogRetentionInDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 365
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention period (in days) for the VPC flow log log group.
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1096
      - 1827
      - 2192
      - 2557
      - 2922
      - 3288
      - 3653
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of the valid CloudWatch Logs retention values (1, 3, 5, 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 365, 400, 545, 731, 1096, 1827, 2192, 2557, 2922, 3288, or 3653 days).
  FlowLogTrafficType:
    Type: String
    Default: ALL
    Description: Traffic type captured by the VPC flow logs.
    AllowedValues:
      - ALL
      - ACCEPT
      - REJECT
    ConstraintDescription: Must be one of ALL, ACCEPT, or REJECT.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  InternetGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Ref VpcCidr
              - 4
              - 4
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az1'

  PublicSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Ref VpcCidr
              - 4
              - 4
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-az2'

  PrivateSubnetAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 0
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 2
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Ref VpcCidr
              - 4
              - 4
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az1'

  PrivateSubnetAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      AvailabilityZone:
        Fn::Select:
          - 1
          - Fn::GetAZs: !Ref 'AWS::Region'
      CidrBlock:
        Fn::Select:
          - 3
          - Fn::Cidr:
              - !Ref VpcCidr
              - 4
              - 4
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-az2'

  NatElasticIpAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az1'

  NatElasticIpAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-az2'

  NatGatewayAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIpAz1.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az1'

  NatGatewayAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatElasticIpAz2.AllocationId
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-az2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: InternetGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PrivateRouteTableAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az1'

  PrivateRouteAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz1

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1

  PrivateRouteTableAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-az2'

  PrivateRouteAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGatewayAz2

  PrivateSubnetRouteTableAssociationAz2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2

  FlowLogLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref FlowLogRetentionInDays

  FlowLogRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flowlogs-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: delivery.logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                aws:SourceAccount: !Ref 'AWS::AccountId'
              ArnLike:
                aws:SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:*'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
                  - !Sub '${FlowLogLogGroup.Arn}:*'

  FlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: !Ref FlowLogTrafficType
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-flow-log'

  EndpointSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for VPC interface endpoints - allows outbound HTTPS within the VPC only.
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      SecurityGroupEgress:
        - IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 443
          ToPort: 443
          CidrIp: !Ref VpcCidr
          Description: Outbound HTTPS within the VPC CIDR
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-endpoint-sg'

  S3GatewayEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.s3'
      VpcEndpointType: Gateway
      RouteTableIds:
        - !Ref PublicRouteTable
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz1
        - !Ref PrivateRouteTableAz2
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal: '*'
            Action: 's3:*'
            Resource: '*'

  EcrApiEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.api'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

  EcrDkrEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCEndpoint
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      ServiceName: !Sub 'com.amazonaws.${AWS::Region}.ecr.dkr'
      VpcEndpointType: Interface
      PrivateDnsEnabled: true
      SubnetIds:
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz1
        - !Ref PrivateSubnetAz2
      SecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref EndpointSecurityGroup

Outputs:

    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  VpcCidr:
    Description: CIDR block of the VPC.
    Value: !Ref VpcCidr
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcCidr'
  Az1Name:
    Description: First Availability Zone used by this VPC.
