AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Reusable DynamoDB table stack with auto scaling, PITR, optional SSE, AWS Backup, and optional alerting.

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional table name. Defaults to stack name.
    Default: ""
  PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Name of the partition key attribute. Defaults to "id"; override as needed.
    Default: "id"
    AllowedPattern: "^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
    MinLength: 1
  PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Partition key attribute type.
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Description: Optional sort key attribute name.
    Default: ""
    AllowedPattern: "^$|^[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]+$"
  SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Description: Sort key attribute type.
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttribute1Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name 1.
  ExtraAttribute1Type:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttribute2Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name 2.
  ExtraAttribute2Type:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  ExtraAttribute3Name:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional extra attribute definition name 3.
  ExtraAttribute3Type:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSI1PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional GSI 1 partition key attribute name.
  GSI1PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSI1SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional GSI 1 sort key attribute name.
  GSI1SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSI2PartitionKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional GSI 2 partition key attribute name.
  GSI2PartitionKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "S"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  GSI2SortKeyName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional GSI 2 sort key attribute name.
  GSI2SortKeyType:
    Type: String
    Default: "N"
    AllowedValues: ["S", "N", "B"]
  TTLAttributeName:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional TTL attribute name. Enables TTL when provided.
  StreamViewType:
    Type: String
    Default: ""
    Description: Optional stream view type. Empty disables streams.
    AllowedValues: ["", "NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES", "NEW_IMAGES", "OLD_IMAGES", "KEYS_ONLY"]
  BillingMode:
    Type: String
    Default: "PROVISIONED"
    AllowedValues: ["PROVISIONED", "PAY_PER_REQUEST"]
  ReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  WriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 1
    MinValue: 1
  MaxReadCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  MaxWriteCapacityUnits:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 1
  TargetTrackingUtilization:
    Type: Number
    Default: 80
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 100
  PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "true"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
  SSEEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]
  BackupRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    Description: Backup retention in days. Set to 0 to disable backups entirely.
    MinValue: 0
  AlertingEnabled:
    Type: String
    Default: "false"
    AllowedValues: ["true", "false"]

Conditions:
  HasTableName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TableName, ""]]
  HasSortKey: !Not [!Equals [!Ref SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasExtraAttribute1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute1Name, ""]]
  HasExtraAttribute2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute2Name, ""]]
  HasExtraAttribute3: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ExtraAttribute3Name, ""]]
  HasGSI1: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName, ""]]
  HasGSI1Sort: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI1SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasGSI2: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName, ""]]
  HasGSI2Sort: !Not [!Equals [!Ref GSI2SortKeyName, ""]]
  HasTTL: !Not [!Equals [!Ref TTLAttributeName, ""]]
  HasStream: !Not [!Equals [!Ref StreamViewType, ""]]
  IsProvisioned: !Equals [!Ref BillingMode, "PROVISIONED"]
  PITREnabled: !Equals [!Ref PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled, "true"]
  SSEIsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref SSEEnabled, "true"]
  BackupsEnabled: !Not [!Equals [!Ref BackupRetentionDays, 0]]
  AlertsEnabled: !Equals [!Ref AlertingEnabled, "true"]

Resources:
  DynamoDBTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !If
        - HasTableName
        - !Ref TableName
        - !Ref AWS::StackName
      BillingMode: !Ref BillingMode
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          AttributeType: !Ref PartitionKeyType
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute1
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute1Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute2
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute2Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasExtraAttribute3
          - AttributeName: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Name
            AttributeType: !Ref ExtraAttribute3Type
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI1Sort
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI1SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2Sort
          - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
            AttributeType: !Ref GSI2SortKeyType
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: !Ref PartitionKeyName
          KeyType: HASH
        - !If
          - HasSortKey
          - AttributeName: !Ref SortKeyName
            KeyType: RANGE
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      ProvisionedThroughput: !If
        - IsProvisioned
        - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
          WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - !If
          - HasGSI1
          - IndexName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi1"
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI1Sort
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI1SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
        - !If
          - HasGSI2
          - IndexName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-gsi2"
            KeySchema:
              - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2PartitionKeyName
                KeyType: HASH
              - !If
                - HasGSI2Sort
                - AttributeName: !Ref GSI2SortKeyName
                  KeyType: RANGE
                - !Ref AWS::NoValue
            Projection:
              ProjectionType: ALL
            ProvisionedThroughput: !If
              - IsProvisioned
              - ReadCapacityUnits: !Ref ReadCapacityUnits
                WriteCapacityUnits: !Ref WriteCapacityUnits
              - !Ref AWS::NoValue
          - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      TimeToLiveSpecification: !If
        - HasTTL
        - AttributeName: !Ref TTLAttributeName
          Enabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      StreamSpecification: !If
        - HasStream
        - StreamViewType: !Ref StreamViewType
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification: !If
        - PITREnabled
        - PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      SSESpecification: !If
        - SSEIsEnabled
        - SSEEnabled: true
          SSEType: KMS
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-table"

  TableReadScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxReadCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableWriteScalableTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxWriteCapacityUnits
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub "table/${DynamoDBTable}"
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TableReadScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-read-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableReadScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetTrackingUtilization

  TableWriteScalingPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Condition: IsProvisioned
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-write-target-tracking"
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TableWriteScalableTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        TargetValue: !Ref TargetTrackingUtilization

  BackupVault:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupVault
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupVaultName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-vault"
      Notifications: !If
        - AlertsEnabled
        - SNSTopicArn: !Ref AlertTopic
          BackupVaultEvents:
            - BACKUP_JOB_FAILED
            - BACKUP_JOB_SUCCESS
            - BACKUP_JOB_EXPIRED
            - RECOVERY_POINT_MODIFIED
        - !Ref AWS::NoValue

  BackupPlan:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupPlan
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlan:
        BackupPlanName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-plan"
        BackupPlanRule:
          - RuleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-daily"
            TargetBackupVault: !Ref BackupVault
            ScheduleExpression: "cron(0 5 * * ? *)"
            StartWindowMinutes: 60
            CompletionWindowMinutes: 1440
            Lifecycle:
              DeleteAfterDays: !Ref BackupRetentionDays

  BackupSelection:
    Type: AWS::Backup::BackupSelection
    Condition: BackupsEnabled
    Properties:
      BackupPlanId: !Ref BackupPlan
      BackupSelection:
        SelectionName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-selection"
        IamRoleArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:role/aws-service-role/backup.amazonaws.com/AWSServiceRoleForBackup"
        Resources:
          - !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.Arn

  AlertTopicKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub "CMK for ${AWS::StackName} alert SNS topic"
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowBackupPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:GenerateDataKey
              - kms:Decrypt
            Resource: "*"

  AlertTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      TopicName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-alerts"
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref AlertTopicKey

  AlertTopicPolicy:
    Type: AWS::SNS::TopicPolicy
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      Topics:
        - !Ref AlertTopic
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: cloudwatch.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic
          - Sid: AllowBackupPublish
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: backup.amazonaws.com
            Action: sns:Publish
            Resource: !Ref AlertTopic

  ReadThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ReadThrottleEvents"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ReadThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  WriteThrottleAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-WriteThrottleEvents"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: WriteThrottleEvents
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  ThrottledRequestsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-ThrottledRequests"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: ThrottledRequests
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  UserErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-UserErrors"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: UserErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

  SystemErrorsAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Condition: AlertsEnabled
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-SystemErrors"
      Namespace: AWS/DynamoDB
      MetricName: SystemErrors
      Dimensions:
        - Name: TableName
          Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 60
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertTopic

Outputs:
  TableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table.
    Value: !Ref DynamoDBTable
  StreamArn:
    Description: ARN of the DynamoDB table stream (only when streams are enabled).
    Value: !GetAtt DynamoDBTable.StreamArn
    Condition: HasStream

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB tables for account-vending automation tool with stage-suffixed names and autoscaling

Parameters:
  Stage:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedPattern: '^[a-zA-Z0-9-]+$'
    Description: Stage value appended to every table name (pipeline may override; defaults to dev)

Resources:
  talrCbInfo:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-cbInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountCbAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrAccountInfo:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountEmailAddress
          KeyType: HASH
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: gsiRequestId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: requestId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: KEYS_ONLY
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
        - IndexName: gsiAccountId
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: accountId
              KeyType: HASH
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
          ProvisionedThroughput:
            ReadCapacityUnits: 1
            WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrTaskStatus:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: eventTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      StreamSpecification:
        StreamViewType: NEW_AND_OLD_IMAGES
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrNipapCfn:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-nipapCfn-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: nipapAlias
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrOps:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-ops-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: layer
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: layer
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrDxInterface:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-dxInterface-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: vlan
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: divisionDcRegion
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: vlan
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrClaStatus:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-claStatus-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: requestId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  talrConfigRulesCompliance:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub 'talr-configRulesCompliance-${Stage}'
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 1
        WriteCapacityUnits: 1
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: accountId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: pollTimestamp
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  DynamoDBAutoscalingRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAutoscalingPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:DescribeTable
                  - dynamodb:UpdateTable
                Resource: !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/talr-*-${Stage}'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cloudwatch:PutMetricAlarm
                  - cloudwatch:DescribeAlarms
                  - cloudwatch:GetMetricData
                  - cloudwatch:SetAlarmState
                  - cloudwatch:DeleteAlarms
                Resource: '*'

  AccountInfoTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiRequestIdWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiRequestId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiAccountIdReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiAccountId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  GsiAccountIdWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrAccountInfo
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-accountInfo-${Stage}/index/gsiAccountId'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:index:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TaskStatusTableReadTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrTaskStatus
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:ReadCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  TaskStatusTableWriteTarget:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalableTarget
    DependsOn: talrTaskStatus
    Properties:
      MaxCapacity: 10
      MinCapacity: 1
      ResourceId: !Sub 'table/talr-taskStatus-${Stage}'
      RoleARN: !GetAtt DynamoDBAutoscalingRole.Arn
      ScalableDimension: dynamodb:table:WriteCapacityUnits
      ServiceNamespace: dynamodb

  AccountInfoTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-read-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  AccountInfoTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-write-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref AccountInfoTableWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiRequestIdReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-gsiRequestId-read-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiRequestIdReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiRequestIdWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-gsiRequestId-write-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiRequestIdWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiAccountIdReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-gsiAccountId-read-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiAccountIdReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  GsiAccountIdWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-accountInfo-gsiAccountId-write-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref GsiAccountIdWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  TaskStatusTableReadPolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-read-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableReadTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBReadCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

  TaskStatusTableWritePolicy:
    Type: AWS::ApplicationAutoScaling::ScalingPolicy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub 'talr-taskStatus-write-${Stage}'
      PolicyType: TargetTrackingScaling
      ScalingTargetId: !Ref TaskStatusTableWriteTarget
      TargetTrackingScalingPolicyConfiguration:
        PredefinedMetricSpecification:
          PredefinedMetricType: DynamoDBWriteCapacityUtilization
        ScaleInCooldown: 60
        ScaleOutCooldown: 60
        TargetValue: 50

Outputs:
  CbInfoTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrCbInfo
  AccountInfoTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrAccountInfo
  TaskStatusTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrTaskStatus
  NipapCfnTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrNipapCfn
  OpsTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrOps
  DxInterfaceTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrDxInterface
  ClaStatusTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrClaStatus
  ConfigRulesComplianceTableName:
    Value: !Ref talrConfigRulesCompliance

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: >
  Highly available network foundation for a containerised Streamlit application:
  VPC with public/private subnets across two AZs, IGW, per-AZ NAT gateways,
  VPC flow logs to CloudWatch Logs, and an ECS cluster with Container Insights.

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: streamlit-dev
    Description: Environment name used for resource tagging.
  ApplicationName:
    Type: String
    Default: streamlit-app
    Description: Application name used for resource tagging.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^10\.0\.0\.0/24$
    Description: CIDR block for the first public subnet.
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^10\.0\.1\.0/24$
    Description: CIDR block for the second public subnet.
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^10\.0\.2\.0/24$
    Description: CIDR block for the first private subnet.
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.3.0/24
    AllowedPattern: ^10\.0\.3\.0/24$
    Description: CIDR block for the second private subnet.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 10.0.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-vpc"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-igw"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs ""]
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-subnet-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-public-rt"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PublicDefaultRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-eip-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-nat-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-1"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-private-rt-2"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

  FlowLogsLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/vpc/${EnvironmentName}-flow-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 7
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

  FlowLogsRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: vpc-flow-logs.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: vpc-flow-logs-delivery
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPCFlowLog:
    Type: AWS::EC2::FlowLog
    Properties:
      ResourceId: !Ref VPC
      ResourceType: VPC
      TrafficType: ALL
      LogDestinationType: cloud-watch-logs
      LogDestination: !GetAtt FlowLogsLogGroup.Arn
      DeliverLogsPermissionArn: !GetAtt FlowLogsRole.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-flow-log"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  ECSCluster:
    Type: AWS::ECS::Cluster
    Properties:
      ClusterName: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-cluster"
      ClusterSettings:
        - Name: containerInsights
          Value: enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
        - Key: Application
          Value: !Ref ApplicationName

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
  ECSClusterName:
    Description: ECS Cluster name
    Value: !Ref ECSCluster
  FlowLogsLogGroupName:
    Description: VPC flow logs log group name
    Value: !Ref FlowLogsLogGroup

Description: Test environment for Service Catalog preventive controls validation - VPC, KMS, DMS, ElastiCache, SageMaker and launch roles.

    Type: String
    Default: test
    Description: Environment tag value.
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: sc-controls-test
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and tags.

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: 172.16.0.0/16
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-vpc'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  Subnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.1.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-1'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  Subnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: 172.16.2.0/24
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      MapPublicIpOnLaunch: false
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-subnet-2'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  TestSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Service Catalog test resources
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${ProjectName}-test-sg'
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for Service Catalog test resources
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root'
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowLaunchRoleUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS:
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleALB.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleASG.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDMS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleDynamoDB.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEBS.Arn
                - !GetAtt LaunchRoleEFS.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Serverless AI campaign orchestration platform (parse, segment, predict, safety check, adapt, deliver, record) with HTTP API, Cognito auth, optional OpenSearch Serverless semantic search, KMS encryption, and monitoring.'

Parameters:
  BedrockModelId:
    Type: String
    Default: anthropic.claude-3-haiku-20240307-v1:0
    Description: 'Bedrock model identifier used by generative Lambda steps.'
  NotificationEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: noreply@example.com
    Description: 'Email address for SNS operational alerts (placeholder safe default).'
  MessagingPhoneNumberId:
    Type: String
    Default: placeholder-phone-number-id
    Description: 'Messaging provider phone number identifier (placeholder safe default).'
  EnableSemanticSearch:
    Type: String
    Default: 'false'
    AllowedValues: ['true', 'false']
    Description: 'Enable OpenSearch Serverless vector semantic search.'
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues: [7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180, 365]

Conditions:
  SemanticSearchEnabled: !Equals [!Ref EnableSemanticSearch, 'true']

Resources:
  KmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: 'Customer managed key for campaign platform data stores'
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAM
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowUseViaService
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: dynamodb.amazonaws.com
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowS3Use
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: s3.amazonaws.com
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowOpenSearch
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: opensearchservice.amazonaws.com
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey, kms:DescribeKey]
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowSnsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: sns.amazonaws.com
            Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
            Resource: '*'

  KmsKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/campaign-orchestrator-${AWS::AccountId}
      TargetKeyId: !Ref KmsKey

  CustomerProfilesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: customerId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEType: KMS

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: channel
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: windowId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: channel
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: windowId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEType: KMS

  DeliveryTrackingTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: campaignId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: messageId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: campaignId
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        KMSMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
        SSEType: KMS

  CampaignAssetsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !Ref KmsKey
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true

  CampaignAssetsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: DenyInsecureTransport
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: '*'
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: 'false'

  AlertsTopic:
    Type: AWS::SNS::Topic
    Properties:
      KmsMasterKeyId: !Ref KmsKey
      Subscription:
        - Endpoint: !Ref NotificationEmail
          Protocol: email

  StateMachineLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays

  ExecutionsFailedAlarm:
    Type: AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
    Properties:
      AlarmName: !Sub campaign-orchestrator-executions-failed-${AWS::AccountId}
      AlarmDescription: 'Fires when campaign state machine executions fail'
      Namespace: AWS/States
      MetricName: ExecutionsFailed
      Dimensions:
        - Name: StateMachineArn
          Value: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Statistic: Sum
      Period: 300
      EvaluationPeriods: 1
      Threshold: 1
      ComparisonOperator: GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold
      TreatMissingData: notBreaching
      AlarmActions:
        - !Ref AlertsTopic
      OKActions:
        - !Ref AlertsTopic

  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub campaign-orchestrator-users-${AWS::AccountId}
      AutoVerifiedAttributes: [email]
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: campaign-api-client
      GenerateSecret: false
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      PreventUserExistenceErrors: ENABLED
      AccessTokenValidity: 1
      IdTokenValidity: 1
      TokenValidityUnits:
        AccessToken: hours
        IdToken: hours

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: campaign-orchestrator-api
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowMethods: [POST, GET, OPTIONS]
        AllowHeaders: [authorization, content-type]
        AllowOrigins: ['*']

  HttpApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: '$default'
      AutoDeploy: true

  HttpApiAuthorizer:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Authorizer
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      Name: cognito-jwt-authorizer
      AuthorizerType: JWT
      IdentitySource: ['$request.header.Authorization']
      JwtConfiguration:
        Audience:
          - !Ref UserPoolClient
        Issuer: !Sub https://cognito-idp.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/${UserPool}

  PipelineLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: pipeline-data-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:PutItem, dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan]
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt CustomerProfilesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RateLimitsTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject]
                Resource: !Sub ${CampaignAssetsBucket.Arn}/*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}

  ParseInstructionFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-parse-instruction-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      MemorySize: 256
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3, uuid
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              instruction = event.get('instruction', '')
              model_id = os.environ['BedrockModelId']
              body = json.dumps({
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 1024,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"Extract a structured campaign plan (objective, audience, channels, timing) as JSON from this instruction: {instruction}"}]
              })
              resp = bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=body)
              plan = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
              return {"campaignId": str(uuid.uuid4()), "instruction": instruction, "plan": plan}

  SegmentCustomersFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-segment-customers-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['PROFILES_TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              plan = event.get('plan', {})
              resp = table.scan(Limit=100)
              return {"campaignId": event.get('campaignId'), "plan": plan, "segments": resp.get('Items', [])}

  PredictChannelFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-predict-channel-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              model_id = os.environ['BedrockModelId']
              customers = event.get('segments', [])
              body = json.dumps({
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 1024,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"For each customer, predict the best channel (email, sms, push). Customers: {json.dumps(customers)}. Return JSON array of {{customerId, channel}}."}]
              })
              resp = bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=body)
              predictions = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
              return {"campaignId": event.get('campaignId'), "plan": event.get('plan'), "predictions": predictions}

  SafetyCheckFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-safety-check-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              model_id = os.environ['BedrockModelId']
              body = json.dumps({
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 1024,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"Review this campaign plan and predictions for safety/compliance issues. Return JSON with approved true/false and reasons. Plan: {json.dumps(event.get('plan'))} Predictions: {json.dumps(event.get('predictions'))}"}]
              })
              resp = bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=body)
              safety = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
              return {"campaignId": event.get('campaignId'), "safety": safety, "predictions": event.get('predictions')}

  AdaptContentFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-adapt-content-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              model_id = os.environ['BedrockModelId']
              body = json.dumps({
                  "anthropic_version": "bedrock-2023-05-31",
                  "max_tokens": 2048,
                  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": f"Adapt this campaign content per channel. Predictions: {json.dumps(event.get('predictions'))}. Return JSON keyed by channel."}]
              })
              resp = bedrock.invoke_model(modelId=model_id, body=body)
              content = json.loads(resp['body'].read())
              s3.put_object(Bucket=os.environ['ASSETS_BUCKET'],
                            Key=f"campaigns/{event.get('campaignId')}/content.json",
                            Body=json.dumps(content).encode())
              return {"campaignId": event.get('campaignId'), "content": content}

  DeliverMessagesFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-deliver-messages-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 120
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json, uuid
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['DELIVERY_TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              phone_id = os.environ['MessagingPhoneNumberId']
              content = event.get('content', {})
              results = []
              for channel, body in content.items():
                  msg_id = str(uuid.uuid4())
                  table.put_item(Item={"messageId": msg_id, "campaignId": event.get('campaignId'),
                                       "channel": channel, "status": "SENT", "senderId": phone_id})
                  results.append({"messageId": msg_id, "channel": channel})
              return {"campaignId": event.get('campaignId'), "deliveries": results}

  RecordResultsFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-record-results-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt PipelineLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          MessagingPhoneNumberId: !Ref MessagingPhoneNumberId
          PROFILES_TABLE: !Ref CustomerProfilesTable
          RATE_LIMITS_TABLE: !Ref RateLimitsTable
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
          ASSETS_BUCKET: !Ref CampaignAssetsBucket
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import os, boto3, json
          s3 = boto3.client('s3')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              s3.put_object(Bucket=os.environ['ASSETS_BUCKET'],
                            Key=f"campaigns/{event.get('campaignId')}/results.json",
                            Body=json.dumps(event).encode())
              return {"status": "COMPLETED", "campaignId": event.get('campaignId')}

  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: invoke-pipeline-lambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
                  - !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
        - PolicyName: write-logs
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogDelivery
                  - logs:GetLogDelivery
                  - logs:UpdateLogDelivery
                  - logs:DeleteLogDelivery
                  - logs:ListLogDeliveries
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:DescribeLogGroups, logs:DescribeLogStreams]
                Resource: !GetAtt StateMachineLogGroup.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [logs:CreateLogStream, logs:PutLogEvents]
                Resource: !Sub ${StateMachineLogGroup.Arn}:*

  CampaignStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      Definition:
        Comment: 'Campaign orchestration pipeline'
        StartAt: ParseInstruction
        States:
          ParseInstruction:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt ParseInstructionFunction.Arn
            Retry:
              - ErrorEquals: [Lambda.ServiceException, Lambda.TooManyRequestsException]
                IntervalSeconds: 2
                MaxAttempts: 3
                BackoffRate: 2
            Next: SegmentCustomers
          SegmentCustomers:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt SegmentCustomersFunction.Arn
            Next: PredictChannel
          PredictChannel:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt PredictChannelFunction.Arn
            Next: SafetyCheck
          SafetyCheck:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt SafetyCheckFunction.Arn
            Next: AdaptContent
          AdaptContent:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt AdaptContentFunction.Arn
            Next: DeliverMessages
          DeliverMessages:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt DeliverMessagesFunction.Arn
            Next: RecordResults
          RecordResults:
            Type: Task
            Resource: !GetAtt RecordResultsFunction.Arn
            End: true

  ApiLambdaRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: api-lambda-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:StartExecution
                Resource: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: states:DescribeExecution
                Resource: !Sub ${CampaignStateMachine.Arn}:*
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:GetItem, dynamodb:Query, dynamodb:Scan]
                Resource: !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt]
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  CampaignLauncherFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-launcher-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt ApiLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !Ref CampaignStateMachine
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          sfn = boto3.client('stepfunctions')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              instruction = body.get('instruction', '')
              resp = sfn.start_execution(stateMachineArn=os.environ['STATE_MACHINE_ARN'],
                                         input=json.dumps({"instruction": instruction}))
              return {"statusCode": 202, "body": json.dumps({"executionArn": resp['executionArn']})}

  CampaignStatusFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-status-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt ApiLambdaRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['DELIVERY_TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              campaign_id = (event.get('queryStringParameters') or {}).get('campaignId', '')
              if campaign_id:
                  resp = table.scan(FilterExpression=boto3.dynamodb.conditions.Attr('campaignId').eq(campaign_id))
              else:
                  resp = table.scan()
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"campaignId": campaign_id, "deliveries": resp.get('Items', [])})}

  LauncherIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CampaignLauncherFunction.Arn}/invocations
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  StatusIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub arn:aws:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CampaignStatusFunction.Arn}/invocations
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  LaunchRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:

      RouteKey: POST /campaigns
      Target: !Sub integrations/${LauncherIntegration}
      AuthorizerId: !Ref HttpApiAuthorizer
      AuthorizationType: JWT

  StatusRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: GET /campaigns/status
      Target: !Sub integrations/${StatusIntegration}
      AuthorizerId: !Ref HttpApiAuthorizer
      AuthorizationType: JWT

  LauncherInvokePermission:

    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CampaignLauncherFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*/campaigns

  StatusInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CampaignStatusFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub arn:aws:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*/campaigns/status

  DeliveryCallbackRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: delivery-callback-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [dynamodb:UpdateItem, dynamodb:GetItem]
                Resource: !GetAtt DeliveryTrackingTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  DeliveryCallbackFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-delivery-callback-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt DeliveryCallbackRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          DELIVERY_TABLE: !Ref DeliveryTrackingTable
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          table = boto3.resource('dynamodb').Table(os.environ['DELIVERY_TABLE'])
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              body = json.loads(event.get('body') or '{}')
              msg_id = body.get('messageId')
              campaign_id = body.get('campaignId')
              status = body.get('status', 'UNKNOWN')
              if msg_id and campaign_id:
                  table.update_item(Key={"messageId": msg_id, "campaignId": campaign_id},
                                    UpdateExpression="SET #s = :s",
                                    ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"},
                                    ExpressionAttributeValues={":s": status})
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"received": True})}

  SemanticSearchRole:

              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [aoss:APIAccessAll]
                Resource: !GetAtt SemanticSearchCollection.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: bedrock:InvokeModel
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:bedrock:${AWS::Region}::foundation-model/${BedrockModelId}
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: [kms:Decrypt, kms:GenerateDataKey]
                Resource: !GetAtt KmsKey.Arn

  SemanticSearchCollection:

    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:

  SemanticSearchEncryptionPolicy:

    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: campaign-vectors-encryption
      Type: encryption
      Policy: !Sub
        - '{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${Collection}"]}],"AWSOwnedKey":false,"KmsARN":"${KmsArn}"}'

  SemanticSearchNetworkPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::SecurityPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: campaign-vectors-network
      Type: network
      Policy: !Sub
        - '{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${Collection}"]}],"AllowFromPublic":false,"SourceVPCEs":[]}'
        - Collection: !Ref SemanticSearchCollection

  SemanticSearchDataPolicy:
    Type: AWS::OpenSearchServerless::AccessPolicy
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      Name: campaign-vectors-data-access
      Type: data
      Policy: !Sub
        - '{"Rules":[{"ResourceType":"collection","Resource":["collection/${Collection}"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateCollectionItems","aoss:DescribeCollectionItems","aoss:UpdateCollectionItems"]},{"ResourceType":"index","Resource":["index/${Collection}/*"],"Permission":["aoss:CreateIndex","aoss:UpdateIndex","aoss:DescribeIndex","aoss:ReadDocument","aoss:WriteDocument"]}],"Principal":["${RoleArn}"]}'
        - Collection: !Ref SemanticSearchCollection
          RoleArn: !GetAtt SemanticSearchRole.Arn

  SemanticSearchFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Condition: SemanticSearchEnabled
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub campaign-semantic-search-${AWS::AccountId}
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.lambda_handler
      Timeout: 60
      Role: !GetAtt SemanticSearchRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          BedrockModelId: !Ref BedrockModelId
          COLLECTION_ENDPOINT: !GetAtt SemanticSearchCollection.CollectionEndpoint
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json, os, boto3
          bedrock = boto3.client('bedrock-runtime')
          def lambda_handler(event, context):
              query = event.get('query', '')
              model_id = os.environ['BedrockModelId']
              body = json.dumps({"inputText": query})
