AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless URL shortener with DynamoDB, Lambda, and API Gateway (regional REST API)

Parameters:
  TableName:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener-table
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table storing short IDs and long URLs.
  FunctionNamePrefix:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Prefix used for the Lambda function names.
  PythonRuntime:
    Type: String
    Default: python3.12
    AllowedValues:
      - python3.9
      - python3.10
      - python3.11
      - python3.12
    Description: Python runtime for the Lambda functions.
  AppUrl:
    Type: String
    Default: https://example.com
    Description: Base application URL used to build the shortened links.
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    Description: Environment tag value.
  Service:
    Type: String
    Default: url-shortener
    Description: Service tag value.
  Owner:
    Type: String
    Default: platform-team
    Description: Owner tag value.

Resources:
  UrlShortenerTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Ref TableName
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: short_id
          KeyType: HASH
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-lambda-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole'
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDBAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                Resource: !GetAtt UrlShortenerTable.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-create'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
          APP_URL: !Ref AppUrl
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import random
          import string
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])
          APP_URL = os.environ["APP_URL"].rstrip("/")

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              except json.JSONDecodeError:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "Invalid JSON body"})

              long_url = body.get("long_url")
              if not long_url or not isinstance(long_url, str):
                  return _response(400, {"error": "long_url is required"})

              length = random.randint(12, 16)
              short_id = "".join(
                  random.SystemRandom().choice(string.ascii_letters + string.digits)
                  for _ in range(length)
              )

              table.put_item(Item={"short_id": short_id, "long_url": long_url})

              return _response(201, {"short_id": short_id, "short_url": f"{APP_URL}/{short_id}"})

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(payload),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RetrieveFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-retrieve'
      Runtime: !Ref PythonRuntime
      Handler: index.handler
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Timeout: 10
      Environment:
        Variables:
          TABLE_NAME: !Ref TableName
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          table = boto3.resource("dynamodb").Table(os.environ["TABLE_NAME"])

          def handler(event, context):
              short_id = (event.get("pathParameters") or {}).get("short_id")
              if not short_id:
                  return _response(400, {"error": "short_id path parameter is required"})

              result = table.get_item(Key={"short_id": short_id})
              item = result.get("Item")
              if not item or "long_url" not in item:
                  return _response(404, {"error": "Short link not found"})

              return {
                  "statusCode": 302,
                  "headers": {
                      "Location": item["long_url"],
                      "Content-Type": "text/plain",
                  },
                  "body": "Redirecting",
              }

          def _response(status, payload):
              return {
                  "statusCode": status,
                  "headers": {"Content-Type": "application/json"},
                  "body": json.dumps(payload),
              }
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  RestApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-api'
      EndpointConfiguration:
        Types:
          - REGIONAL
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  CreateResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: links

  AdminResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: admin

  ShortLinkResource:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ParentId: !GetAtt RestApi.RootResourceId
      PathPart: '{short_id}'

  CreateMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref CreateResource
      HttpMethod: POST
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${CreateFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  ShortLinkGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref ShortLinkResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      RequestParameters:
        method.request.path.short_id: true
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  AdminGetMethod:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Method
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      ResourceId: !Ref AdminResource
      HttpMethod: GET
      AuthorizationType: NONE
      Integration:
        Type: AWS_PROXY
        IntegrationHttpMethod: POST
        Uri: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${RetrieveFunction.Arn}/invocations'

  CreateFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref CreateFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

  RetrieveFunctionPermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref RetrieveFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub 'arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${RestApi}/*/*'

  ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${FunctionNamePrefix}-apigw-cw-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: apigateway.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: ApiGatewayLogsPolicy
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - logs:DescribeLogGroups
                  - logs:DescribeLogStreams
                Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiGatewayAccount:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Account
    Properties:
      CloudWatchRoleArn: !GetAtt ApiGatewayCloudWatchRole.Arn

  ApiDeployment:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Deployment
    DependsOn:
      - CreateMethod
      - ShortLinkGetMethod
      - AdminGetMethod
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi

  TestStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Stage
    DependsOn: ApiGatewayAccount
    Properties:
      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
      DeploymentId: !Ref ApiDeployment
      StageName: test
      TracingEnabled: true
      AccessLogSetting:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","path":"$context.path","status":"$context.status","responseLength":"$context.responseLength"}'
      MethodSettings:
        - ResourcePath: '/*'
          HttpMethod: '*'
          LoggingLevel: INFO
          DataTraceEnabled: false
          MetricsEnabled: true
          ThrottlingBurstLimit: 100
          ThrottlingRateLimit: 50
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub '/apigateway/${FunctionNamePrefix}-api/test-access-logs'
      RetentionInDays: 30
      Tags:
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment
        - Key: Service
          Value: !Ref Service
        - Key: Owner
          Value: !Ref Owner

Outputs:
  ApiEndpointUrl:
    Description: Base URL of the test stage for the URL shortener API.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test'
  CreateLinkEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint to create a shortened link (POST).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test/links'
  ShortLinkEndpoint:
    Description: Endpoint to retrieve a shortened link (GET with short_id path parameter).
    Value: !Sub 'https://${RestApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com/test/{short_id}'
  DynamoDBTableName:
    Description: Name of the DynamoDB table backing the URL shortener.
    Value: !Ref UrlShortenerTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Serverless on-call incident alerting service (DynamoDB, Lambda, Step Functions, HTTP API, SSM discovery)

Parameters:
  AppName:
    Type: String
    Default: oncall-alerting
    Description: Application name used for resource naming and SSM parameter path.
  SenderEmailAddress:
    Type: String
    Default: no-reply@example.com
    Description: Verified SES sender email address used for notifications. Override this placeholder with a SES-verified address at deployment time.
    AllowedPattern: "^[^@\\s]+@[^@\\s]+\\.[^@\\s]+$"
    ConstraintDescription: Must be a valid email address.

Resources:
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # DynamoDB tables
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ConfigurationTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AppName}-configuration"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ConfigurationKey
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ConfigurationKey
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  ServicesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AppName}-services"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ServiceId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  OnCallSchedulesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AppName}-oncall-schedules"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: TeamId
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: Day
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: TeamId
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: Day
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  IncidentsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub "${AppName}-incidents"
      BillingMode: PROVISIONED
      ProvisionedThroughput:
        ReadCapacityUnits: 5
        WriteCapacityUnits: 5
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: IncidentId
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: IncidentId
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Shared Lambda execution role
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  LambdaExecutionRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-lambda-execution-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole"
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: DynamoDbAccess
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigurationTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt ServicesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt OnCallSchedulesTable.Arn
                  - !GetAtt IncidentsTable.Arn
        - PolicyName: SesSend
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: ses:SendEmail
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ses:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:identity/${SenderEmailAddress}"
        - PolicyName: SsmRead
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - ssm:GetParameter
                  - ssm:GetParameters
                Resource: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter/${AppName}/*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Standalone policy: processor may start state machine executions
  # (attached externally to avoid a circular dependency between the
  # shared execution role and the state machine resource)
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ProcessorStartExecutionPolicy:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Policy
    Properties:
      PolicyName: !Sub "${AppName}-processor-start-execution"
      Roles:
        - !Ref LambdaExecutionRole
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Action: states:StartExecution
            Resource: !GetAtt IncidentStateMachine.Arn

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Lambda functions
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  IncidentProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AppName}-incident-processor"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 256
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          INCIDENTS_TABLE: !Ref IncidentsTable
          SERVICES_TABLE: !Ref ServicesTable
          ONCALL_SCHEDULES_TABLE: !Ref OnCallSchedulesTable
          CONFIGURATION_TABLE: !Ref ConfigurationTable
          STATE_MACHINE_ARN: !GetAtt IncidentStateMachine.Arn
          SSM_PARAMETER_PATH: !Sub "/${AppName}"
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          incidents_table = os.environ["INCIDENTS_TABLE"]
          state_machine_arn = os.environ["STATE_MACHINE_ARN"]

          dynamodb = boto3.resource("dynamodb")
          sfn = boto3.client("stepfunctions")
          table = dynamodb.Table(incidents_table)

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder implementation - real code deployed separately.
              method = event.get("requestContext", {}).get("http", {}).get("method")
              incident_id = event.get("pathParameters", {}).get("incidentId")

              if method == "GET":
                  response = table.get_item(Key={"IncidentId": incident_id})
                  item = response.get("Item")
                  if not item:
                      return {"statusCode": 404, "body": json.dumps({"error": "not found"})}
                  return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(item, default=str)}

              body = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}")
              body["IncidentId"] = incident_id
              table.put_item(Item=body)
              sfn.start_execution(
                  stateMachineArn=state_machine_arn,
                  name=f"incident-{incident_id}",
                  input=json.dumps(body)
              )
              return {"statusCode": 201, "body": json.dumps({"incidentId": incident_id})}

  NotifierFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Sub "${AppName}-notifier"
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 30
      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
      Environment:
        Variables:
          SENDER_EMAIL: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
          SSM_PARAMETER_PATH: !Sub "/${AppName}"
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import json
          import os
          import boto3

          sender = os.environ["SENDER_EMAIL"]
          ses = boto3.client("ses")

          def handler(event, context):
              # Placeholder implementation - real code deployed separately.
              detail = json.loads(event.get("body") or "{}") if isinstance(event.get("body"), str) else event
              recipient = detail.get("recipient", "placeholder@example.com")
              subject = detail.get("subject", "Incident Notification")
              body_text = detail.get("body", "An incident has been raised.")
              ses.send_email(
                  Source=sender,
                  Destination={"ToAddresses": [recipient]},
                  Message={
                      "Subject": {"Data": subject},
                      "Body": {"Text": {"Data": body_text}}
                  }
              )
              return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps({"sent": True})}

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Step Functions state machine
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  StateMachineRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AppName}-sfn-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: states.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: InvokeLambdas
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt NotifierFunction.Arn
                  - !Sub "${NotifierFunction.Arn}:*"

  IncidentStateMachine:
    Type: AWS::StepFunctions::StateMachine
    Properties:
      StateMachineName: !Sub "${AppName}-incident-state-machine"
      RoleArn: !GetAtt StateMachineRole.Arn
      DefinitionString: !Sub
        - |
          {
            "Comment": "Notify on-call responder immediately and escalate after 5 minutes",
            "StartAt": "Dispatch",
            "States": {
              "Dispatch": {
                "Type": "Pass",
                "Parameters": {
                  "recipient.$": "$.recipient",
                  "subject.$": "$.subject",
                  "body.$": "$.body"
                },
                "Next": "NotifyAndEscalate"
              },
              "NotifyAndEscalate": {
                "Type": "Parallel",
                "Branches": [
                  {
                    "StartAt": "NotifyOnCall",
                    "States": {
                      "NotifyOnCall": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke",
                        "Parameters": {
                          "FunctionName": "${NotifierFunction}",
                          "Payload": {
                            "recipient.$": "$.recipient",
                            "subject.$": "$.subject",
                            "body.$": "$.body"
                          }
                        },
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": [
                              "States.TaskFailed",
                              "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException",
                              "Lambda.ServiceException"
                            ],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2.0
                          }
                        ],
                        "End": true
                      }
                    }
                  },
                  {
                    "StartAt": "WaitFiveMinutes",
                    "States": {
                      "WaitFiveMinutes": {
                        "Type": "Wait",
                        "Seconds": 300,
                        "Next": "SendEscalation"
                      },
                      "SendEscalation": {
                        "Type": "Task",
                        "Resource": "arn:${AWS::Partition}:states:::lambda:invoke",
                        "Parameters": {
                          "FunctionName": "${NotifierFunction}",
                          "Payload": {
                            "recipient.$": "$.recipient",
                            "subject.$": "$.subject",
                            "body.$": "$.body"
                          }
                        },
                        "Retry": [
                          {
                            "ErrorEquals": [
                              "States.TaskFailed",
                              "Lambda.TooManyRequestsException",
                              "Lambda.ServiceException"
                            ],
                            "IntervalSeconds": 2,
                            "MaxAttempts": 3,
                            "BackoffRate": 2.0
                          }
                        ],
                        "End": true
                      }
                    }
                  }
                ],
                "End": true
              }
            }
          }
        - {}

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # HTTP API
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  ApiAccessLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: !Sub "/aws/apigateway/${AppName}-access-logs"
      RetentionInDays: 7

  HttpApi:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Api
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AppName}-api"
      ProtocolType: HTTP
      CorsConfiguration:
        AllowMethods:
          - GET
          - PUT
        AllowOrigins:
          - "*"
        AllowHeaders:
          - content-type

  GetIncidentIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  GetIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: "GET /incidents/{incidentId}"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${GetIncidentIntegration}"

  PutIncidentIntegration:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Integration
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      IntegrationType: AWS_PROXY
      IntegrationUri: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:apigateway:${AWS::Region}:lambda:path/2015-03-31/functions/${IncidentProcessorFunction.Arn}/invocations"
      PayloadFormatVersion: '2.0'

  PutIncidentRoute:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Route
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      RouteKey: "PUT /incidents/{incidentId}"
      Target: !Sub "integrations/${PutIncidentIntegration}"

  ApiStage:
    Type: AWS::ApiGatewayV2::Stage
    Properties:
      ApiId: !Ref HttpApi
      StageName: "$default"
      AutoDeploy: true
      AccessLogSettings:
        DestinationArn: !GetAtt ApiAccessLogGroup.Arn
        Format: '{"requestId":"$context.requestId","ip":"$context.identity.sourceIp","requestTime":"$context.requestTime","httpMethod":"$context.httpMethod","routeKey":"$context.routeKey","status":"$context.status","protocol":"$context.protocol","responseLength":"$context.responseLength","integrationError":"$context.integration.error"}'

  ApiInvokePermission:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
    Properties:
      FunctionName: !Ref IncidentProcessorFunction
      Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
      Principal: apigateway.amazonaws.com
      SourceArn: !Sub "arn:${AWS::Partition}:execute-api:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:${HttpApi}/*/*"

  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  # SSM parameters for runtime discovery
  # ------------------------------------------------------------------
  SenderEmailParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/sender-email"
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref SenderEmailAddress
      Description: SES sender email address for incident notifications.

  StateMachineArnParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/state-machine-arn"
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt IncidentStateMachine.Arn
      Description: ARN of the incident alerting Step Functions state machine.

  ApiEndpointParameter:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "/${AppName}/api-endpoint"
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub "https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/"
      Description: HTTP API endpoint for the incident alerting service.

Outputs:
  ApiEndpoint:
    Description: HTTP API endpoint
    Value: !Sub "https://${HttpApi}.execute-api.${AWS::Region}.${AWS::URLSuffix}/"
  StateMachineArn:
    Description: Incident state machine ARN
    Value: !GetAtt IncidentStateMachine.Arn
  SsmParameterPaths:
    Description: SSM parameter paths for runtime discovery
    Value: !Sub "/${AppName}/sender-email, /${AppName}/state-machine-arn, /${AppName}/api-endpoint"

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"

Description: >
  Operational best practices conformance pack for Amazon CloudWatch, composed of
  five AWS managed Config rules. Rule inputs are exposed as parameters and are
  only passed through to each rule when the parameter value is non-empty.
  This template creates AWS Config recording infrastructure (IAM role, KMS key,
  S3 bucket, configuration recorder, delivery channel), a Config pre-cleanup
  custom resource that removes stale recorders/channels, and a bucket-emptying
  custom resource; deployment tooling must acknowledge CAPABILITY_IAM and
  CAPABILITY_NAMED_IAM.

Parameters:
  AlarmActionsRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether the alarm must have an ALARM action configured. Leave empty to omit.
  InsufficientDataActionsRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "TRUE"
    Description: Whether the alarm must have an INSUFFICIENT_DATA action configured. Leave empty to omit.
  OkActionsRequired:
    Type: String
    Default: "FALSE"
    Description: Whether the alarm must have an OK action configured. Leave empty to omit.
  MetricName:
    Type: String
    Default: "CPUUtilization"
    Description: Metric name the alarm must monitor. Leave empty to omit.
  ResourceType:
    Type: String
    Default: "AWS::EC2::Instance"
    Description: Resource type the alarm must cover. Leave empty to omit.
  Namespace:
    Type: String
    Default: "AWS/EC2"
    Description: Namespace of the metric. Leave empty to omit.
  Period:
    Type: String
    Default: "300"
    Description: Metric period in seconds. Leave empty to omit.
  EvaluationPeriods:
    Type: String
    Default: "3"
    Description: Number of evaluation periods. Leave empty to omit.
  Threshold:
    Type: String
    Default: "90"
    Description: Alarm threshold value. Leave empty to omit.
  ComparisonOperator:
    Type: String
    Default: "GreaterThanThreshold"
    Description: Comparison operator for the alarm. Leave empty to omit.

Conditions:
  HasAlarmActionsRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref AlarmActionsRequired, ""]]
  HasInsufficientDataActionsRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref InsufficientDataActionsRequired, ""]]
  HasOkActionsRequired: !Not [!Equals [!Ref OkActionsRequired, ""]]
  HasMetricName: !Not [!Equals [!Ref MetricName, ""]]
  HasResourceType: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ResourceType, ""]]
  HasNamespace: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Namespace, ""]]
  HasPeriod: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Period, ""]]
  HasEvaluationPeriods: !Not [!Equals [!Ref EvaluationPeriods, ""]]
  HasThreshold: !Not [!Equals [!Ref Threshold, ""]]
  HasComparisonOperator: !Not [!Equals [!Ref ComparisonOperator, ""]]
  HasAlarmActionInputs: !Or
    - !Condition HasAlarmActionsRequired
    - !Condition HasInsufficientDataActionsRequired
    - !Condition HasOkActionsRequired
  HasAlarmResourceInputs: !Or
    - !Condition HasMetricName
    - !Condition HasResourceType
  HasAlarmSettingsInputs: !Or
    - !Condition HasNamespace
    - !Condition HasMetricName
    - !Condition HasPeriod
    - !Condition HasEvaluationPeriods
    - !Condition HasThreshold
    - !Condition HasComparisonOperator
  HasAnyBeforeOkActions: !Or
    - !Condition HasAlarmActionsRequired
    - !Condition HasInsufficientDataActionsRequired
  HasAnyBeforeResourceType: !Condition HasMetricName
  HasAnyBeforePeriod: !Or
    - !Condition HasNamespace
    - !Condition HasMetricName
  HasAnyBeforeEvaluationPeriods: !Or
    - !Condition HasNamespace
    - !Condition HasMetricName
    - !Condition HasPeriod
  HasAnyBeforeThreshold: !Or
    - !Condition HasNamespace
    - !Condition HasMetricName
    - !Condition HasPeriod
    - !Condition HasEvaluationPeriods
  HasAnyBeforeComparisonOperator: !Or
    - !Condition HasNamespace
    - !Condition HasMetricName
    - !Condition HasPeriod
    - !Condition HasEvaluationPeriods
    - !Condition HasThreshold

Resources:
  ConfigDeliveryBucketKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: Customer managed key for the AWS Config delivery bucket
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableRootAccountFullAccess
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub "arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root"
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"

  ConfigDeliveryBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Delete
    Properties:
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      LifecycleConfiguration:
        Rules:
          - Id: ExpireConfigLogs
            Status: Enabled
            Prefix: AWSLogs/
            ExpirationInDays: 1

  ConfigDeliveryBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketCheck
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:GetBucketAcl
            Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
          - Sid: AWSConfigBucketWrite
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: s3:PutObject
            Resource: !Sub "${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*"
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                s3:x-amz-acl: bucket-owner-full-control

  ConfigRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-config-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: config.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWS_ConfigRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: config-delivery-s3
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:PutObject*
                  - s3:GetBucketAcl
                  - s3:GetObjectAcl
                Resource:
                  - !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
                  - !Sub "${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/AWSLogs/${AWS::AccountId}/Config/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                  - kms:ReEncrypt*
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn

  ConfigPreCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-config-precleanup-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: config-precleanup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - config:DescribeDeliveryChannels
                  - config:DescribeConfigurationRecorders
                  - config:DescribeDeliveryChannelStatus
                  - config:DescribeConfigurationRecorderStatus
                  - config:StopConfigurationRecorder
                  - config:DeleteDeliveryChannel
                  - config:DeleteConfigurationRecorder
                Resource: "*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*"

  ConfigPreCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt ConfigPreCleanupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import time
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse

          def wait_until_empty(cfg, timeout_seconds=60, interval=5):
              deadline = time.time() + timeout_seconds
              while time.time() < deadline:
                  recorders = cfg.describe_configuration_recorders().get("ConfigurationRecorders", [])
                  channels = cfg.describe_delivery_channels().get("DeliveryChannels", [])
                  if not recorders and not channels:
                      return
                  time.sleep(interval)
              raise RuntimeError(
                  "Config pre-cleanup timed out: stale recorders/channels still present after deletions"
              )

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] == "Delete":
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  cfg = boto3.client("config")
                  # Stop and delete all recorders first, then delete channels.
                  for rec in cfg.describe_configuration_recorders().get("ConfigurationRecorders", []):
                      try:
                          cfg.stop_configuration_recorder(ConfigurationRecorderName=rec["name"])
                      except Exception as e:
                          print("stop_configuration_recorder:", e)
                  for rec in cfg.describe_configuration_recorders().get("ConfigurationRecorders", []):
                      cfg.delete_configuration_recorder(ConfigurationRecorderName=rec["name"])
                  for ch in cfg.describe_delivery_channels().get("DeliveryChannels", []):
                      cfg.delete_delivery_channel(DeliveryChannelName=ch["name"])
                  wait_until_empty(cfg)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"error": str(e)})

  ConfigPreCleanupCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt ConfigPreCleanupFunction.Arn

  ConfigRecorder:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder
    DependsOn: ConfigPreCleanupCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-config-recorder"
      RoleARN: !GetAtt ConfigRole.Arn
      RecordingGroup:
        AllSupported: true
        IncludeGlobalResourceTypes: true

  ConfigDeliveryChannel:
    Type: AWS::Config::DeliveryChannel
    DependsOn: ConfigPreCleanupCustomResource
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-config-delivery-channel"
      S3BucketName: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket
      ConfigSnapshotDeliveryProperties:
        DeliveryFrequency: TwentyFour_Hours

  BucketCleanupRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-bucket-cleanup-role"
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: bucket-cleanup
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: "2012-10-17"
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:ListBucket
                  - s3:GetBucketVersioning
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - s3:DeleteObject
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersion
                  - s3:DeleteObjectVersionTagging
                Resource: !Sub "${ConfigDeliveryBucket.Arn}/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:GenerateDataKey
                Resource: !GetAtt ConfigDeliveryBucketKey.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*"
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub "arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/*:log-stream:*"

  BucketCleanupFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: index.handler
      Timeout: 300
      Role: !GetAtt BucketCleanupRole.Arn
      Code:
        ZipFile: |
          import boto3
          import cfnresponse
          from botocore.exceptions import ClientError

          def empty_bucket(bucket):
              s3 = boto3.client("s3")
              try:
                  paginator = s3.get_paginator("list_object_versions")
                  for page in paginator.paginate(Bucket=bucket):
                      to_delete = []
                      for key in page.get("Versions", []):
                          to_delete.append({"Key": key["Key"], "VersionId": key["VersionId"]})
                      for key in page.get("DeleteMarkers", []):
                          to_delete.append({"Key": key["Key"], "VersionId": key["VersionId"]})
                      if to_delete:
                          try:
                              s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={"Objects": to_delete})
                          except ClientError:
                              try:
                                  s3.delete_objects(Bucket=bucket, Delete={"Objects": to_delete})
                              except s3.exceptions.NoSuchBucket:
                                  return
              except s3.exceptions.NoSuchBucket:
                  return

          def handler(event, context):
              try:
                  if event["RequestType"] in ("Create", "Update"):
                      cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
                      return
                  bucket = event["ResourceProperties"]["BucketName"]
                  empty_bucket(bucket)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.SUCCESS, {})
              except Exception as e:
                  print(e)
                  cfnresponse.send(event, context, cfnresponse.FAILED, {"error": str(e)})

  BucketCleanupCustomResource:
    Type: AWS::CloudFormation::CustomResource
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigDeliveryBucket
      - ConfigDeliveryBucketPolicy
    Properties:
      ServiceToken: !GetAtt BucketCleanupFunction.Arn
      BucketName: !Ref ConfigDeliveryBucket

  OperationalBestPracticesCloudWatchPack:
    Type: AWS::Config::ConformancePack
    DependsOn:
      - ConfigRecorder
      - ConfigDeliveryChannel
    Properties:
      ConformancePackName: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-operational-best-practices-cloudwatch"
      TemplateBody: !Sub
        - |
          Resources:
            CloudWatchAlarmActionCheckRule:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
          ${AlarmActionCheckInputsLine}
            CloudWatchAlarmActionEnabledCheckRule:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_ACTION_ENABLED_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
            CloudWatchAlarmResourceCheckRule:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_RESOURCE_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
          ${AlarmResourceCheckInputsLine}
            CloudWatchAlarmSettingsCheckRule:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                Source:
                  Owner: AWS
                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_ALARM_SETTINGS_CHECK
                Scope:
                  ComplianceResourceTypes:
                    - AWS::CloudWatch::Alarm
          ${AlarmSettingsCheckInputsLine}
            CloudWatchLogGroupEncryptedRule:
              Type: AWS::Config::ConfigRule
              Properties:
                Source:

                  SourceIdentifier: CLOUDWATCH_LOG_GROUP_ENCRYPTED
        - AlarmActionCheckInputsLine: !If
            - HasAlarmActionInputs
            - !Sub
              - "      InputParameters: {${F1}${F2}${F3}}"
              - F1: !If
                  - HasAlarmActionsRequired

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: DynamoDB storage layer for the security orchestration and automated response platform (six on-demand tables).

Parameters:
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - production
      - staging
      - development
    Description: Environment tag applied to all tables.

Resources:
  SoclessEventsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_events
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: event_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: event_id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SoclessExecutionResultsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_execution_results
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: execution_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: execution_id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SoclessMessageResponsesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_message_responses
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: message_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: message_id
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SoclessPlaybooksTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_playbooks
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: state_machine_name
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: state_machine_name
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SoclessCustomMappingsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_custom_mappings
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: lookup_key
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: lookup_key
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  SoclessDedupTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: socless_dedup
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: dedup_hash
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: dedup_hash
          KeyType: HASH
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: application
          Value: socless
        - Key: environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

Outputs:
  EventsTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_events table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessEventsTable
    Export:
      Name: socless-events-table

  ExecutionResultsTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_execution_results table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessExecutionResultsTable
    Export:
      Name: socless-execution-results-table

  MessageResponsesTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_message_responses table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessMessageResponsesTable
    Export:
      Name: socless-message-responses-table

  PlaybooksTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_playbooks table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessPlaybooksTable
    Export:
      Name: socless-playbooks-table

  CustomMappingsTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_custom_mappings table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessCustomMappingsTable
    Export:
      Name: socless-custom-mappings-table

  DedupTableName:
    Description: Name of the socless_dedup table.
    Value: !Ref SoclessDedupTable

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Description: Encryption-at-rest foundation for restaurant assistant - KMS CMK, DynamoDB tables, and S3 buckets

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: restaurant-assistant
    Description: Project name used for resource naming and tags
  Environment:
    Type: String
    Default: dev
    AllowedValues:
      - dev
      - staging
      - prod
    Description: Deployment environment used for resource naming and tags

Resources:
  DataKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      Description: !Sub Customer managed key for ${ProjectName} ${Environment} data at rest encryption
      Enabled: true
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnableIAMUserPermissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: kms:*
            Resource: "*"
          - Sid: AllowUseOfKeyByServices
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service:
                - dynamodb.amazonaws.com
                - s3.amazonaws.com
                - logging.s3.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: "*"
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  DataKeyAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: !Sub alias/${ProjectName}-${Environment}-key
      TargetKeyId: !Ref DataKey

  SessionsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-sessions
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: data_type
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: session_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: data_type
          KeyType: RANGE
      TimeToLiveSpecification:
        AttributeName: time_to_live
        Enabled: true
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  MarketPricesTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-market-prices
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: ingredient_name
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: market_name
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: last_updated
          AttributeType: N
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: ingredient_name
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: market_name
          KeyType: RANGE
      GlobalSecondaryIndexes:
        - IndexName: ingredient-by-last-updated
          KeySchema:
            - AttributeName: ingredient_name
              KeyType: HASH
            - AttributeName: last_updated
              KeyType: RANGE
          Projection:
            ProjectionType: ALL
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RemindersTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-reminders
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: reminder_id
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: user_id
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: reminder_id
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  RateLimitsTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      TableName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-rate-limits
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: identifier
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: window
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: identifier
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: window
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
        KMSMasterKeyId: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccessLogsBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-access-logs
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  AccessLogsBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${AccessLogsBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

  ImagesBucket:
    Type: AWS::S3::Bucket
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BucketName: !Sub ${ProjectName}-${Environment}-images
      BucketEncryption:
        ServerSideEncryptionConfiguration:
          - ServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
              SSEAlgorithm: aws:kms
              KMSMasterKeyID: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
            BucketKeyEnabled: true
      PublicAccessBlockConfiguration:
        BlockPublicAcls: true
        BlockPublicPolicy: true
        IgnorePublicAcls: true
        RestrictPublicBuckets: true
      VersioningConfiguration:
        Status: Enabled
      LoggingConfiguration:
        DestinationBucketName: !Ref AccessLogsBucket
        LogFilePrefix: !Sub ${ProjectName}/${Environment}/images/
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: !Ref ProjectName
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref Environment

  ImagesBucketPolicy:
    Type: AWS::S3::BucketPolicy
    Properties:
      Bucket: !Ref ImagesBucket
      PolicyDocument:
        Version: "2012-10-17"
        Statement:
          - Sid: EnforceTLS
            Effect: Deny
            Principal: "*"
            Action: s3:*
            Resource:
              - !GetAtt ImagesBucket.Arn
              - !Sub ${ImagesBucket.Arn}/*
            Condition:
              Bool:
                aws:SecureTransport: "false"

Outputs:
  KmsKeyArn:
    Description: KMS customer managed key ARN
    Value: !GetAtt DataKey.Arn
  KmsKeyAliasName:
    Description: KMS key alias name
    Value: !Ref DataKeyAlias
  SessionsTableName:
    Value: !Ref SessionsTable
  SessionsTableArn:
    Value: !GetAtt SessionsTable.Arn
  MarketPricesTableName:
    Value: !Ref MarketPricesTable

    Value: !Ref RemindersTable
  RemindersTableArn:
    Value: !GetAtt RemindersTable.Arn
  RateLimitsTableName:
    Value: !Ref RateLimitsTable
  RateLimitsTableArn:
    Value: !GetAtt RateLimitsTable.Arn

    Value: !Ref ImagesBucket

    Value: !GetAtt ImagesBucket.Arn

    Value: !Ref AccessLogsBucket

    Value: !GetAtt AccessLogsBucket.Arn

final_template:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: >
  Shared identity and state layer for a stateful Amazon Bedrock AgentCore demo.
  Provisions a Cognito user pool with hosted domain, resource server, two app
  clients, a seeded test user, a DynamoDB finance-state table, two IAM runtime
  roles, and SSM discovery parameters.
  NOTE (objective 5): Setting a PERMANENT password on a Cognito user directly
  from CloudFormation requires a Lambda-backed custom resource. Per guidance,
  the user is created with a temporary password (placeholder default) and the
  password is also stored in a Secrets Manager secret created in-template.
  An operator (or the demo bootstrap script) must call AdminSetUserPassword
  once to make it permanent. No secrets are resolved dynamically.

Parameters:
  ProjectName:
    Type: String
    Default: agentcore-demo
    Description: Project name used to derive resource names and the SSM parameter path.
  TestUserEmail:
    Type: String
    Default: user@example.com
    AllowedPattern: '^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+\.[^@\s]+$'
    Description: Email address for the seeded test user (placeholder default).
  TestUserPassword:
    Type: String
    Default: 'ChangeMe-Temp123!'
    NoEcho: true
    Description: >
      Temporary password for the seeded test user (placeholder default).
      Must be promoted to permanent via AdminSetUserPassword post-deployment.
  CallbackURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://localhost:3000/callback
    Description: Callback URLs for the interactive web client.
  LogoutURLs:
    Type: CommaDelimitedList
    Default: https://localhost:3000/logout
    Description: Logout URLs for the interactive web client.

Resources:
  UserPool:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPool
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      UserPoolName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agentcore-users'
      AutoVerifiedAttributes:
        - email
      Policies:
        PasswordPolicy:
          MinimumLength: 12
          RequireLowercase: true
          RequireUppercase: true
          RequireNumbers: true
          RequireSymbols: true
      UserPoolAddOns:
        AdvancedSecurityMode: ENFORCED
      AccountRecoverySetting:
        RecoveryMechanisms:
          - Name: verified_email
            Priority: 1

  UserPoolDomain:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolDomain
    Properties:
      Domain: !Sub '${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}'
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool

  ResourceServer:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Identifier: !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.example-api.local'
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}-finance-api'
      Scopes:
        - ScopeName: finance:read
          ScopeDescription: Read finance tracking state for the agent
        - ScopeName: finance:write
          ScopeDescription: Write finance tracking state for the agent

  M2MClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-m2m-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - client_credentials
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.example-api.local/finance:read'
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.example-api.local/finance:write'
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO

  WebClient:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolClient
    DependsOn: ResourceServer
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      ClientName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-web-client'
      GenerateSecret: true
      AllowedOAuthFlows:
        - code
      AllowedOAuthFlowsUserPoolClient: true
      AllowedOAuthScopes:
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.example-api.local/finance:read'
        - !Sub 'https://${ProjectName}-${AWS::AccountId}-${AWS::Region}.example-api.local/finance:write'
        - openid
        - email
        - profile
      SupportedIdentityProviders:
        - COGNITO
      ExplicitAuthFlows:
        - ALLOW_USER_SRP_AUTH
        - ALLOW_REFRESH_TOKEN_AUTH
      CallbackURLs: !Ref CallbackURLs
      LogoutURLs: !Ref LogoutURLs

  TestUserSecret:
    Type: AWS::SecretsManager::Secret
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '${ProjectName}/agentcore/test-user-credentials'
      Description: Seeded test user credentials for the AgentCore demo (placeholder default; rotate immediately).
      SecretString: !Sub '{"username":"${TestUserEmail}","password":"${TestUserPassword}","user_pool_id":"${UserPool}"}'

  TestUser:
    Type: AWS::Cognito::UserPoolUser
    Properties:
      UserPoolId: !Ref UserPool
      Username: !Ref TestUserEmail
      MessageAction: SUPPRESS
      DesiredDeliveryMediums:
        - EMAIL
      UserAttributes:
        - Name: email
          Value: !Ref TestUserEmail
        - Name: email_verified
          Value: 'true'
      # Temporary password only; permanent set requires a custom resource (see template Description).

  FinanceStateTable:
    Type: AWS::DynamoDB::Table
    UpdateReplacePolicy: Retain
    DeletionPolicy: Retain
    Properties:
      BillingMode: PAY_PER_REQUEST
      AttributeDefinitions:
        - AttributeName: PK
          AttributeType: S
        - AttributeName: SK
          AttributeType: S
      KeySchema:
        - AttributeName: PK
          KeyType: HASH
        - AttributeName: SK
          KeyType: RANGE
      SSESpecification:
        SSEEnabled: true
        SSEType: KMS
      PointInTimeRecoverySpecification:
        PointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true

  McpServerRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-mcp-server-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: mcp-server-dynamodb
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - dynamodb:GetItem
                  - dynamodb:PutItem
                  - dynamodb:UpdateItem
                  - dynamodb:DeleteItem
                  - dynamodb:Query
                  - dynamodb:Scan
                Resource: !GetAtt FinanceStateTable.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                  - xray:PutTraceSegments
                  - xray:PutTelemetryRecords
                Resource: '*'

  AgentRuntimeRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub '${ProjectName}-agent-runtime-role'
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: bedrock-agentcore.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: agent-runtime-access
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeModel
                  - bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - bedrock:InvokeAgent
                  - bedrock:Retrieve
                  - bedrock:RetrieveAndGenerate
                Resource: '*'
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - cognito-idp:DescribeUserPoolClient
                  - cognito-idp:ListUserPoolClients
                Resource: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn
              - Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: '*'

  SsmUserPoolId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/user-pool-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref UserPool

  SsmUserPoolArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/user-pool-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt UserPool.Arn

  SsmM2MClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/m2m-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref M2MClient

  SsmWebClientId:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/web-client-id'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref WebClient

  SsmDiscoveryEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/oidc-discovery-endpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/.well-known/openid-configuration'

  SsmTokenEndpoint:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/token-endpoint'
      Type: String
      Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token'

  SsmTableName:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/finance-table-name'
      Type: String
      Value: !Ref FinanceStateTable

  SsmMcpRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/mcp-server-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt McpServerRole.Arn

  SsmAgentRoleArn:
    Type: AWS::SSM::Parameter
    Properties:
      Name: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore/agent-runtime-role-arn'
      Type: String
      Value: !GetAtt AgentRuntimeRole.Arn

Outputs:
  SsmParameterPathPrefix:
    Description: SSM parameter path prefix where all discovery values are published.
    Value: !Sub '/${ProjectName}/agentcore'
  UserPoolId:
    Description: Cognito user pool identifier.
    Value: !Ref UserPool
  M2MClientId:
    Description: Machine-to-machine (client credentials) app client ID.
    Value: !Ref M2MClient
  WebClientId:
    Description: Interactive web sign-in app client ID.
    Value: !Ref WebClient
  FinanceStateTableName:
    Description: DynamoDB table holding finance tracking state.
    Value: !Ref FinanceStateTable
  HostedUiDomain:
    Description: Cognito hosted UI domain.
    Value: !Sub 'https://${UserPoolDomain}.auth.${AWS::Region}.amazoncognito.com'

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Highly available two-tier network VPC with public/private subnets across two AZs, per-AZ NAT gateways, and exported identifiers.

Parameters:
  VpcCidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.0.0/16
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for the VPC.
  PublicSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.1.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 1 (AZ0).
  PublicSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.2.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for public subnet 2 (AZ1).
  PrivateSubnet1Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.101.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 1 (AZ0).
  PrivateSubnet2Cidr:
    Type: String
    Default: 10.0.102.0/24
    AllowedPattern: '^(\d{1,3}\.){3}\d{1,3}/\d{1,2}$'
    Description: CIDR block for private subnet 2 (AZ1).

Resources:
  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC
    Properties:
      CidrBlock: !Ref VpcCidr
      EnableDnsSupport: true
      EnableDnsHostnames: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-vpc'

  InternetGateway:
    Type: AWS::EC2::InternetGateway
    Properties:
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-igw'

  VPCGatewayAttachment:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      InternetGatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-1'

  PublicSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PublicSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-subnet-2'

  PrivateSubnet1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet1Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [0, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-1'

  PrivateSubnet2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Subnet
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      CidrBlock: !Ref PrivateSubnet2Cidr
      AvailabilityZone: !Select [1, !GetAZs '']
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-subnet-2'

  PublicRouteTable:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-public-rt'

  PublicRoute:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      GatewayId: !Ref InternetGateway

  PublicSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  PublicSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PublicRouteTable

  NatEIP1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-1'

  NatEIP2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::EIP
    DependsOn: VPCGatewayAttachment
    Properties:
      Domain: vpc
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-eip-2'

  NatGateway1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet1
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP1.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-1'

  NatGateway2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::NatGateway
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PublicSubnet2
      AllocationId: !GetAtt NatEIP2.AllocationId
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-nat-2'

  PrivateRouteTable1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-1'

  PrivateRoute1:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway1

  PrivateSubnet1RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable1

  PrivateRouteTable2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::RouteTable
    Properties:
      VpcId: !Ref VPC
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-private-rt-2'

  PrivateRoute2:
    Type: AWS::EC2::Route
    Properties:
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2
      DestinationCidrBlock: 0.0.0.0/0
      NatGatewayId: !Ref NatGateway2

  PrivateSubnet2RouteTableAssociation:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SubnetRouteTableAssociation
    Properties:
      SubnetId: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
      RouteTableId: !Ref PrivateRouteTable2

Outputs:
  VpcId:
    Description: VPC ID
    Value: !Ref VPC
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-VpcId'
  PublicSubnet1Id:
    Description: Public subnet 1 ID (AZ0)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet1Id'
  PublicSubnet2Id:
    Description: Public subnet 2 ID (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PublicSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PublicSubnet2Id'
  PrivateSubnet1Id:
    Description: Private subnet 1 ID (AZ0)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet1
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet1Id'
  PrivateSubnet2Id:
    Description: Private subnet 2 ID (AZ1)
    Value: !Ref PrivateSubnet2
    Export:
      Name: !Sub '${AWS::StackName}-PrivateSubnet2Id'
